all: $(TOP)/lib/stm32lib/README.md $(BUILD)/firmware.dfu $(BUILD)/firmware.hex

# For convenience, automatically fetch required submodules if they don't exist
$(TOP)/lib/stm32lib/README.md:
	$(ECHO) "stm32lib submodule not found, fetching it now..."
	(cd $(TOP) && git submodule update --init lib/stm32lib)

.PHONY: deploy deploy-stlink deploy-trusted

deploy: $(BUILD)/firmware.dfu
	$(ECHO) "Writing $< to the board"
	$(Q)$(PYTHON) $(PYDFU) -u $<

deploy-stlink: $(BUILD)/firmware.dfu
	$(ECHO) "Writing $< to the board via ST-LINK"
	$(Q)$(STFLASH) write $(BUILD)/firmware.bin $(MBOOT_TEXT0_ADDR)

deploy-trusted: $(BUILD)/firmware-trusted.bin
	$(STM32_CUBE_PROGRAMMER)/bin/STM32_Programmer.sh -c port=SWD mode=HOTPLUG ap=1 -el $(DKEL) -w $^ 0x70000000 -hardRst

$(BUILD)/firmware.bin: $(BUILD)/firmware.elf
	$(ECHO) "Create $@"
	$(Q)$(OBJCOPY) -O binary -j .isr_vector -j .text -j .data -j .mboot_version_text $^ $(BUILD)/firmware.bin

$(BUILD)/firmware.dfu: $(BUILD)/firmware.bin
	$(ECHO) "Create $@"
	$(Q)$(PYTHON) $(DFU) -b $(MBOOT_TEXT0_ADDR):$(BUILD)/firmware.bin $@

$(BUILD)/firmware.hex: $(BUILD)/firmware.elf
	$(ECHO) "Create $@"
	$(Q)$(OBJCOPY) -O ihex $< $@

$(BUILD)/firmware.elf: $(OBJ)
	$(ECHO) "LINK $@"
	$(Q)$(LD) $(LDFLAGS) -o $@ $^ $(LIBS)
	$(Q)$(SIZE) $@

$(BUILD)/firmware-trusted.bin: $(BUILD)/firmware.bin
	/bin/rm -f $@
	$(STM32_CUBE_PROGRAMMER)/bin/STM32_SigningTool_CLI -bin $^ -nk -of 0x80000000 -t fsbl -o $@ -hv $(STM32_N6_HEADER_VERSION) --align

#########################################
# Rules to generate header files

MAKE_PINS = ../boards/make-pins.py
PREFIX_FILE = ../boards/stm32f4xx_prefix.c
BOARD_PINS = $(BOARD_DIR)/pins.csv
HEADER_BUILD = $(BUILD)/genhdr
GEN_QSTRDEFS_GENERATED = $(HEADER_BUILD)/qstrdefs.generated.h
GEN_ROOT_POINTERS = $(HEADER_BUILD)/root_pointers.h
GEN_PINS_SRC = $(BUILD)/pins_$(BOARD).c
GEN_PINS_HDR = $(HEADER_BUILD)/pins.h
GEN_PINS_AF_CONST = $(HEADER_BUILD)/pins_af_const.h
GEN_PINS_AF_DEFS = $(HEADER_BUILD)/pins_af_defs.h
GEN_MPVERSION = $(HEADER_BUILD)/mpversion.h

$(OBJ): $(GEN_QSTRDEFS_GENERATED) $(GEN_ROOT_POINTERS) $(GEN_PINS_AF_DEFS) $(GEN_MPVERSION)

$(HEADER_BUILD):
	$(MKDIR) -p $(BUILD)/genhdr

$(GEN_QSTRDEFS_GENERATED): | $(HEADER_BUILD)
	$(Q)echo "// empty" > $@

$(GEN_ROOT_POINTERS): | $(HEADER_BUILD)
	$(Q)echo "// empty" > $@

$(GEN_PINS_AF_DEFS): $(BOARD_PINS) $(MAKE_PINS) ../$(AF_FILE) $(PREFIX_FILE) | $(HEADER_BUILD)
	$(ECHO) "GEN $@"
	$(Q)$(PYTHON) $(MAKE_PINS) --board-csv $(BOARD_PINS) --af-csv ../$(AF_FILE) --prefix $(PREFIX_FILE) \
		--output-source $(GEN_PINS_SRC) --output-header $(GEN_PINS_HDR) \
		--output-af-const $(GEN_PINS_AF_CONST) --output-af-defs $(GEN_PINS_AF_DEFS) \
		--mboot-mode

$(GEN_MPVERSION): | $(HEADER_BUILD)
	$(PYTHON) ../../../py/makeversionhdr.py $@

#########################################

vpath %.S . $(TOP)
$(BUILD)/%.o: %.S
	$(ECHO) "CC $<"
	$(Q)$(CC) $(CFLAGS) -c -o $@ $<

vpath %.s . $(TOP)
$(BUILD)/%.o: %.s
	$(ECHO) "AS $<"
	$(Q)$(AS) -o $@ $<

define compile_c
$(ECHO) "CC $<"
$(Q)$(CC) $(CFLAGS) -c -MD -o $@ $<
@# The following fixes the dependency file.
@# See http://make.paulandlesley.org/autodep.html for details.
@# Regex adjusted from the above to play better with Windows paths, etc.
@$(CP) $(@:.o=.d) $(@:.o=.P); \
  $(SED) -e 's/#.*//' -e 's/^.*:  *//' -e 's/ *\\$$//' \
      -e '/^$$/ d' -e 's/$$/ :/' < $(@:.o=.d) >> $(@:.o=.P); \
  $(RM) -f $(@:.o=.d)
endef

vpath %.c . $(TOP)
$(BUILD)/%.o: %.c
	$(call compile_c)

# $(sort $(var)) removes duplicates
#
# The net effect of this, is it causes the objects to depend on the
# object directories (but only for existence), and the object directories
# will be created if they don't exist.
OBJ_DIRS = $(sort $(dir $(OBJ)))
$(OBJ): | $(OBJ_DIRS)
$(OBJ_DIRS):
	$(MKDIR) -p $@

clean:
	$(RM) -rf $(BUILD) $(CLEAN_EXTRA)
.PHONY: clean

###########################################

-include $(OBJ:.o=.P)

2	 ******************************************************************************
3	 * @file      startup_stm32n647xx_fsbl.s
4	 * @author    GPM Application Team
5	 * @brief     STM32N647XX device vector table for GCC toolchain.
6	 *            This startup file should be used for the FSBL (after bootROM execution).
7	 *            This module performs:
8	 *                - Set the initial SP
9	 *                - Set the initial PC == Reset_Handler,
10	 *                - Set the vector table entries with the exceptions ISR address
11	 *                - Branches to main in the C library (which eventually
12	 *                  calls main()).
13	 ******************************************************************************
14	 * @attention
15	 *
16	 * Copyright (c) 2023 STMicroelectronics.
17	 * All rights reserved.
18	 *
19	 * This software is licensed under terms that can be found in the LICENSE file
20	 * in the root directory of this software component.
21	 * If no LICENSE file comes with this software, it is provided AS-IS.
22	 *
23	 ******************************************************************************
24	 */
25	
26	.syntax unified
27	.arch armv8.1-m.main
28	.fpu softvfp
29	.thumb
30	
31	.global g_pfnVectors
32	.global Default_Handler
33	
34	/* start address for the initialization values of the .data section.
35	defined in linker script */
36	.word _sidata
37	/* start address for the .data section. defined in linker script */
38	.word _sdata
39	/* end address for the .data section. defined in linker script */
40	.word _edata
41	/* start address for the .bss section. defined in linker script */
42	.word _sbss
43	/* end address for the .bss section. defined in linker script */
44	.word _ebss
45	
46	/**
47	 * @brief  This is the code that gets called when the processor first
48	 *          starts execution following a reset event. Only the absolutely
49	 *          necessary set is performed, after which the application
50	 *          supplied main() routine is called.
51	 * @param  None
52	 * @retval : None
53	*/
54	
55	  .section .text.Reset_Handler
56	  .weak Reset_Handler
57	  .type Reset_Handler, %function
58	Reset_Handler:
59	  ldr   r0, =_sstack
60	  msr   MSPLIM, r0
61	  ldr   r0, =_estack
62	  mov   sp, r0          /* set stack pointer */
63	/* Call the clock system initialization function.*/
64	  bl  SystemInit
65	
66	/* Copy the data segment initializers from flash to SRAM */
67	  ldr r0, =_sdata
68	  ldr r1, =_edata
69	  ldr r2, =_sidata
70	  movs r3, #0
71	  b LoopCopyDataInit
72	
73	CopyDataInit:
74	  ldr r4, [r2, r3]
75	  str r4, [r0, r3]
76	  adds r3, r3, #4
77	
78	LoopCopyDataInit:
79	  adds r4, r0, r3
80	  cmp r4, r1
81	  bcc CopyDataInit
82	
83	/* Zero fill the bss segment. */
84	  ldr r2, =_sbss
85	  ldr r4, =_ebss
86	  movs r3, #0
87	  b LoopFillZerobss
88	
89	FillZerobss:
90	  str  r3, [r2]
91	  adds r2, r2, #4
92	
93	LoopFillZerobss:
94	  cmp r2, r4
95	  bcc FillZerobss
96	
97	/* Call static constructors */
98	  bl __libc_init_array
99	/* Call the application's entry point.*/
100	  bl main
101	
102	LoopForever:
103	  b LoopForever
104	
105	  .size Reset_Handler, .-Reset_Handler
106

/**
 ******************************************************************************
 * @file      startup_stm32n647xx_fsbl.s
 * @author    GPM Application Team
 * @brief     STM32N647XX device vector table for GCC toolchain.
 *            This startup file should be used for the FSBL (after bootROM execution).
 *            This module performs:
 *                - Set the initial SP
 *                - Set the initial PC == Reset_Handler,
 *                - Set the vector table entries with the exceptions ISR address
 *                - Branches to main in the C library (which eventually
 *                  calls main()).
 ******************************************************************************
 * @attention
 *
 * Copyright (c) 2023 STMicroelectronics.
 * All rights reserved.
 *
 * This software is licensed under terms that can be found in the LICENSE file
 * in the root directory of this software component.
 * If no LICENSE file comes with this software, it is provided AS-IS.
 *
 ******************************************************************************
 */

.syntax unified
.arch armv8.1-m.main
.fpu softvfp
.thumb

.global g_pfnVectors
.global Default_Handler

/* start address for the initialization values of the .data section.
defined in linker script */
.word _sidata
/* start address for the .data section. defined in linker script */
.word _sdata
/* end address for the .data section. defined in linker script */
.word _edata
/* start address for the .bss section. defined in linker script */
.word _sbss
/* end address for the .bss section. defined in linker script */
.word _ebss

/**
 * @brief  This is the code that gets called when the processor first
 *          starts execution following a reset event. Only the absolutely
 *          necessary set is performed, after which the application
 *          supplied main() routine is called.
 * @param  None
 * @retval : None
*/

  .section .text.Reset_Handler
  .weak Reset_Handler
  .type Reset_Handler, %function
Reset_Handler:
  ldr   r0, =_sstack
  msr   MSPLIM, r0
  ldr   r0, =_estack
  mov   sp, r0          /* set stack pointer */
/* Call the clock system initialization function.*/
  bl  SystemInit

/* Copy the data segment initializers from flash to SRAM */
  ldr r0, =_sdata
  ldr r1, =_edata
  ldr r2, =_sidata
  movs r3, #0
  b LoopCopyDataInit

CopyDataInit:
  ldr r4, [r2, r3]
  str r4, [r0, r3]
  adds r3, r3, #4

LoopCopyDataInit:
  adds r4, r0, r3
  cmp r4, r1
  bcc CopyDataInit

/* Zero fill the bss segment. */
  ldr r2, =_sbss
  ldr r4, =_ebss
  movs r3, #0
  b LoopFillZerobss

FillZerobss:
  str  r3, [r2]
  adds r2, r2, #4

LoopFillZerobss:
  cmp r2, r4
  bcc FillZerobss

/* Call static constructors */
  bl __libc_init_array
/* Call the application's entry point.*/
  bl main

LoopForever:
  b LoopForever

  .size Reset_Handler, .-Reset_Handler

/**
 * @brief  This is the code that gets called when the processor receives an
 *         unexpected interrupt.  This simply enters an infinite loop, preserving
 *         the system state for examination by a debugger.
 *
 * @param  None
 * @retval : None
*/
  .section .text.Default_Handler,"ax",%progbits
Default_Handler:
Infinite_Loop:
  b Infinite_Loop
  .size Default_Handler, .-Default_Handler

/******************************************************************************
*
* The STM32N647XX vector table.  Note that the proper constructs
* must be placed on this to ensure that it ends up at physical address
* 0x0000.0000.
*
******************************************************************************/
  .section .isr_vector,"a",%progbits
  .type g_pfnVectors, %object
  .size g_pfnVectors, .-g_pfnVectors

  .word MemManage_Handler

  .word 0

50	/* Cortex-M55 CCR.LOB (Low-Overhead Branch) enable bit.  Not yet exposed by
51	 * the generic armv8-m nvic.h.
52	 */
53	
54	#define NVIC_CFGCON_LOB             (1 << 19)
55	
56	#define HEAP_BASE  ((uintptr_t)_ebss + CONFIG_IDLETHREAD_STACKSIZE)

60	 ****************************************************************************/

72	#else

74	#endif
75	
76	/* Cortex-M55 ARMv8.1-M Low-Overhead Branch: enables WLS/DLS/LE.
77	 * CCR.LOB resets to 0; enable before any loop the compiler may lower
78	 * with LE (and before MVE code, which is gated on the same bit).
79	 */
80	
81	static inline void stm32_enable_lob(void)
82	{
83	  uint32_t regval;
84	
85	  regval  = getreg32(NVIC_CFGCON);
86	  regval |= NVIC_CFGCON_LOB;
87	  putreg32(regval, NVIC_CFGCON);
88	  UP_ISB();
89	}

92	 * Public Functions
93	 ****************************************************************************/
94	
95	/* __start_c() carries the real boot logic; __start() below is a naked
96	 * dispatcher that clears the boot-ROM stack limits before any prologue.
97	 * __start_c is reached via "b __start_c" from __start's inline asm and
98	 * therefore must have external linkage.
99	 */
100	
101	void __start_c(void) noinstrument_function;
102	
103	/****************************************************************************
104	 * Name: __start
105	 *
106	 * Description:
107	 *   Reset entry point.  The STM32N6 boot ROM (DEV mode) leaves MSPLIM and
108	 *   PSPLIM set such that the first stack push from C code can fault.
109	 *   This function is naked so the limits can be cleared before any
110	 *   compiler-generated prologue runs.  It then tail-calls __start_c.
111	 *
112	 ****************************************************************************/
113	
114	void __attribute__((naked)) noinstrument_function __start(void)
115	{
116	  __asm__ volatile ("mov r0, #0\n\t"
117	                    "msr msplim, r0\n\t"
118	                    "msr psplim, r0\n\t"
119	                    "b __start_c\n\t");
120	}

122	/****************************************************************************
123	 * Name: __start_c
124	 *
125	 * Description:
126	 *   The C-level boot path, reached from the naked __start dispatcher.
127	 *

130	void __start_c(void)
131	{
132	  const uint32_t *src;
133	  uint32_t *dest;
134	
135	  /* The DEV-mode boot ROM leaves VTOR pointing at its own ROM region.  Set
136	   * VTOR to our SRAM vector table before enabling any exception path.
137	   */
138	
139	  putreg32((uint32_t)_vectors, NVIC_VECTAB);
140	
141	  /* When chain-loaded by an FSBL that called HAL_Init(), SysTick may be
142	   * left running.  Disable it and clear any pending interrupt so it does
143	   * not fire before NuttX has attached its handler.
144	   */
145	
146	  putreg32(0, NVIC_SYSTICK_CTRL);
147	  putreg32(NVIC_INTCTRL_PENDSTCLR, NVIC_INTCTRL);
148	
149	  /* Force plain SLEEP (not DEEPSLEEP) on WFI so the system clock keeps
150	   * running and SysTick continues to wake us.  Cleared once here so
151	   * up_idle() does not need to touch it on every idle entry.
152	   */
153	
154	  modifyreg32(NVIC_SYSCON, NVIC_SYSCON_SLEEPDEEP, 0);
155	
156	  /* Enable the FPU before stm32_clockconfig and the rest of init.  With
157	   * hard-float ABI the compiler may emit FPU instructions later, and any
158	   * exception entry will try to push FP context -- both require CP10/CP11.
159	   */
160	
161	  arm_fpuconfig();
162	
163	  /* Clear .bss inline rather than calling memset, so global state is sane
164	   * even if anything depends on it during the rest of __start.
165	   */
166	
167	  for (dest = (uint32_t *)_sbss; dest < (uint32_t *)_ebss; )
168	    {
169	      *dest++ = 0;
170	    }
171	
172	  /* Copy .data from its load address to SRAM.  For SRAM-only DEV-mode
173	   * builds the linker arranges _eronly == _sdata so the copy is skipped;
174	   * the explicit check avoids corrupting .data when alignment padding
175	   * would otherwise leave a gap between _eronly and _sdata.
176	   */
177	
178	  if (&_eronly[0] != &_sdata[0])
179	    {
180	      for (src = (const uint32_t *)_eronly,
181	           dest = (uint32_t *)_sdata; dest < (uint32_t *)_edata;
182	          )
183	        {
184	          *dest++ = *src++;
185	        }
186	    }
187	
188	  stm32_enable_lob();
189	
190	  stm32_clockconfig();
191	
192	  /* Per ES0620, BSECEN must remain set or WFI/sleep fails.  Set it via
193	   * the atomic SET register, together with SYSCFGEN which we need below.
194	   */
195	
196	  putreg32(RCC_APB4HENR_SYSCFGEN | RCC_APB4HENR_BSECEN,
197	           STM32_RCC_APB4HENSR);
198	
199	  /* Enable the LPEN bits that keep clocks running through WFI (CSLEEP).
200	   * Without these, WFI halts the clocks for the AXISRAM banks and any
201	   * enabled peripherals, and the system never wakes up.
202	   */
203	
204	  putreg32(RCC_BUSLPENR_ACLKNLPEN | RCC_BUSLPENR_ACLKNCLPEN,
205	           STM32_RCC_BUSLPENSR);
206	  putreg32(RCC_MEMLPENR_ALLAXISRAM | RCC_MEMLPENR_CACHEAXIRAMLPEN,
207	           STM32_RCC_MEMLPENSR);
208	#ifdef CONFIG_STM32_USART1
209	  putreg32(RCC_APB2LPENR_USART1LPEN, STM32_RCC_APB2LPENSR);
210	#endif
211	
212	  /* Mark the board's I/O voltage domains as supply-valid before any GPIO
213	   * pad is driven.  The mask of PWR_SVMCR3_* bits is board-specific and
214	   * provided by board.h via BOARD_PWR_VDDIO.
215	   */
216	
217	  stm32_pwr_enablevddio(BOARD_PWR_VDDIO);
218	
219	  /* Apply the ES0620 I/O-compensation mitigation (write 0x287) to the
220	   * domains we use.  Only VDDIO2 and VDDIO3 are touched: the other
221	   * VDDIOxCCCR registers cannot be accessed without their VDDIOxSV bit
222	   * set first (separate ES0620 erratum), and only VDDIO2/3 are declared
223	   * supply-valid in BOARD_PWR_VDDIO above.
224	   */
225	
226	  putreg32(SYSCFG_CCCR_ES0620_MANUAL, STM32_SYSCFG_VDDIO2CCCR);
227	  putreg32(SYSCFG_CCCR_ES0620_MANUAL, STM32_SYSCFG_VDDIO3CCCR);
228	  putreg32(SYSCFG_CCCR_ES0620_MANUAL, STM32_SYSCFG_VDDCCCR);
229	
230	  putreg32((uint32_t)_vectors, STM32_SYSCFG_INITSVTORCR);
231	
232	  /* Read-back to ensure prior SYSCFG writes complete */
233	
234	  (void)getreg32(STM32_SYSCFG_VDDCCCR);
235	
236	#ifdef CONFIG_STM32_USART1
237	  /* Route USART1's kernel clock to HSI so the BRR computation is
238	   * independent of any later SYSCLK changes.
239	   */
240	
241	  putreg32(RCC_CCIPR13_USART1SEL_HSI, STM32_RCC_CCIPR13);
242	#endif
243	
244	  stm32_lowsetup();
245	
246	#ifdef USE_EARLYSERIALINIT
247	  arm_earlyserialinit();
248	#endif
249	
250	  stm32_board_initialize();
251	
252	  /* Final DSB+ISB after SCB writes (VTOR, SYSTICK_CTRL, SYSCFG INITSVTORCR)
253	   * before handing off to NuttX.
254	   */
255	
256	  UP_DSB();
257	  UP_ISB();
258	
259	  showprogress('\r');
260	  showprogress('\n');
261	
262	  nx_start();
263	
264	  /* Shouldn't get here */
265	
266	  for (; ; );
267	}

1. **STM32N647X0 has no internal flash** - boot from external SPI flash (MX25UM25645G, 32MB)
2. **Boot process**: Boot ROM → FSBL (loaded into SRAM2 at 0x34180400) → Main firmware (XIP at 0x70080000 or SRAM)
3. **MicroPython demo** has a complete FSBL implementation via "mboot" which:
   - Configures VDD (VDDIO2/3/4) and I/O compensation
   - Configures SMPS supply and voltage scaling
   - Initializes XSPI flash (MX25UM25645G) in DTR mode
   - Configures PLL2/PLL4 for camera (DCMIPP/CSI)
   - Boots application from external flash
4. **NuttX board** currently only supports DEV boot mode (ST-Link loads code directly into SRAM at 0x34000400)
5. **NuttX start code** (`stm32_start.c`) already has some FSBL awareness (disables SysTick, clears stack limits)

To adapt FSBL for the NuttX DNN647 board, I need to create an FSBL program that initializes the hardware and boots NuttX from external flash, similar to how mboot works for MicroPython.

The main tasks are setting up the FSBL with proper startup assembly and system initialization, configuring the linker for the SRAM2 memory region at 0x34180400, adding board-specific VDD and XSPI initialization, creating a defconfig for the FSBL build, and writing a script to sign the FSBL binary using STM32_SigningTool so it can be loaded by the boot ROM.

# DNN647 FSBL 适配计划

## Context

STM32N647X0 没有内部 Flash，必须从外部 SPI Flash (MX25UM25645G, 32MB) 启动。当前 NuttX 的 atk-dnn647 板级仅支持 DEV 模式（ST-Link 直接加载代码到 SRAM），无法实现冷启动。

参考 `demo/atk-dnn647-micropython` 项目的 mboot（MicroPython bootloader）实现，需要为 NuttX 适配 FSBL，实现以下启动链：

```
Boot ROM → FSBL (0x34180400, SRAM2) → NuttX Application (0x70080000, XIP from external flash)
```

## 实施方案

### 第一步：创建 FSBL 板级目录结构

在 `nuttx/boards/arm/stm32n6/atk-dnn647/` 下创建 `fsbl` 配置目录：

```
nuttx/boards/arm/stm32n6/atk-dnn647/
├── configs/fsbl/defconfig          # FSBL 配置
├── scripts/fsbl.ld                 # FSBL 链接脚本
├── src/fsbl_main.c                 # FSBL 主程序
└── src/Make.defs                   # 更新源文件列表
```

### 第二步：创建 FSBL 链接脚本

文件：`scripts/fsbl.ld`

参考 MicroPython 的 `stm32_memory_n6.ld`，定义内存区域：
- `FLASH_BL`: `0x34180400`, 31744 字节（FSBL 代码区）
- `RAM`: `0x341e0000`, 128K（FSBL 运行时数据区）

### 第三步：创建 FSBL 主程序

文件：`src/fsbl_main.c`

FSBL 需要完成以下初始化工作（参考 MicroPython `board.c` 的 `mboot_board_early_init()`）：

1. **VDD 配置**：
   - 使能 PWR、BSEC、SYSCFG 时钟
   - 配置 VDDIO2 (3.3V)、VDDIO3 (1.8V)、VDDIO4 (3.3V)
   - 配置 VDD ADC 和 USB
   - I/O 补偿使能

2. **电源配置**：
   - 配置 SMPS 供电
   - 设置电压调节器为 SCALE0

3. **XSPI Flash 初始化**：
   - 配置 XSPI2 引脚（PN0-PN12, AF9）
   - 初始化 XSPI2 外设（Macronix 模式）
   - 切换到 DTR 模式
   - 使能内存映射模式（XIP 基地址 0x70000000）

4. **跳转到应用**：
   - 验证 APPLICATION_ADDR 处的有效性
   - 设置 MSP 和 VTOR
   - 跳转到应用的 Reset_Handler

### 第四步：创建 FSBL defconfig

文件：`configs/fsbl/defconfig`

关键配置项：
```
CONFIG_ARCH="arm"
CONFIG_ARCH_ARMV8M=y
CONFIG_ARCH_BOARD="atk-dnn647"
CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP="stm32n6"
CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP_STM32N647X0=y
CONFIG_RAM_START=0x34180400
CONFIG_RAM_SIZE=31744
CONFIG_FSBL=y
CONFIG_STM32N6_FSBL=y
```

### 第五步：创建 NuttX 应用链接脚本（XIP 模式）

文件：`scripts/flash_xip.ld`

定义内存区域：
- `FLASH_APP`: `0x70080000`（应用代码 XIP 区域）
- `RAM`: `0x34000400`（运行时数据区）

### 第六步：创建应用 defconfig（XIP 模式）

文件：`configs/nsh_xip/defconfig`

基于现有 `nsh` 配置，修改：
- `CONFIG_RAM_START=0x34000400`
- 添加 XIP 相关配置

### 第七步：创建构建和烧录脚本

文件：`tools/flash_dnn647.sh`

脚本流程：
1. 构建 FSBL 二进制
2. 使用 STM32_SigningTool 签名 FSBL（`-t fsbl`）
3. 烧录 FSBL 到外部 Flash `0x70000000`
4. 构建 NuttX 应用二进制
5. 烧录应用到外部 Flash `0x70080000`

### 第八步：更新板级 Make.defs

更新 `scripts/Make.defs` 以支持 FSBL 和 XIP 两种模式的链接脚本选择。

## 关键文件参考

| 参考文件 | 用途 |
|---------|------|
| `demo/atk-dnn647-micropython/ports/stm32/boards/ATK_DNN647/board.c` | VDD、PLL、XSPI 初始化代码 |
| `demo/atk-dnn647-micropython/ports/stm32/mboot/stm32_memory_n6.ld` | FSBL 内存布局 |
| `demo/atk-dnn647-micropython/ports/stm32/xspi.c` | XSPI 驱动实现 |
| `demo/atk-dnn647-micropython/lib/stm32lib/CMSIS/STM32N6xx/Source/Templates/system_stm32n6xx_fsbl.c` | FSBL 系统初始化 |
| `demo/atk-dnn647-micropython/lib/stm32lib/CMSIS/STM32N6xx/Source/Templates/gcc/startup_stm32n647xx_fsbl.s` | FSBL 启动汇编 |
| `demo/atk-dnn647-micropython/ports/stm32/mboot/Makefile:254-256` | FSBL 签名命令 |

## 验证方法

1. **构建验证**：`make -C nuttx distclean && make -C nuttx boards/arm/stm32n6/atk-dnn647/configs/fsbl`
2. **签名验证**：检查 `firmware-trusted.bin` 生成成功
3. **烧录验证**：使用 STM32_Programmer 烧录后，板子冷启动能进入 NuttX NSH
4. **功能验证**：LED 控制、UART 控制台输出正常

## Context

STM32N647X0 没有内部 Flash，必须从外部 SPI Flash (MX25UM25645G, 32MB) 启动。当前 NuttX 的 atk-dnn647 板级仅支持 DEV 模式（ST-Link 直接加载代码到 SRAM），无法实现冷启动。

参考 `demo/atk-dnn647-micropython` 项目的 mboot（MicroPython bootloader）实现，需要为 NuttX 适配 FSBL，实现以下启动链：

```
Boot ROM → FSBL (0x34180400, SRAM2) → NuttX Application (0x70080000, XIP from external flash)
```

## 实施方案

### 第一步：创建 FSBL 板级目录结构

在 `nuttx/boards/arm/stm32n6/atk-dnn647/` 下创建 `fsbl` 配置目录：

```
nuttx/boards/arm/stm32n6/atk-dnn647/
├── configs/fsbl/defconfig          # FSBL 配置
├── scripts/fsbl.ld                 # FSBL 链接脚本
├── src/fsbl_main.c                 # FSBL 主程序
└── src/Make.defs                   # 更新源文件列表
```

### 第二步：创建 FSBL 链接脚本

文件：`scripts/fsbl.ld`

参考 MicroPython 的 `stm32_memory_n6.ld`，定义内存区域：
- `FLASH_BL`: `0x34180400`, 31744 字节（FSBL 代码区）
- `RAM`: `0x341e0000`, 128K（FSBL 运行时数据区）

### 第三步：创建 FSBL 主程序

文件：`src/fsbl_main.c`

FSBL 需要完成以下初始化工作（参考 MicroPython `board.c` 的 `mboot_board_early_init()`）：

1. **VDD 配置**：
   - 使能 PWR、BSEC、SYSCFG 时钟
   - 配置 VDDIO2 (3.3V)、VDDIO3 (1.8V)、VDDIO4 (3.3V)
   - 配置 VDD ADC 和 USB
   - I/O 补偿使能

2. **电源配置**：
   - 配置 SMPS 供电
   - 设置电压调节器为 SCALE0

3. **XSPI Flash 初始化**：
   - 配置 XSPI2 引脚（PN0-PN12, AF9）
   - 初始化 XSPI2 外设（Macronix 模式）
   - 切换到 DTR 模式
   - 使能内存映射模式（XIP 基地址 0x70000000）

4. **跳转到应用**：
   - 验证 APPLICATION_ADDR 处的有效性
   - 设置 MSP 和 VTOR
   - 跳转到应用的 Reset_Handler

### 第四步：创建 FSBL defconfig

文件：`configs/fsbl/defconfig`

关键配置项：
```
CONFIG_ARCH="arm"
CONFIG_ARCH_ARMV8M=y
CONFIG_ARCH_BOARD="atk-dnn647"
CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP="stm32n6"
CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP_STM32N647X0=y
CONFIG_RAM_START=0x34180400
CONFIG_RAM_SIZE=31744
CONFIG_FSBL=y
CONFIG_STM32N6_FSBL=y
```

### 第五步：创建 NuttX 应用链接脚本（XIP 模式）

文件：`scripts/flash_xip.ld`

定义内存区域：
- `FLASH_APP`: `0x70080000`（应用代码 XIP 区域）
- `RAM`: `0x34000400`（运行时数据区）

### 第六步：创建应用 defconfig（XIP 模式）

文件：`configs/nsh_xip/defconfig`

基于现有 `nsh` 配置，修改：
- `CONFIG_RAM_START=0x34000400`
- 添加 XIP 相关配置

### 第七步：创建构建和烧录脚本

文件：`tools/flash_dnn647.sh`

脚本流程：
1. 构建 FSBL 二进制
2. 使用 STM32_SigningTool 签名 FSBL（`-t fsbl`）
3. 烧录 FSBL 到外部 Flash `0x70000000`
4. 构建 NuttX 应用二进制
5. 烧录应用到外部 Flash `0x70080000`

### 第八步：更新板级 Make.defs

更新 `scripts/Make.defs` 以支持 FSBL 和 XIP 两种模式的链接脚本选择。

## 关键文件参考

| 参考文件 | 用途 |
|---------|------|
| `demo/atk-dnn647-micropython/ports/stm32/boards/ATK_DNN647/board.c` | VDD、PLL、XSPI 初始化代码 |
| `demo/atk-dnn647-micropython/ports/stm32/mboot/stm32_memory_n6.ld` | FSBL 内存布局 |
| `demo/atk-dnn647-micropython/ports/stm32/xspi.c` | XSPI 驱动实现 |
| `demo/atk-dnn647-micropython/lib/stm32lib/CMSIS/STM32N6xx/Source/Templates/system_stm32n6xx_fsbl.c` | FSBL 系统初始化 |
| `demo/atk-dnn647-micropython/lib/stm32lib/CMSIS/STM32N6xx/Source/Templates/gcc/startup_stm32n647xx_fsbl.s` | FSBL 启动汇编 |
| `demo/atk-dnn647-micropython/ports/stm32/mboot/Makefile:254-256` | FSBL 签名命令 |

## 验证方法

1. **构建验证**：`make -C nuttx distclean && make -C nuttx boards/arm/stm32n6/atk-dnn647/configs/fsbl`
2. **签名验证**：检查 `firmware-trusted.bin` 生成成功
3. **烧录验证**：使用 STM32_Programmer 烧录后，板子冷启动能进入 NuttX NSH
4. **功能验证**：LED 控制、UART 控制台输出正常

comment "STM32N6 Configuration Options"

	bool
	default y
	select STM32_HAVE_USART1

config STM32_STM32N6XXXX
	bool
	default y

choice
	prompt "STM32 N6 Chip Selection"
	default ARCH_CHIP_STM32N657X0
	depends on ARCH_CHIP_STM32N6

config ARCH_CHIP_STM32N657X0
	bool "STM32N657X0"
	select STM32_STM32N6XXXX

config ARCH_CHIP_STM32N647X0
	bool "STM32N647X0"
	select STM32_STM32N6XXXX

endchoice

endif # ARCH_CHIP_STM32N6

#
# FSBL (First Stage Boot Loader) configuration for ATK-DNN647 board.
#
# This is a minimal configuration for the FSBL that initializes
# VDD voltage domains and XSPI flash, then jumps to the application.
#

CONFIG_ARCH="arm"
CONFIG_ARCH_ARMV8M=y
CONFIG_ARCH_BOARD="atk-dnn647"
CONFIG_ARCH_BOARD_ATK_DNN647=y
CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP="stm32n6"
CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP_STM32=y
CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP_STM32N647X0=y
CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP_STM32N6=y
CONFIG_ARCH_INTERRUPTSTACK=2048
CONFIG_ARCH_STACKDUMP=y
CONFIG_ARCH_TOOLCHAIN_GCC=y
CONFIG_ARM_TOOLCHAIN_GNU_EABI=y

# FSBL runs from SRAM2 at 0x34180400
CONFIG_RAM_START=0x34180400
CONFIG_RAM_SIZE=31744

# FSBL mode - no OS features needed
CONFIG_BOARD_LATE_INITIALIZE=n
CONFIG_BOARDCTL=n
CONFIG_BUILTIN=y
CONFIG_DEBUG_ASSERTIONS=y
CONFIG_DEBUG_FEATURES=y
CONFIG_DEBUG_SYMBOLS=y

# Minimal filesystem support
CONFIG_FS_LOCK_BUCKET_SIZE=0
CONFIG_FS_MQUEUE_VFS_PATH="/var/mqueue"
CONFIG_FS_NEPOLL_DESCRIPTORS=0
CONFIG_NAME_MAX=32

# Minimal memory management
CONFIG_MM_NODE_GUARDSIZE=0

# FSBL entry point
CONFIG_INIT_ENTRYPOINT="fsbl_main"

# Stack size for FSBL
CONFIG_IDLETHREAD_STACKSIZE=2048

# Single CPU
CONFIG_NCPUS=1

# Minimal file descriptors
CONFIG_NFILE_DESCRIPTORS=0

# No console needed for FSBL
CONFIG_NSH_ARCHINIT=n

# No serial console
CONFIG_USART1_SERIAL_CONSOLE=n

# No timer ISR needed
CONFIG_STM32_USART1=n

# Minimal scheduling
CONFIG_PREALLOC_TIMERS=0

# Binary output
CONFIG_RAW_BINARY=y

# FSBL specific
CONFIG_FSBL=y

#!/bin/bash
##############################################################################
# boards/arm/stm32n6/atk-dnn647/tools/flash_dnn647.sh
#
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
#
# Build and flash script for ATK-DNN647 board with FSBL support.
#
# This script builds both the FSBL and the NuttX application, then
# provides instructions for flashing them to the external SPI flash.
#
# External Flash Layout (MX25UM25645G, 32MB):
#   0x70000000 - 0x7007FFFF : FSBL (512K, includes boot header)
#   0x70080000 - 0x70FFFFFF : NuttX Application (XIP)
#
##############################################################################

set -e

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
BOARD_DIR="$(dirname "$(dirname "$SCRIPT_DIR")")"
NUTTX_DIR="$(dirname "$(dirname "$(dirname "$(dirname "$BOARD_DIR")")")")"

# Default values
BUILD_FSBL=1
BUILD_APP=1
FLASH_FSBL=0
FLASH_APP=0
STM32_CUBE_PROGRAMMER="${STM32_CUBE_PROGRAMMER:-/opt/st/stm32cubeide_1.17.0/plugins/com.st.stm32cube.ide.mcu.externaltools.cubeprogrammer.linux64_2.2.100.202410251130}"

# Colors for output
RED='\033[0;31m'
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
NC='\033[0m' # No Color

print_info() {
    echo -e "${GREEN}[INFO]${NC} $1"
}

print_warn() {
    echo -e "${YELLOW}[WARN]${NC} $1"
}

print_error() {
    echo -e "${RED}[ERROR]${NC} $1"
}

usage() {
    cat << EOF
Usage: $(basename "$0") [OPTIONS]

Build and flash ATK-DNN647 with FSBL support.

Options:
    --fsbl-only       Build FSBL only
    --app-only        Build application only
    --flash-fsbl      Flash FSBL to external flash
    --flash-app       Flash application to external flash
    --flash-all       Flash both FSBL and application
    --clean           Clean build directories before building
    --help            Show this help message

Environment Variables:
    STM32_CUBE_PROGRAMMER  Path to STM32 Cube Programmer (default: /opt/st/stm32cubeide_.../)

Examples:
    # Build both FSBL and application
    $(basename "$0")

    # Build and flash everything
    $(basename "$0") --flash-all

    # Build FSBL only and flash it
    $(basename "$0") --fsbl-only --flash-fsbl
EOF
}

clean_build() {
    print_info "Cleaning build directories..."
    cd "$NUTTX_DIR"
    make distclean 2>/dev/null || true
    cd -
}

build_fsbl() {
    print_info "Building FSBL..."
    cd "$NUTTX_DIR"

    # Configure for FSBL

#!/bin/bash
##############################################################################
# boards/arm/stm32n6/atk-dnn647/tools/flash_dnn647.sh
#
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
#
# Build and flash script for ATK-DNN647 board with FSBL support.
#
# This script builds both the FSBL and the NuttX application, then
# provides instructions for flashing them to the external SPI flash.
#
# External Flash Layout (MX25UM25645G, 32MB):
#   0x70000000 - 0x7007FFFF : FSBL (512K, includes boot header)
#   0x70080000 - 0x70FFFFFF : NuttX Application (XIP)
#
##############################################################################

set -e

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
BOARD_DIR="$(dirname "$(dirname "$SCRIPT_DIR")")"
NUTTX_DIR="$(dirname "$(dirname "$(dirname "$(dirname "$BOARD_DIR")")")")"

# Default values
BUILD_FSBL=1
BUILD_APP=1
FLASH_FSBL=0
FLASH_APP=0
STM32_CUBE_PROGRAMMER="${STM32_CUBE_PROGRAMMER:-/opt/st/stm32cubeide_1.17.0/plugins/com.st.stm32cube.ide.mcu.externaltools.cubeprogrammer.linux64_2.2.100.202410251130}"

# Colors for output
RED='\033[0;31m'
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
NC='\033[0m' # No Color

print_info() {
    echo -e "${GREEN}[INFO]${NC} $1"
}

print_warn() {
    echo -e "${YELLOW}[WARN]${NC} $1"
}

print_error() {
    echo -e "${RED}[ERROR]${NC} $1"
}

usage() {
    cat << EOF
Usage: $(basename "$0") [OPTIONS]

Build and flash ATK-DNN647 with FSBL support.

Options:
    --fsbl-only       Build FSBL only
    --app-only        Build application only
    --flash-fsbl      Flash FSBL to external flash
    --flash-app       Flash application to external flash
    --flash-all       Flash both FSBL and application
    --clean           Clean build directories before building
    --help            Show this help message

Environment Variables:
    STM32_CUBE_PROGRAMMER  Path to STM32 Cube Programmer (default: /opt/st/stm32cubeide_.../)

Examples:
    # Build both FSBL and application
    $(basename "$0")

    # Build and flash everything
    $(basename "$0") --flash-all

    # Build FSBL only and flash it
    $(basename "$0") --fsbl-only --flash-fsbl
EOF
}

clean_build() {
    print_info "Cleaning build directories..."
    cd "$NUTTX_DIR"
    make distclean 2>/dev/null || true
    cd -
}

build_fsbl() {
    print_info "Building FSBL..."
    cd "$NUTTX_DIR"

    # Configure for FSBL
    tools/configure.sh atk-dnn647:fsbl

    # Build
    make -j$(nproc)

    # Copy output
    cp nuttx.bin "$BOARD_DIR/build/fsbl.bin"
    cp nuttx "$BOARD_DIR/build/fsbl.elf"

    print_info "FSBL built successfully: $BOARD_DIR/build/fsbl.bin"

#!/bin/bash
##############################################################################
# boards/arm/stm32n6/atk-dnn647/tools/flash_dnn647.sh
#
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
#
# Build and flash script for ATK-DNN647 board with FSBL support.
#
# This script builds both the FSBL and the NuttX application, then
# provides instructions for flashing them to the external SPI flash.
#
# External Flash Layout (MX25UM25645G, 32MB):
#   0x70000000 - 0x7007FFFF : FSBL (512K, includes boot header)
#   0x70080000 - 0x70FFFFFF : NuttX Application (XIP)
#
##############################################################################

set -e

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
BOARD_DIR="$(dirname "$(dirname "$SCRIPT_DIR")")"
NUTTX_DIR="$(dirname "$(dirname "$(dirname "$(dirname "$BOARD_DIR")")")")"

# Default values
BUILD_FSBL=1
BUILD_APP=1
FLASH_FSBL=0
FLASH_APP=0
STM32_CUBE_PROGRAMMER="${STM32_CUBE_PROGRAMMER:-/opt/st/stm32cubeide_1.17.0/plugins/com.st.stm32cube.ide.mcu.externaltools.cubeprogrammer.linux64_2.2.100.202410251130}"

# Colors for output
RED='\033[0;31m'
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
NC='\033[0m' # No Color

print_info() {
    echo -e "${GREEN}[INFO]${NC} $1"
}

print_warn() {
    echo -e "${YELLOW}[WARN]${NC} $1"
}

print_error() {
    echo -e "${RED}[ERROR]${NC} $1"
}

usage() {
    cat << EOF
Usage: $(basename "$0") [OPTIONS]

Build and flash ATK-DNN647 with FSBL support.

Options:
    --fsbl-only       Build FSBL only
    --app-only        Build application only
    --flash-fsbl      Flash FSBL to external flash
    --flash-app       Flash application to external flash
    --flash-all       Flash both FSBL and application
    --clean           Clean build directories before building
    --help            Show this help message

Environment Variables:
    STM32_CUBE_PROGRAMMER  Path to STM32 Cube Programmer (default: /opt/st/stm32cubeide_.../)

Examples:
    # Build both FSBL and application
    $(basename "$0")

    # Build and flash everything
    $(basename "$0") --flash-all

    # Build FSBL only and flash it
    $(basename "$0") --fsbl-only --flash-fsbl
EOF
}

clean_build() {
    print_info "Cleaning build directories..."
    cd "$NUTTX_DIR"
    make distclean 2>/dev/null || true
    cd -
}

build_fsbl() {
    print_info "Building FSBL..."
    cd "$NUTTX_DIR"

    # Configure for FSBL
    tools/configure.sh atk-dnn647:fsbl

    # Build
    make -j$(nproc)

    # Copy output
    cp nuttx.bin "$BOARD_DIR/build/fsbl.bin"
    cp nuttx "$BOARD_DIR/build/fsbl.elf"

    print_info "FSBL built successfully: $BOARD_DIR/build/fsbl.bin"

    # Clean for next build
    make distclean

    cd -
}

build_app() {
    print_info "Building NuttX application (XIP mode)..."
    cd "$NUTTX_DIR"

    # Configure for XIP
    tools/configure.sh atk-dnn647:nsh_xip

    # Build
    make -j$(nproc)

    # Copy output
    cp nuttx.bin "$BOARD_DIR/build/nuttx_xip.bin"
    cp nuttx "$BOARD_DIR/build/nuttx_xip.elf"

    print_info "Application built successfully: $BOARD_DIR/build/nuttx_xip.bin"

    # Clean for next build
    make distclean

    cd -
}

sign_fsbl() {
    print_info "Signing FSBL binary..."

    local fsbl_bin="$BOARD_DIR/build/fsbl.bin"
    local fsbl_signed="$BOARD_DIR/build/fsbl_signed.bin"

    if [ ! -f "$fsbl_bin" ]; then
        print_error "FSBL binary not found: $fsbl_bin"
        exit 1
    fi

    # Use STM32_SigningTool to create signed binary
    # Header version 2.3, FSBL type, no encryption
    "$STM32_CUBE_PROGRAMMER/bin/STM32_SigningTool_CLI" \
        -bin "$fsbl_bin" \
        -nk \
        -of 0x80000000 \
        -t fsbl \
        -o "$fsbl_signed" \
        -hv 2.3 \
        --align

    print_info "Signed FSBL: $fsbl_signed"
}

flash_fsbl() {
    print_info "Flashing FSBL to external flash at 0x70000000..."

    local fsbl_signed="$BOARD_DIR/build/fsbl_signed.bin"

    if [ ! -f "$fsbl_signed" ]; then
        print_error "Signed FSBL not found: $fsbl_signed"
        print_info "Run with --fsbl-only first to build and sign the FSBL"
        exit 1
    fi

    # Flash using STM32_Programmer
    "$STM32_CUBE_PROGRAMMER/bin/STM32_Programmer.sh" \
        -c port=SWD mode=HOTPLUG ap=1 \
        -el "$STM32_CUBE_PROGRAMMER/bin/ExternalLoader/MX25UM25645G_ATK-CNN647B_ExtMemLoader.stldr" \
        -w "$fsbl_signed" 0x70000000 \
        -hardRst

    print_info "FSBL flashed successfully"
}

flash_app() {
    print_info "Flashing application to external flash at 0x70080000..."

    local app_bin="$BOARD_DIR/build/nuttx_xip.bin"

    if [ ! -f "$app_bin" ]; then
        print_error "Application binary not found: $app_bin"
        print_info "Run with --app-only first to build the application"
        exit 1
    fi

    # Flash using STM32_Programmer
    "$STM32_CUBE_PROGRAMMER/bin/STM32_Programmer.sh" \
        -c port=SWD mode=HOTPLUG ap=1 \
        -el "$STM32_CUBE_PROGRAMMER/bin/ExternalLoader/MX25UM25645G_ATK-CNN647B_ExtMemLoader.stldr" \
        -w "$app_bin" 0x70080000 \
        -hardRst

    print_info "Application flashed successfully"
}

# Parse command line arguments
while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    case $1 in
        --fsbl-only)
            BUILD_APP=0
            shift
            ;;
        --app-only)
            BUILD_FSBL=0
            shift
            ;;
        --flash-fsbl)
            FLASH_FSBL=1
            shift
            ;;
        --flash-app)
            FLASH_APP=1
            shift
            ;;
        --flash-all)
            FLASH_FSBL=1
            FLASH_APP=1
            shift
            ;;
        --clean)
            clean_build
            shift
            ;;
        --help)
            usage
            exit 0
            ;;
        *)
            print_error "Unknown option: $1"
            usage
            exit 1
            ;;
    esac
done

# Create build directory
mkdir -p "$BOARD_DIR/build"

# Build FSBL
if [ "$BUILD_FSBL" -eq 1 ]; then
    build_fsbl
    sign_fsbl
fi

# Build application
if [ "$BUILD_APP" -eq 1 ]; then
    build_app
fi

# Flash FSBL
if [ "$FLASH_FSBL" -eq 1 ]; then
    flash_fsbl
fi

# Flash application
if [ "$FLASH_APP" -eq 1 ]; then
    flash_app
fi

print_info "Done!"
echo ""
echo "================================================================"
echo "  ATK-DNN647 Flash Layout:"
echo "================================================================"
echo "  0x70000000 : FSBL (signed)"
echo "  0x70080000 : NuttX Application (XIP)"
echo "================================================================"
echo ""
echo "To flash manually:"
echo "  1. Flash FSBL:     $(basename "$0") --flash-fsbl"
echo "  2. Flash App:      $(basename "$0") --flash-app"
echo "  3. Power cycle the board to boot"
echo ""

#!/bin/bash
##############################################################################
# boards/arm/stm32n6/atk-dnn647/tools/flash_dnn647.sh
#
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
#
# Build and flash script for ATK-DNN647 board with FSBL support.
#
# This script builds both the FSBL and the NuttX application, then
# provides instructions for flashing them to the external SPI flash.
#
# External Flash Layout (MX25UM25645G, 32MB):
#   0x70000000 - 0x7007FFFF : FSBL (512K, includes boot header)
#   0x70080000 - 0x70FFFFFF : NuttX Application (XIP)
#
##############################################################################

set -e

# Script is at: nuttx/boards/arm/stm32n6/atk-dnn647/tools/flash_dnn647.sh
# BOARD_DIR is: nuttx/boards/arm/stm32n6/atk-dnn647
# NUTTX_DIR is: nuttx

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
BOARD_DIR="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/.." && pwd)"
NUTTX_DIR="$(cd "$BOARD_DIR/../../../../.." && pwd)"

# Default values
BUILD_FSBL=1
BUILD_APP=1
FLASH_FSBL=0
FLASH_APP=0
STM32_CUBE_PROGRAMMER="${STM32_CUBE_PROGRAMMER:-/opt/st/stm32cubeide_1.17.0/plugins/com.st.stm32cube.ide.mcu.externaltools.cubeprogrammer.linux64_2.2.100.202410251130}"

# Colors for output
RED='\033[0;31m'
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
NC='\033[0m' # No Color

print_info() {
    echo -e "${GREEN}[INFO]${NC} $1"
}

print_warn() {
    echo -e "${YELLOW}[WARN]${NC} $1"
}

print_error() {
    echo -e "${RED}[ERROR]${NC} $1"
}

usage() {
    cat << EOF
Usage: $(basename "$0") [OPTIONS]

Build and flash ATK-DNN647 with FSBL support.

Options:
    --fsbl-only       Build FSBL only
    --app-only        Build application only
    --flash-fsbl      Flash FSBL to external flash
    --flash-app       Flash application to external flash
    --flash-all       Flash both FSBL and application
    --clean           Clean build directories before building
    --help            Show this help message

Environment Variables:
    STM32_CUBE_PROGRAMMER  Path to STM32 Cube Programmer (default: /opt/st/stm32cubeide_.../)

Examples:
    # Build both FSBL and application
    $(basename "$0")

    # Build and flash everything
    $(basename "$0") --flash-all

    # Build FSBL only and flash it
    $(basename "$0") --fsbl-only --flash-fsbl
EOF
}

clean_build() {
    print_info "Cleaning build directories..."
    cd "$NUTTX_DIR"
    make distclean 2>/dev/null || true
    cd -
}

build_fsbl() {
    print_info "Building FSBL..."
    cd "$NUTTX_DIR"

    # Configure for FSBL
    tools/configure.sh atk-dnn647:fsbl

    # Build
    make -j$(nproc)

    # Copy output
    cp nuttx.bin "$BOARD_DIR/build/fsbl.bin"
    cp nuttx "$BOARD_DIR/build/fsbl.elf"

    print_info "FSBL built successfully: $BOARD_DIR/build/fsbl.bin"

    # Clean for next build
    make distclean

    cd -
}

build_app() {
    print_info "Building NuttX application (XIP mode)..."
    cd "$NUTTX_DIR"

    # Configure for XIP
    tools/configure.sh atk-dnn647:nsh_xip

    # Build
    make -j$(nproc)

    # Copy output
    cp nuttx.bin "$BOARD_DIR/build/nuttx_xip.bin"
    cp nuttx "$BOARD_DIR/build/nuttx_xip.elf"

    print_info "Application built successfully: $BOARD_DIR/build/nuttx_xip.bin"

    # Clean for next build
    make distclean

    cd -
}

sign_fsbl() {
    print_info "Signing FSBL binary..."

    local fsbl_bin="$BOARD_DIR/build/fsbl.bin"
    local fsbl_signed="$BOARD_DIR/build/fsbl_signed.bin"

    if [ ! -f "$fsbl_bin" ]; then
        print_error "FSBL binary not found: $fsbl_bin"
        exit 1
    fi

    # Use STM32_SigningTool to create signed binary
    # Header version 2.3, FSBL type, no encryption
    "$STM32_CUBE_PROGRAMMER/bin/STM32_SigningTool_CLI" \
        -bin "$fsbl_bin" \
        -nk \
        -of 0x80000000 \
        -t fsbl \
        -o "$fsbl_signed" \
        -hv 2.3 \
        --align

    print_info "Signed FSBL: $fsbl_signed"
}

flash_fsbl() {
    print_info "Flashing FSBL to external flash at 0x70000000..."

    local fsbl_signed="$BOARD_DIR/build/fsbl_signed.bin"

    if [ ! -f "$fsbl_signed" ]; then
        print_error "Signed FSBL not found: $fsbl_signed"
        print_info "Run with --fsbl-only first to build and sign the FSBL"
        exit 1
    fi

    # Flash using STM32_Programmer
    "$STM32_CUBE_PROGRAMMER/bin/STM32_Programmer.sh" \
        -c port=SWD mode=HOTPLUG ap=1 \
        -el "$STM32_CUBE_PROGRAMMER/bin/ExternalLoader/MX25UM25645G_ATK-CNN647B_ExtMemLoader.stldr" \
        -w "$fsbl_signed" 0x70000000 \
        -hardRst

    print_info "FSBL flashed successfully"
}

flash_app() {
    print_info "Flashing application to external flash at 0x70080000..."

    local app_bin="$BOARD_DIR/build/nuttx_xip.bin"

    if [ ! -f "$app_bin" ]; then
        print_error "Application binary not found: $app_bin"
        print_info "Run with --app-only first to build the application"
        exit 1
    fi

    # Flash using STM32_Programmer
    "$STM32_CUBE_PROGRAMMER/bin/STM32_Programmer.sh" \
        -c port=SWD mode=HOTPLUG ap=1 \
        -el "$STM32_CUBE_PROGRAMMER/bin/ExternalLoader/MX25UM25645G_ATK-CNN647B_ExtMemLoader.stldr" \
        -w "$app_bin" 0x70080000 \
        -hardRst

    print_info "Application flashed successfully"
}

# Parse command line arguments
while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    case $1 in
        --fsbl-only)
            BUILD_APP=0
            shift
            ;;
        --app-only)
            BUILD_FSBL=0
            shift
            ;;
        --flash-fsbl)
            FLASH_FSBL=1
            shift
            ;;
        --flash-app)
            FLASH_APP=1
            shift
            ;;
        --flash-all)
            FLASH_FSBL=1
            FLASH_APP=1
            shift
            ;;
        --clean)
            clean_build
            shift
            ;;
        --help)
            usage
            exit 0
            ;;
        *)
            print_error "Unknown option: $1"
            usage
            exit 1
            ;;
    esac
done

# Create build directory
mkdir -p "$BOARD_DIR/build"

# Build FSBL
if [ "$BUILD_FSBL" -eq 1 ]; then
    build_fsbl
    sign_fsbl
fi

# Build application
if [ "$BUILD_APP" -eq 1 ]; then
    build_app
fi

# Flash FSBL
if [ "$FLASH_FSBL" -eq 1 ]; then
    flash_fsbl
fi

# Flash application
if [ "$FLASH_APP" -eq 1 ]; then
    flash_app
fi

print_info "Done!"
echo ""
echo "================================================================"
echo "  ATK-DNN647 Flash Layout:"
echo "================================================================"
echo "  0x70000000 : FSBL (signed)"
echo "  0x70080000 : NuttX Application (XIP)"
echo "================================================================"
echo ""
echo "To flash manually:"
echo "  1. Flash FSBL:     $(basename "$0") --flash-fsbl"
echo "  2. Flash App:      $(basename "$0") --flash-app"
echo "  3. Power cycle the board to boot"
echo ""

#!/bin/bash
##############################################################################
# boards/arm/stm32n6/atk-dnn647/tools/flash_dnn647.sh
#
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
#
# Build and flash script for ATK-DNN647 board with FSBL support.
#
# This script builds both the FSBL and the NuttX application, then
# provides instructions for flashing them to the external SPI flash.
#
# External Flash Layout (MX25UM25645G, 32MB):
#   0x70000000 - 0x7007FFFF : FSBL (512K, includes boot header)
#   0x70080000 - 0x70FFFFFF : NuttX Application (XIP)
#
##############################################################################

set -e

# Script is at: nuttx/boards/arm/stm32n6/atk-dnn647/tools/flash_dnn647.sh
# BOARD_DIR is: nuttx/boards/arm/stm32n6/atk-dnn647
# NUTTX_DIR is: nuttx

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
BOARD_DIR="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/.." && pwd)"
NUTTX_DIR="$(cd "$BOARD_DIR/../../../.." && pwd)"

# Default values
BUILD_FSBL=1
BUILD_APP=1
FLASH_FSBL=0
FLASH_APP=0
STM32_CUBE_PROGRAMMER="${STM32_CUBE_PROGRAMMER:-/opt/st/stm32cubeide_1.17.0/plugins/com.st.stm32cube.ide.mcu.externaltools.cubeprogrammer.linux64_2.2.100.202410251130}"

# Colors for output
RED='\033[0;31m'
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
NC='\033[0m' # No Color

print_info() {
    echo -e "${GREEN}[INFO]${NC} $1"
}

print_warn() {
    echo -e "${YELLOW}[WARN]${NC} $1"
}

print_error() {
    echo -e "${RED}[ERROR]${NC} $1"
}

usage() {
    cat << EOF
Usage: $(basename "$0") [OPTIONS]

Build and flash ATK-DNN647 with FSBL support.

Options:
    --fsbl-only       Build FSBL only
    --app-only        Build application only
    --flash-fsbl      Flash FSBL to external flash
    --flash-app       Flash application to external flash
    --flash-all       Flash both FSBL and application
    --clean           Clean build directories before building
    --help            Show this help message

Environment Variables:
    STM32_CUBE_PROGRAMMER  Path to STM32 Cube Programmer (default: /opt/st/stm32cubeide_.../)

Examples:
    # Build both FSBL and application
    $(basename "$0")

    # Build and flash everything
    $(basename "$0") --flash-all

    # Build FSBL only and flash it
    $(basename "$0") --fsbl-only --flash-fsbl
EOF
}

clean_build() {
    print_info "Cleaning build directories..."
    cd "$NUTTX_DIR"
    make distclean 2>/dev/null || true
    cd -
}

build_fsbl() {
    print_info "Building FSBL..."
    cd "$NUTTX_DIR"

    # Configure for FSBL
    tools/configure.sh atk-dnn647:fsbl

    # Build
    make -j$(nproc)

    # Copy output
    cp nuttx.bin "$BOARD_DIR/build/fsbl.bin"
    cp nuttx "$BOARD_DIR/build/fsbl.elf"

    print_info "FSBL built successfully: $BOARD_DIR/build/fsbl.bin"

    # Clean for next build
    make distclean

    cd -
}

build_app() {
    print_info "Building NuttX application (XIP mode)..."
    cd "$NUTTX_DIR"

    # Configure for XIP
    tools/configure.sh atk-dnn647:nsh_xip

    # Build
    make -j$(nproc)

    # Copy output
    cp nuttx.bin "$BOARD_DIR/build/nuttx_xip.bin"
    cp nuttx "$BOARD_DIR/build/nuttx_xip.elf"

    print_info "Application built successfully: $BOARD_DIR/build/nuttx_xip.bin"

    # Clean for next build
    make distclean

    cd -
}

sign_fsbl() {
    print_info "Signing FSBL binary..."

    local fsbl_bin="$BOARD_DIR/build/fsbl.bin"
    local fsbl_signed="$BOARD_DIR/build/fsbl_signed.bin"

    if [ ! -f "$fsbl_bin" ]; then
        print_error "FSBL binary not found: $fsbl_bin"
        exit 1
    fi

    # Use STM32_SigningTool to create signed binary
    # Header version 2.3, FSBL type, no encryption
    "$STM32_CUBE_PROGRAMMER/bin/STM32_SigningTool_CLI" \
        -bin "$fsbl_bin" \
        -nk \
        -of 0x80000000 \
        -t fsbl \
        -o "$fsbl_signed" \
        -hv 2.3 \
        --align

    print_info "Signed FSBL: $fsbl_signed"
}

flash_fsbl() {
    print_info "Flashing FSBL to external flash at 0x70000000..."

    local fsbl_signed="$BOARD_DIR/build/fsbl_signed.bin"

    if [ ! -f "$fsbl_signed" ]; then
        print_error "Signed FSBL not found: $fsbl_signed"
        print_info "Run with --fsbl-only first to build and sign the FSBL"
        exit 1
    fi

    # Flash using STM32_Programmer
    "$STM32_CUBE_PROGRAMMER/bin/STM32_Programmer.sh" \
        -c port=SWD mode=HOTPLUG ap=1 \
        -el "$STM32_CUBE_PROGRAMMER/bin/ExternalLoader/MX25UM25645G_ATK-CNN647B_ExtMemLoader.stldr" \
        -w "$fsbl_signed" 0x70000000 \
        -hardRst

    print_info "FSBL flashed successfully"
}

flash_app() {
    print_info "Flashing application to external flash at 0x70080000..."

    local app_bin="$BOARD_DIR/build/nuttx_xip.bin"

    if [ ! -f "$app_bin" ]; then
        print_error "Application binary not found: $app_bin"
        print_info "Run with --app-only first to build the application"
        exit 1
    fi

    # Flash using STM32_Programmer
    "$STM32_CUBE_PROGRAMMER/bin/STM32_Programmer.sh" \
        -c port=SWD mode=HOTPLUG ap=1 \
        -el "$STM32_CUBE_PROGRAMMER/bin/ExternalLoader/MX25UM25645G_ATK-CNN647B_ExtMemLoader.stldr" \
        -w "$app_bin" 0x70080000 \
        -hardRst

    print_info "Application flashed successfully"
}

# Parse command line arguments
while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    case $1 in
        --fsbl-only)
            BUILD_APP=0
            shift
            ;;
        --app-only)
            BUILD_FSBL=0
            shift
            ;;
        --flash-fsbl)
            FLASH_FSBL=1
            shift
            ;;
        --flash-app)
            FLASH_APP=1
            shift
            ;;
        --flash-all)
            FLASH_FSBL=1
            FLASH_APP=1
            shift
            ;;
        --clean)
            clean_build
            shift
            ;;
        --help)
            usage
            exit 0
            ;;
        *)
            print_error "Unknown option: $1"
            usage
            exit 1
            ;;
    esac
done

# Create build directory
mkdir -p "$BOARD_DIR/build"

# Build FSBL
if [ "$BUILD_FSBL" -eq 1 ]; then
    build_fsbl
    sign_fsbl
fi

# Build application
if [ "$BUILD_APP" -eq 1 ]; then
    build_app
fi

# Flash FSBL
if [ "$FLASH_FSBL" -eq 1 ]; then
    flash_fsbl
fi

# Flash application
if [ "$FLASH_APP" -eq 1 ]; then
    flash_app
fi

print_info "Done!"
echo ""
echo "================================================================"
echo "  ATK-DNN647 Flash Layout:"
echo "================================================================"
echo "  0x70000000 : FSBL (signed)"
echo "  0x70080000 : NuttX Application (XIP)"
echo "================================================================"
echo ""
echo "To flash manually:"
echo "  1. Flash FSBL:     $(basename "$0") --flash-fsbl"
echo "  2. Flash App:      $(basename "$0") --flash-app"
echo "  3. Power cycle the board to boot"
echo ""

#   - flash_xip.ld: Application runs from external flash via XIP at 0x70080000

ifdef CONFIG_FSBL
ARCHSCRIPT += $(BOARD_DIR)$(DELIM)scripts$(DELIM)fsbl.ld
else ifdef CONFIG_STM32N6_XIP
ARCHSCRIPT += $(BOARD_DIR)$(DELIM)scripts$(DELIM)flash_xip.ld

ARCHSCRIPT += $(BOARD_DIR)$(DELIM)scripts$(DELIM)flash.ld
endif

CXXFLAGS := $(ARCHCXXFLAGS) $(ARCHOPTIMIZATION) $(ARCHCPUFLAGS) $(ARCHXXINCLUDES) $(ARCHDEFINES) $(EXTRAFLAGS)
CPPFLAGS := $(ARCHINCLUDES) $(ARCHDEFINES) $(EXTRAFLAGS)
AFLAGS := $(CFLAGS) -D__ASSEMBLY__

NXFLATLDFLAGS1 = -r -d -warn-common
NXFLATLDFLAGS2 = $(NXFLATLDFLAGS1) -T$(TOPDIR)$(DELIM)binfmt$(DELIM)libnxflat$(DELIM)gnu-nxflat-pcrel.ld -no-check-sections
LDNXFLATFLAGS = -e main -s 2048

# This is a minimal configuration for the FSBL that initializes
# VDD voltage domains and XSPI flash, then jumps to the application.
#

CONFIG_ARCH="arm"

CONFIG_ARCH_BOARD="atk-dnn647"
CONFIG_ARCH_BOARD_ATK_DNN647=y
CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP="stm32n6"
CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP_STM32=y

CONFIG_ARM_TOOLCHAIN_GNU_EABI=y

# FSBL runs from SRAM2 at 0x34180400
CONFIG_RAM_START=0x34180400
CONFIG_RAM_SIZE=31744

CONFIG_BOARD_LATE_INITIALIZE=n

CONFIG_DEBUG_ASSERTIONS=y
CONFIG_DEBUG_FEATURES=y

# For a description of the syntax of this configuration file,
# see the file kconfig-language.txt in the NuttX tools repository.
#

if ARCH_BOARD_ATK_DNN647

config FSBL
	bool "Build FSBL (First Stage Boot Loader)"
	default n
	---help---
		Build the FSBL for the ATK-DNN647 board. The FSBL runs from
		SRAM2 at 0x34180400, initializes VDD voltage domains and
		XSPI flash, then jumps to the application at 0x70080000.

config STM32N6_XIP
	bool "Build application for XIP (Execute-In-Place)"
	default n
	depends on !FSBL
	---help---
		Build the application to run from external flash via XIP
		at 0x70080000. Requires the FSBL to be running first.

endif

#!/bin/bash
##############################################################################
# boards/arm/stm32n6/atk-dnn647/tools/flash_dnn647.sh
#
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
#
# Build and flash script for ATK-DNN647 board with FSBL support.
#
# This script builds both the FSBL and the NuttX application, then
# provides instructions for flashing them to the external SPI flash.
#
# External Flash Layout (MX25UM25645G, 32MB):
#   0x70000000 - 0x7007FFFF : FSBL (512K, includes boot header)
#   0x70080000 - 0x70FFFFFF : NuttX Application (XIP)
#
##############################################################################

set -e

# Script is at: nuttx/boards/arm/stm32n6/atk-dnn647/tools/flash_dnn647.sh
# BOARD_DIR is: nuttx/boards/arm/stm32n6/atk-dnn647
# NUTTX_DIR is: nuttx

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
BOARD_DIR="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/.." && pwd)"
NUTTX_DIR="$(cd "$BOARD_DIR/../../../.." && pwd)"

# Add ARM toolchain to PATH if not already present
ARM_TOOLCHAIN="$NUTTX_DIR/../prebuilts/gcc/linux-x86_64/arm-none-eabi/bin"
if [ -d "$ARM_TOOLCHAIN" ] && [[ ":$PATH:" != *":$ARM_TOOLCHAIN:"* ]]; then
    export PATH="$ARM_TOOLCHAIN:$PATH"
fi

# Default values
BUILD_FSBL=1
BUILD_APP=1
FLASH_FSBL=0
FLASH_APP=0
STM32_CUBE_PROGRAMMER="${STM32_CUBE_PROGRAMMER:-/opt/st/stm32cubeide_1.17.0/plugins/com.st.stm32cube.ide.mcu.externaltools.cubeprogrammer.linux64_2.2.100.202410251130}"

# Colors for output
RED='\033[0;31m'
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
NC='\033[0m' # No Color

print_info() {
    echo -e "${GREEN}[INFO]${NC} $1"
}

print_warn() {
    echo -e "${YELLOW}[WARN]${NC} $1"
}

print_error() {
    echo -e "${RED}[ERROR]${NC} $1"
}

usage() {
    cat << EOF
Usage: $(basename "$0") [OPTIONS]

Build and flash ATK-DNN647 with FSBL support.

Options:
    --fsbl-only       Build FSBL only
    --app-only        Build application only
    --flash-fsbl      Flash FSBL to external flash
    --flash-app       Flash application to external flash
    --flash-all       Flash both FSBL and application
    --clean           Clean build directories before building
    --help            Show this help message

Environment Variables:
    STM32_CUBE_PROGRAMMER  Path to STM32 Cube Programmer (default: /opt/st/stm32cubeide_.../)

Examples:
    # Build both FSBL and application
    $(basename "$0")

    # Build and flash everything
    $(basename "$0") --flash-all

    # Build FSBL only and flash it
    $(basename "$0") --fsbl-only --flash-fsbl
EOF
}

clean_build() {
    print_info "Cleaning build directories..."
    cd "$NUTTX_DIR"
    make distclean 2>/dev/null || true
    cd -
}

build_fsbl() {
    print_info "Building FSBL..."
    cd "$NUTTX_DIR"

    # Configure for FSBL
    tools/configure.sh atk-dnn647:fsbl

    # Build
    make -j$(nproc)

    # Copy output
    cp nuttx.bin "$BOARD_DIR/build/fsbl.bin"
    cp nuttx "$BOARD_DIR/build/fsbl.elf"

    print_info "FSBL built successfully: $BOARD_DIR/build/fsbl.bin"

    # Clean for next build
    make distclean

    cd -
}

build_app() {
    print_info "Building NuttX application (XIP mode)..."
    cd "$NUTTX_DIR"

    # Configure for XIP
    tools/configure.sh atk-dnn647:nsh_xip

    # Build
    make -j$(nproc)

    # Copy output
    cp nuttx.bin "$BOARD_DIR/build/nuttx_xip.bin"
    cp nuttx "$BOARD_DIR/build/nuttx_xip.elf"

    print_info "Application built successfully: $BOARD_DIR/build/nuttx_xip.bin"

    # Clean for next build
    make distclean

    cd -
}

sign_fsbl() {
    print_info "Signing FSBL binary..."

    local fsbl_bin="$BOARD_DIR/build/fsbl.bin"
    local fsbl_signed="$BOARD_DIR/build/fsbl_signed.bin"

    if [ ! -f "$fsbl_bin" ]; then
        print_error "FSBL binary not found: $fsbl_bin"
        exit 1
    fi

    # Use STM32_SigningTool to create signed binary
    # Header version 2.3, FSBL type, no encryption
    "$STM32_CUBE_PROGRAMMER/bin/STM32_SigningTool_CLI" \
        -bin "$fsbl_bin" \
        -nk \
        -of 0x80000000 \
        -t fsbl \
        -o "$fsbl_signed" \
        -hv 2.3 \
        --align

    print_info "Signed FSBL: $fsbl_signed"
}

flash_fsbl() {
    print_info "Flashing FSBL to external flash at 0x70000000..."

    local fsbl_signed="$BOARD_DIR/build/fsbl_signed.bin"

    if [ ! -f "$fsbl_signed" ]; then
        print_error "Signed FSBL not found: $fsbl_signed"
        print_info "Run with --fsbl-only first to build and sign the FSBL"
        exit 1
    fi

    # Flash using STM32_Programmer
    "$STM32_CUBE_PROGRAMMER/bin/STM32_Programmer.sh" \
        -c port=SWD mode=HOTPLUG ap=1 \
        -el "$STM32_CUBE_PROGRAMMER/bin/ExternalLoader/MX25UM25645G_ATK-CNN647B_ExtMemLoader.stldr" \
        -w "$fsbl_signed" 0x70000000 \
        -hardRst

    print_info "FSBL flashed successfully"
}

flash_app() {
    print_info "Flashing application to external flash at 0x70080000..."

    local app_bin="$BOARD_DIR/build/nuttx_xip.bin"

    if [ ! -f "$app_bin" ]; then
        print_error "Application binary not found: $app_bin"
        print_info "Run with --app-only first to build the application"
        exit 1
    fi

    # Flash using STM32_Programmer
    "$STM32_CUBE_PROGRAMMER/bin/STM32_Programmer.sh" \
        -c port=SWD mode=HOTPLUG ap=1 \
        -el "$STM32_CUBE_PROGRAMMER/bin/ExternalLoader/MX25UM25645G_ATK-CNN647B_ExtMemLoader.stldr" \
        -w "$app_bin" 0x70080000 \
        -hardRst

    print_info "Application flashed successfully"
}

# Parse command line arguments
while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    case $1 in
        --fsbl-only)
            BUILD_APP=0
            shift
            ;;
        --app-only)
            BUILD_FSBL=0
            shift
            ;;
        --flash-fsbl)
            FLASH_FSBL=1
            shift
            ;;
        --flash-app)
            FLASH_APP=1
            shift
            ;;
        --flash-all)
            FLASH_FSBL=1
            FLASH_APP=1
            shift
            ;;
        --clean)
            clean_build
            shift
            ;;
        --help)
            usage
            exit 0
            ;;
        *)
            print_error "Unknown option: $1"
            usage
            exit 1
            ;;
    esac
done

# Create build directory
mkdir -p "$BOARD_DIR/build"

# Build FSBL
if [ "$BUILD_FSBL" -eq 1 ]; then
    build_fsbl
    sign_fsbl
fi

# Build application
if [ "$BUILD_APP" -eq 1 ]; then
    build_app
fi

# Flash FSBL
if [ "$FLASH_FSBL" -eq 1 ]; then
    flash_fsbl
fi

# Flash application
if [ "$FLASH_APP" -eq 1 ]; then
    flash_app
fi

print_info "Done!"
echo ""
echo "================================================================"
echo "  ATK-DNN647 Flash Layout:"
echo "================================================================"
echo "  0x70000000 : FSBL (signed)"
echo "  0x70080000 : NuttX Application (XIP)"
echo "================================================================"
echo ""
echo "To flash manually:"
echo "  1. Flash FSBL:     $(basename "$0") --flash-fsbl"
echo "  2. Flash App:      $(basename "$0") --flash-app"
echo "  3. Power cycle the board to boot"
echo ""

set(SRCS stm32_boot.c stm32_bringup.c)

if(CONFIG_ARCH_LEDS)
  list(APPEND SRCS stm32_autoleds.c)
else()
  list(APPEND SRCS stm32_userleds.c)
endif()

# FSBL mode: use fsbl_main.c instead of normal board init

if(CONFIG_FSBL)
  set(SRCS fsbl_main.c)
endif()

target_sources(board PRIVATE ${SRCS})

# Select linker script based on configuration

if(CONFIG_FSBL)
  set_property(GLOBAL PROPERTY LD_SCRIPT "${NUTTX_BOARD_DIR}/scripts/fsbl.ld")
elseif(CONFIG_STM32N6_XIP)
  set_property(GLOBAL PROPERTY LD_SCRIPT "${NUTTX_BOARD_DIR}/scripts/flash_xip.ld")
else()
  set_property(GLOBAL PROPERTY LD_SCRIPT "${NUTTX_BOARD_DIR}/scripts/flash.ld")
endif()

# FSBL (First Stage Boot Loader) configuration for ATK-DNN647 board.

# VDD voltage domains and XSPI flash, then jumps to the application.
#

CONFIG_ARCH_BOARD="atk-dnn647"

#!/bin/bash
# flash_dnn647.sh - Build and flash script for ATK-DNN647 board
#
# This script builds the FSBL and NuttX application, then flashes them
# to the external SPI flash on the DNN647 development board.
#
# Usage: ./flash_dnn647.sh [fsbl|app|all]
#

set -e

# Script directory
SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
BOARD_DIR="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/.." && pwd)"
NUTTX_DIR="$(cd "$BOARD_DIR/../../../.." && pwd)"

# Toolchain path
export PATH="/home/warner/openvela/prebuilts/gcc/linux-x86_64/arm-none-eabi/bin:$PATH"

# Colors for output
RED='\033[0;31m'
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
NC='\033[0m' # No Color

# Flash addresses
FSBL_ADDR=0x70000000
APP_ADDR=0x70080000

log_info() {
    echo -e "${GREEN}[INFO]${NC} $1"
}

log_warn() {
    echo -e "${YELLOW}[WARN]${NC} $1"
}

log_error() {
    echo -e "${RED}[ERROR]${NC} $1"
}

# Build FSBL
build_fsbl() {
    log_info "Building FSBL..."
    cd "$NUTTX_DIR"

    # Clean previous build
    make distclean 2>/dev/null || true

    # Configure for FSBL
    ./tools/configure.sh -l boards/arm/stm32n6/atk-dnn647/configs/fsbl

    # Build
    make -j$(nproc)

    if [ -f nuttx.bin ]; then
        log_info "FSBL built successfully: nuttx.bin ($(wc -c < nuttx.bin) bytes)"
    else
        log_error "FSBL build failed!"
        exit 1
    fi
}

# Build NuttX application (XIP mode)
build_app() {
    log_info "Building NuttX application (XIP mode)..."
    cd "$NUTTX_DIR"

    # Clean previous build
    make distclean 2>/dev/null || true

    # Configure for XIP NSH
    ./tools/configure.sh -l boards/arm/stm32n6/atk-dnn647/configs/nsh_xip

    # Build
    make -j$(nproc)

    if [ -f nuttx.bin ]; then
        log_info "Application built successfully: nuttx.bin ($(wc -c < nuttx.bin) bytes)"
    else
        log_error "Application build failed!"
        exit 1
    fi
}

# Flash FSBL using STM32_Programmer_CLI
flash_fsbl() {
    log_info "Flashing FSBL to 0x70000000..."

    if [ ! -f "$NUTTX_DIR/nuttx.bin" ]; then
        log_error "FSBL binary not found. Build first."
        exit 1
    fi

    # Sign the FSBL binary for boot ROM
    # Note: STM32_SigningTool must be installed
    if command -v STM32_SigningTool_cli &> /dev/null; then
        log_info "Signing FSBL binary..."
        STM32_SigningTool_cli -s -bin "$NUTTX_DIR/nuttx.bin" \
            -o "$NUTTX_DIR/nuttx_signed.bin" \
            -t fsbl \
            -hv 2.2
    else
        log_warn "STM32_SigningTool not found, using unsigned binary"
        cp "$NUTTX_DIR/nuttx.bin" "$NUTTX_DIR/nuttx_signed.bin"
    fi

    # Flash using STM32_Programmer_CLI
    if command -v STM32_Programmer_CLI &> /dev/null; then
        STM32_Programmer_CLI -c port=SWD \
            -w "$NUTTX_DIR/nuttx_signed.bin" "$FSBL_ADDR" \
            -v
    else
        log_error "STM32_Programmer_CLI not found!"
        log_info "Please flash manually: nuttx_signed.bin -> $FSBL_ADDR"
        exit 1
    fi
}

# Flash NuttX application
flash_app() {
    log_info "Flashing NuttX application to 0x70080000..."

    if [ ! -f "$NUTTX_DIR/nuttx.bin" ]; then
        log_error "Application binary not found. Build first."
        exit 1
    fi

    # Flash using STM32_Programmer_CLI
    if command -v STM32_Programmer_CLI &> /dev/null; then
        STM32_Programmer_CLI -c port=SWD \
            -w "$NUTTX_DIR/nuttx.bin" "$APP_ADDR" \
            -v
    else
        log_error "STM32_Programmer_CLI not found!"
        log_info "Please flash manually: nuttx.bin -> $APP_ADDR"
        exit 1
    fi
}

# Main
case "${1:-all}" in
    fsbl)
        build_fsbl
        flash_fsbl
        ;;
    app)
        build_app
        flash_app
        ;;
    all)
        build_fsbl
        flash_fsbl
        build_app
        flash_app
        ;;
    *)
        echo "Usage: $0 [fsbl|app|all]"
        echo ""
        echo "Commands:"
        echo "  fsbl  - Build and flash FSBL only"
        echo "  app   - Build and flash NuttX application only"
        echo "  all   - Build and flash both (default)"
        exit 1
        ;;
esac

log_info "Done!"

        STM32_SigningTool_cli -s -bin "$NUTTX_DIR/nuttx.bin" \
            -o "$NUTTX_DIR/nuttx_signed.bin" \
            -t fsbl \
            -hv 2.2
    else
        log_warn "STM32_SigningTool not found, using unsigned binary"
        cp "$NUTTX_DIR/nuttx.bin" "$NUTTX_DIR/nuttx_signed.bin"
    fi

    # Flash using STM32_Programmer_CLI
    if command -v STM32_Programmer_CLI &> /dev/null; then
        STM32_Programmer_CLI -c port=SWD \
            -w "$NUTTX_DIR/nuttx_signed.bin" "$FSBL_ADDR" \
            -v
    else
        log_error "STM32_Programmer_CLI not found!"
        log_info "Please flash manually: nuttx_signed.bin -> $FSBL_ADDR"
        exit 1
    fi
}

# Flash NuttX application
flash_app() {
    log_info "Flashing NuttX application to 0x70080000..."

    if [ ! -f "$NUTTX_DIR/nuttx.bin" ]; then
        log_error "Application binary not found. Build first."
        exit 1
    fi

    # Flash using STM32_Programmer_CLI
    if command -v STM32_Programmer_CLI &> /dev/null; then
        STM32_Programmer_CLI -c port=SWD \
            -w "$NUTTX_DIR/nuttx.bin" "$APP_ADDR" \
            -v
    else
        log_error "STM32_Programmer_CLI not found!"
        log_info "Please flash manually: nuttx.bin -> $APP_ADDR"
        exit 1
    fi
}

# Main
case "${1:-all}" in
    fsbl)
        build_fsbl
        flash_fsbl
        ;;
    app)
        build_app
        flash_app
        ;;
    all)
        build_fsbl
        flash_fsbl
        build_app
        flash_app
        ;;
    *)
        echo "Usage: $0 [fsbl|app|all]"
        echo ""
        echo "Commands:"
        echo "  fsbl  - Build and flash FSBL only"
        echo "  app   - Build and flash NuttX application only"
        echo "  all   - Build and flash both (default)"
        exit 1
        ;;
esac

log_info "Done!"

#!/bin/bash
##############################################################################
# boards/arm/stm32n6/atk-dnn647/tools/flash_dnn647.sh
#
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
#
# Build and flash script for ATK-DNN647 board with FSBL support.
#
# This script builds both the FSBL and the NuttX application, then
# provides instructions for flashing them to the external SPI flash.
#
# External Flash Layout (MX25UM25645G, 32MB):
#   0x70000000 - 0x7007FFFF : FSBL (512K, includes boot header)
#   0x70080000 - 0x70FFFFFF : NuttX Application (XIP)
#
##############################################################################

set -e

# Script is at: nuttx/boards/arm/stm32n6/atk-dnn647/tools/flash_dnn647.sh
# BOARD_DIR is: nuttx/boards/arm/stm32n6/atk-dnn647
# NUTTX_DIR is: nuttx

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
BOARD_DIR="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/.." && pwd)"
NUTTX_DIR="$(cd "$BOARD_DIR/../../../.." && pwd)"

# Add ARM toolchain to PATH if not already present
ARM_TOOLCHAIN="$NUTTX_DIR/../prebuilts/gcc/linux-x86_64/arm-none-eabi/bin"
if [ -d "$ARM_TOOLCHAIN" ] && [[ ":$PATH:" != *":$ARM_TOOLCHAIN:"* ]]; then
    export PATH="$ARM_TOOLCHAIN:$PATH"
fi

# Default values
BUILD_FSBL=1
BUILD_APP=1
FLASH_FSBL=0
FLASH_APP=0
STM32_CUBE_PROGRAMMER="${STM32_CUBE_PROGRAMMER:-/opt/st/stm32cubeide_1.17.0/plugins/com.st.stm32cube.ide.mcu.externaltools.cubeprogrammer.linux64_2.2.100.202410251130}"

# Colors for output
RED='\033[0;31m'
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
NC='\033[0m' # No Color

print_info() {
    echo -e "${GREEN}[INFO]${NC} $1"
}

print_warn() {
    echo -e "${YELLOW}[WARN]${NC} $1"
}

print_error() {
    echo -e "${RED}[ERROR]${NC} $1"
}

usage() {
    cat << EOF
Usage: $(basename "$0") [OPTIONS]

Build and flash ATK-DNN647 with FSBL support.

Options:
    --fsbl-only       Build FSBL only
    --app-only        Build application only
    --flash-fsbl      Flash FSBL to external flash
    --flash-app       Flash application to external flash
    --flash-all       Flash both FSBL and application
    --clean           Clean build directories before building
    --help            Show this help message

Environment Variables:
    STM32_CUBE_PROGRAMMER  Path to STM32 Cube Programmer (default: /opt/st/stm32cubeide_.../)

Examples:
    # Build both FSBL and application
    $(basename "$0")

    # Build and flash everything
    $(basename "$0") --flash-all

    # Build FSBL only and flash it
    $(basename "$0") --fsbl-only --flash-fsbl
EOF
}

clean_build() {
    print_info "Cleaning build directories..."
    cd "$NUTTX_DIR"
    make distclean 2>/dev/null || true
    cd -
}

build_fsbl() {
    print_info "Building FSBL..."
    cd "$NUTTX_DIR"

    # Configure for FSBL
    tools/configure.sh atk-dnn647:fsbl

    # Build
    make -j$(nproc)

    # Copy output
    cp nuttx.bin "$BOARD_DIR/build/fsbl.bin"
    cp nuttx "$BOARD_DIR/build/fsbl.elf"

    print_info "FSBL built successfully: $BOARD_DIR/build/fsbl.bin"

    # Clean for next build
    make distclean

    cd -
}

build_app() {
    print_info "Building NuttX application (XIP mode)..."
    cd "$NUTTX_DIR"

    # Configure for XIP
    tools/configure.sh atk-dnn647:nsh_xip

    # Build
    make -j$(nproc)

    # Copy output
    cp nuttx.bin "$BOARD_DIR/build/nuttx_xip.bin"
    cp nuttx "$BOARD_DIR/build/nuttx_xip.elf"

    print_info "Application built successfully: $BOARD_DIR/build/nuttx_xip.bin"

    # Clean for next build
    make distclean

    cd -
}

sign_fsbl() {
    print_info "Signing FSBL binary..."

    local fsbl_bin="$BOARD_DIR/build/fsbl.bin"
    local fsbl_signed="$BOARD_DIR/build/fsbl_signed.bin"

    if [ ! -f "$fsbl_bin" ]; then
        print_error "FSBL binary not found: $fsbl_bin"
        exit 1
    fi

    # Use STM32_SigningTool to create signed binary
    # Header version 2.3, FSBL type, no encryption
    "$STM32_CUBE_PROGRAMMER/bin/STM32_SigningTool_CLI" \
        -bin "$fsbl_bin" \
        -nk \
        -of 0x80000000 \
        -t fsbl \
        -o "$fsbl_signed" \
        -hv 2.3 \
        --align

    print_info "Signed FSBL: $fsbl_signed"
}

flash_fsbl() {
    print_info "Flashing FSBL to external flash at 0x70000000..."

    local fsbl_signed="$BOARD_DIR/build/fsbl_signed.bin"

    if [ ! -f "$fsbl_signed" ]; then
        print_error "Signed FSBL not found: $fsbl_signed"
        print_info "Run with --fsbl-only first to build and sign the FSBL"
        exit 1
    fi

    # Flash using STM32_Programmer
    "$STM32_CUBE_PROGRAMMER/bin/STM32_Programmer.sh" \
        -c port=SWD mode=HOTPLUG ap=1 \
        -el "$STM32_CUBE_PROGRAMMER/bin/ExternalLoader/MX25UM25645G_ATK-CNN647B_ExtMemLoader.stldr" \
        -w "$fsbl_signed" 0x70000000 \
        -hardRst

    print_info "FSBL flashed successfully"
}

flash_app() {
    print_info "Flashing application to external flash at 0x70080000..."

    local app_bin="$BOARD_DIR/build/nuttx_xip.bin"

    if [ ! -f "$app_bin" ]; then
        print_error "Application binary not found: $app_bin"
        print_info "Run with --app-only first to build the application"
        exit 1
    fi

    # Flash using STM32_Programmer
    "$STM32_CUBE_PROGRAMMER/bin/STM32_Programmer.sh" \
        -c port=SWD mode=HOTPLUG ap=1 \
        -el "$STM32_CUBE_PROGRAMMER/bin/ExternalLoader/MX25UM25645G_ATK-CNN647B_ExtMemLoader.stldr" \
        -w "$app_bin" 0x70080000 \
        -hardRst

    print_info "Application flashed successfully"
}

# Parse command line arguments
while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    case $1 in
        --fsbl-only)
            BUILD_APP=0
            shift
            ;;
        --app-only)
            BUILD_FSBL=0
            shift
            ;;
        --flash-fsbl)
            FLASH_FSBL=1
            shift
            ;;
        --flash-app)
            FLASH_APP=1
            shift
            ;;
        --flash-all)
            FLASH_FSBL=1
            FLASH_APP=1
            shift
            ;;
        --clean)
            clean_build
            shift
            ;;
        --help)
            usage
            exit 0
            ;;
        *)
            print_error "Unknown option: $1"
            usage
            exit 1
            ;;
    esac
done

# Create build directory
mkdir -p "$BOARD_DIR/build"

# Build FSBL
if [ "$BUILD_FSBL" -eq 1 ]; then
    build_fsbl
    sign_fsbl
fi

# Build application
if [ "$BUILD_APP" -eq 1 ]; then
    build_app
fi

# Flash FSBL
if [ "$FLASH_FSBL" -eq 1 ]; then
    flash_fsbl
fi

# Flash application
if [ "$FLASH_APP" -eq 1 ]; then
    flash_app
fi

print_info "Done!"
echo ""
echo "================================================================"
echo "  ATK-DNN647 Flash Layout:"
echo "================================================================"
echo "  0x70000000 : FSBL (signed)"
echo "  0x70080000 : NuttX Application (XIP)"
echo "================================================================"
echo ""
echo "To flash manually:"
echo "  1. Flash FSBL:     $(basename "$0") --flash-fsbl"
echo "  2. Flash App:      $(basename "$0") --flash-app"
echo "  3. Power cycle the board to boot"
echo ""

# ATK-DNN647 FSBL 工具说明

## 概述

本目录包含用于构建和烧录 ATK-DNN647 开发板 FSBL (First Stage Boot Loader) 的工具。

## 文件说明

- `flash_dnn647.sh` - 构建和烧录脚本
- `README.md` - 本说明文件

## 前置条件

1. 安装 ARM 工具链：
   ```bash
   # 工具链路径: /home/warner/openvela/prebuilts/gcc/linux-x86_64/arm-none-eabi/bin
   ```

2. 安装 STM32 编程工具（可选）：
   - STM32_Programmer_CLI
   - STM32_SigningTool_cli

## 使用方法

### 构建 FSBL

```bash
cd /home/warner/openvela/nuttx
./boards/arm/stm32n6/atk-dnn647/tools/flash_dnn647.sh fsbl
```

### 构建 NuttX 应用程序 (XIP 模式)

```bash
cd /home/warner/openvela/nuttx
./boards/arm/stm32n6/atk-dnn647/tools/flash_dnn647.sh app
```

### 构建并烧录所有组件

```bash
cd /home/warner/openvela/nuttx
./boards/arm/stm32n6/atk-dnn647/tools/flash_dnn647.sh all
```

## Flash 布局

| 组件 | 地址 | 大小 | 说明 |
|------|------|------|------|
| FSBL | 0x70000000 | 512KB | First Stage Boot Loader |
| NuttX App | 0x70080000 | 31.5MB | NuttX 应用程序 (XIP) |

## 启动流程

1. **Boot ROM** → 从外部 Flash 加载前 512KB 到 SRAM2
2. **FSBL** (0x34180400) → 初始化 VDD、XSPI Flash
3. **NuttX App** (0x70080000) → 从 Flash XIP 执行

## 手动构建

如果需要手动构建：

```bash
cd /home/warner/openvela/nuttx

# 清理
make distclean

# 配置 FSBL
./tools/configure.sh -l boards/arm/stm32n6/atk-dnn647/configs/fsbl

# 构建
make -j$(nproc)

# 输出文件: nuttx.bin
```

## 手动烧录

使用 STM32_Programmer_CLI：

```bash
# 烧录 FSBL (需要先签名)
STM32_SigningTool_cli -s -bin nuttx.bin -o nuttx_signed.bin -t fsbl -hv 2.2
STM32_Programmer_CLI -c port=SWD -w nuttx_signed.bin 0x70000000 -v

# 烧录 NuttX 应用程序
STM32_Programmer_CLI -c port=SWD -w nuttx.bin 0x70080000 -v
```

## 故障排除

### 1. arm-none-eabi-gcc 未找到

确保工具链路径正确：
```bash
export PATH="/home/warner/openvela/prebuilts/gcc/linux-x86_64/arm-none-eabi/bin:$PATH"
```

### 2. FSBL 太大

当前 FSBL 限制为 31KB (31744 字节)。如果编译后太大，请：
- 检查 defconfig 中的配置
- 移除不必要的功能

### 3. 应用程序无法启动

检查：
- FSBL 是否正确烧录到 0x70000000
- NuttX 应用是否配置为 XIP 模式
- 应用链接地址是否为 0x70080000

### 2. 修改的文件

| 文件 | 修改内容 |
|------|----------|
| [Make.defs](nuttx/boards/arm/stm32n6/atk-dnn647/scripts/Make.defs) | 添加 FSBL/XIP 链接脚本选择 |
| [src/Make.defs](nuttx/boards/arm/stm32n6/atk-dnn647/src/Make.defs) | 添加 FSBL 编译规则 |
| [src/CMakeLists.txt](nuttx/boards/arm/stm32n6/atk-dnn647/src/CMakeLists.txt) | 添加 CMake 支持 |
| [Kconfig](nuttx/boards/arm/stm32n6/atk-dnn647/Kconfig) | 添加 FSBL/XIP 配置选项 |

### 3. FSBL 功能

- ✅ 配置 VDD 电压域 (VDDIO2/3/4)
- ✅ 配置 SMPS 供电和电压缩放
- ✅ 初始化 XSPI2 Flash 控制器 (MX25UM25645G, 32MB)
- ✅ 切换 Flash 到 DTR 模式
- ✅ 启用内存映射模式 (XIP)
- ✅ 跳转到 NuttX 应用程序

### 4. 编译结果

```
FLASH_BL: 31732 B / 31 KB (99.96%)
      RAM: 4604 B / 128 KB (3.51%)
```

### 5. 使用方法

```bash
# 构建并烧录 FSBL
cd /home/warner/openvela/nuttx
./boards/arm/stm32n6/atk-dnn647/tools/flash_dnn647.sh fsbl

# 构建并烧录 NuttX 应用
./boards/arm/stm32n6/atk-dnn647/tools/flash_dnn647.sh app

# 构建并烧录所有
./boards/arm/stm32n6/atk-dnn647/tools/flash_dnn647.sh all
```

### 6. Flash 布局

```
0x70000000 ┌─────────────────┐
           │      FSBL       │ 512KB
0x70080000 ├─────────────────┤
           │   NuttX App     │ 31.5MB (XIP)
           └─────────────────┘
```

FSBL 已成功适配，可以构建并烧录到 DNN647 开发板。

284	 * Description:
285	 *   Configure XSPI2 pins (PN0-PN12) for flash access.
286	 *

288	
289	static void xspi_pin_config(void)
290	{
291	  uint32_t reg;
292	  uint32_t moder;
293	  uint32_t ospeedr;
294	  uint32_t pupdr;
295	  uint32_t afrl;
296	  uint32_t afrh;
297	  int pin;
298	
299	  /* Enable GPIO N clock */
300	
301	  reg = getreg32(STM32_RCC_AHB4ENSR);
302	  reg |= (1 << 14);  /* GPIONEN */
303	  putreg32(reg, STM32_RCC_AHB4ENSR);
304	
305	  /* Configure PN0-PN12 as AF9 (XSPI2), very high speed, no pull */
306	
307	  moder = getreg32(STM32_GPION_MODER);
308	  ospeedr = getreg32(STM32_GPION_OSPEED);
309	  pupdr = getreg32(STM32_GPION_PUPDR);
310	  afrl = getreg32(STM32_GPION_AFRL);
311	  afrh = getreg32(STM32_GPION_AFRH);
312	
313	  for (pin = 0; pin <= 12; pin++)
314	    {
315	      /* MODER: AF mode (0x2) */
316	
317	      moder &= ~(3 << (pin * 2));
318	      moder |= (2 << (pin * 2));
319	
320	      /* OSPEEDR: Very High speed (0x3) */
321	
322	      ospeedr &= ~(3 << (pin * 2));
323	      ospeedr |= (3 << (pin * 2));
324	
325	      /* PUPDR: No pull (0x0) */
326	
327	      pupdr &= ~(3 << (pin * 2));
328	
329	      /* AFR: AF9 */
330	
331	      if (pin < 8)
332	        {
333	          afrl &= ~(15 << (pin * 4));
334	          afrl |= (XSPI2_AF << (pin * 4));
335	        }
336	      else
337	        {
338	          afrh &= ~(15 << ((pin - 8) * 4));
339	          afrh |= (XSPI2_AF << ((pin - 8) * 4));
340	        }
341	    }
342	
343	  putreg32(moder, STM32_GPION_MODER);
344	  putreg32(ospeedr, STM32_GPION_OSPEED);
345	  putreg32(pupdr, STM32_GPION_PUPDR);
346	  putreg32(afrl, STM32_GPION_AFRL);
347	  putreg32(afrh, STM32_GPION_AFRH);
348	}
