350	/****************************************************************************
351	 * Name: xspi_write_111
352	 *
353	 * Description:
354	 *   Write data to flash using 1-1-1 SPI mode.
355	 *
356	 ****************************************************************************/
357	
358	static void xspi_write_111(uint8_t cmd, uint32_t addr, int addr_en,
359	                            const uint8_t *data, size_t len)
360	{
361	  uint32_t ccr;
362	
363	  ccr = (1 << XSPI_CCR_DMODE_Pos)   /* data on 1 line */
364	      | (3 << XSPI_CCR_ADSIZE_Pos)  /* 32-bit address */
365	      | ((addr_en ? 1 : 0) << XSPI_CCR_ADMODE_Pos)
366	      | (1 << XSPI_CCR_IMODE_Pos);  /* instruction on 1 line */
367	
368	  /* Indirect write mode */
369	
370	  xspi2->cr = (xspi2->cr & ~(3 << XSPI_CR_FMODE_Pos)) | (0 << XSPI_CR_FMODE_Pos);
371	
372	  xspi2->ccr = ccr;
373	  xspi2->tcr = 0;  /* no dummy cycles */
374	
375	  if (len > 0)
376	    {
377	      xspi2->dlr = len - 1;
378	    }
379	
380	  xspi2->ir = cmd;
381	
382	  if (addr_en)
383	    {
384	      xspi2->ar = addr;
385	    }
386	
387	  /* Write data */
388	
389	  while (len-- > 0)
390	    {
391	      while (!(xspi2->sr & XSPI_SR_FTF))
392	        {
393	        }
394	
395	      *(volatile uint8_t *)&xspi2->dr = *data++;
396	    }
397	
398	  /* Wait for completion */
399	
400	  while (!(xspi2->sr & XSPI_SR_TCF))
401	    {
402	    }
403	
404	  xspi2->fcr = XSPI_FCR_CTCF;
405	
406	  while (xspi2->sr & XSPI_SR_BUSY)
407	    {
408	    }
409	}

412	 * Name: xspi_read_111
413	 *
414	 * Description:
415	 *   Read data from flash using 1-1-1 SPI mode.
416	 *
417	 ****************************************************************************/
418	
419	static void xspi_read_111(uint8_t cmd, uint32_t addr, int addr_en,
420	                           uint8_t *data, size_t len)
421	{
422	  uint32_t ccr;
423	
424	  ccr = (1 << XSPI_CCR_DMODE_Pos)   /* data on 1 line */
425	      | (3 << XSPI_CCR_ADSIZE_Pos)  /* 32-bit address */
426	      | ((addr_en ? 1 : 0) << XSPI_CCR_ADMODE_Pos)
427	      | (1 << XSPI_CCR_IMODE_Pos);  /* instruction on 1 line */
428	
429	  /* Indirect read mode */
430	
431	  xspi2->cr = (xspi2->cr & ~(3 << XSPI_CR_FMODE_Pos)) | (1 << XSPI_CR_FMODE_Pos);
432	
433	  xspi2->ccr = ccr;
434	  xspi2->tcr = 0;  /* no dummy cycles */
435	  xspi2->dlr = len - 1;
436	  xspi2->ir = cmd;
437	
438	  if (addr_en)
439	    {
440	      xspi2->ar = addr;
441	    }
442	
443	  /* Read data */
444	
445	  while (len-- > 0)
446	    {
447	      while (!((xspi2->sr >> XSPI_SR_FLEVEL_Pos) & 0x3f))
448	        {
449	        }
450	
451	      *data++ = *(volatile uint8_t *)&xspi2->dr;
452	    }
453	
454	  xspi2->fcr = XSPI_FCR_CTCF;
455	}
456	
457	/****************************************************************************
458	 * Name: xspi_switch_to_dtr
459	 *
460	 * Description:
461	 *   Switch the MX25UM25645G flash from SPI mode to DTR (DOPI) mode.
462	 *
463	 ****************************************************************************/
464	
465	static void xspi_switch_to_dtr(void)
466	{
467	  uint8_t buf[4];
468	
469	  /* Send WREN (Write Enable) */
470	
471	  xspi_write_111(CMD_WREN, 0, 0, NULL, 0);
472	
473	  /* Wait for WEL bit */
474	
475	  for (int i = 0; i < 100; i++)
476	    {
477	      xspi_read_111(CMD_RDSR, 0, 0, buf, 1);
478	      if (buf[0] & 0x02)
479	        {
480	          break;
481	        }
482	    }
483	
484	  /* Write Configuration Register 2 to switch to DOPI mode */
485	
486	  buf[0] = 0x02;  /* DOPI mode */
487	  xspi_write_111(0x72, 0x00000000, 1, buf, 1);
488	}
489	
490	/****************************************************************************
491	 * Name: xspi_init
492	 *
493	 * Description:
494	 *   Initialize XSPI2 for flash access and enable memory-mapped mode.
495	 *
496	 ****************************************************************************/
497	
498	static void xspi_init(void)
499	{
500	  uint32_t reg;
501	
502	  /* Configure XSPI pins */
503	
504	  xspi_pin_config();
505	
506	  /* Enable XSPI clocks and release reset */
507	
508	  reg = getreg32(rcc_ahb5rstcr);
509	  reg |= RCC_AHB5RSTCR_XSPIMRSTC | RCC_AHB5RSTCR_XSPI2RSTC;
510	  putreg32(reg, rcc_ahb5rstcr);
511	
512	  reg = getreg32(rcc_ahb5ensr);
513	  reg |= RCC_AHB5ENSR_XSPIMEN | RCC_AHB5ENSR_XSPI2EN;
514	  putreg32(reg, rcc_ahb5ensr);
515	
516	  /* Set XSPI2 clock source to HCLK */
517	
518	  reg = getreg32(rcc_ccipr4);
519	  reg &= ~(3 << 4);
520	  reg |= (1 << 4);  /* HCLK */
521	  putreg32(reg, rcc_ccipr4);
522	
523	  /* Configure XSPIM in direct mode */
524	
525	  *xspim_cr = 0;
526	
527	  /* Disable XSPI2 for configuration */
528	
529	  xspi2->cr &= ~XSPI_CR_EN;
530	
531	  /* Configure XSPI2:
532	   * - Macronix memory type
533	   * - 32MB flash size
534	   * - CS high time: 2 cycles
535	   * - CLK idles low
536	   */
537	
538	  xspi2->dcr1 = (1 << XSPI_DCR1_MTYP_Pos)
539	               | ((XSPI_FLASH_SIZE_BITS_LOG2 - 3 - 1) << XSPI_DCR1_DEVSIZE_Pos)
540	               | (1 << XSPI_DCR1_CSHT_Pos)
541	               | (0 << XSPI_DCR1_CKMODE_Pos);
542	
543	  /* Prescaler: F_CLK = F_AHB / 4 */
544	
545	  xspi2->dcr2 = (4 - 1) << XSPI_DCR2_PRESCALER_Pos;
546	  xspi2->dcr3 = 0;
547	  xspi2->dcr4 = 0;
548	  xspi2->tcr = 0;
549	
550	  /* Enable XSPI2 */
551

553	
554	  /* Reconfigure XSPIM */
555

557	  *xspim_cr = 0;
558	  xspi2->cr |= XSPI_CR_EN;
559

569	/****************************************************************************
570	 * Name: xspi_memory_map_888
571	 *
572	 * Description:
573	 *   Enable memory-mapped mode for XIP using 8-8-8 DTR read.
574	 *
575	 ****************************************************************************/
576	
577	static void xspi_memory_map_888(void)
578	{
579	  uint32_t ccr;
580	
581	  ccr = (1 << XSPI_CCR_DQSE_Pos)    /* DQS enabled */
582	      | (1 << XSPI_CCR_DDTR_Pos)     /* data DTR */
583	      | (4 << XSPI_CCR_DMODE_Pos)    /* data on 8 lines */
584	      | (3 << XSPI_CCR_ADSIZE_Pos)   /* 32-bit address */
585	      | (1 << XSPI_CCR_ADDTR_Pos)    /* address DTR */
586	      | (4 << XSPI_CCR_ADMODE_Pos)   /* address on 8 lines */
587	      | (1 << XSPI_CCR_ISIZE_Pos)    /* 16-bit instruction */
588	      | (1 << XSPI_CCR_IDTR_Pos)     /* instruction DTR */
589	      | (4 << XSPI_CCR_IMODE_Pos);   /* instruction on 8 lines */
590	
591	  xspi2->ccr = ccr;
592	  xspi2->tcr = 20 << XSPI_TCR_DCYC_Pos;  /* 20 dummy cycles */
593	  xspi2->ir = CMD_8DTRD;
594	  xspi2->lptr = 1024;  /* timeout period */
595	
596	  /* Enable memory-mapped mode */
597	
598	  xspi2->cr = (xspi2->cr & ~(3 << XSPI_CR_FMODE_Pos)) | (3 << XSPI_CR_FMODE_Pos);
599	}

608	
609	static void fsbl_jump_to_app(uint32_t app_addr)
610	{
611	  uint32_t msp;
612	  uint32_t reset_handler;
613	
614	  /* Validate application: check that the reset handler address is valid */
615	
616	  msp = *(volatile uint32_t *)app_addr;
617	  reset_handler = *(volatile uint32_t *)(app_addr + 4);
618	
619	  /* Check that MSP looks reasonable (in SRAM range) and reset handler
620	   * is in the XIP flash range
621	   */
622	
623	  if ((msp & 0x2ff00000) != 0x20000000 ||
624	      (reset_handler & 0xff000000) != 0x70000000)
625	    {
626	      /* Invalid application, hang */
627	
628	      for (; ; )
629	        {
630	        }
631	    }
632	
633	  /* Set the vector table to the application's location */
634	
635	  putreg32(app_addr, NVIC_VECTAB);
636	
637	  /* Set MSP and jump */
638	
639	  __asm__ volatile (
640	      "msr msp, %0\n"
641	      "bx %1\n"
642	      :
643	      : "r" (msp), "r" (reset_handler)
644	  );
645	
646	  /* Should not reach here */
647	
648	  for (; ; )
649	    {
650	    }
651	}

content.thinking:
The boot ROM loads 512KB from external flash into SRAM2. The first 1024 bytes (0x400) is the header, so the FSBL code starts at 0x34180400. The SRAM2 region goes up to 0x34180000 + 512KB = 0x34200000.

So the FSBL code can be up to:
- 0x34200000 - 0x34180400 = 0x7FC00 = 523264 bytes = 511KB

But we only allocated 31KB (31744 bytes). We can increase this significantly. Let me update the linker script to use more space.

content.text: Boot ROM 加载 512KB 到 SRAM2。FSBL 可以使用更多空间。更新链接脚本。

input.old_string:
/* FSBL linker script for STM32N647X0.
 *
 * The STM32N647X0 has no internal flash.  The hardware boot ROM loads the
 * first 512K of external flash into the upper part of SRAM2 AXI S,
 * starting at 0x34180000.  The first 1024 bytes is a header (signed by
 * STM32_SigningTool).  The actual FSBL code starts at 0x34180400.
 *
 * Memory layout:
 *   0x34180000 - 0x341803FF : Boot header (1024 bytes)
 *   0x34180400 - 0x34187FFF : FSBL code (31744 bytes = 31K)
 *   0x341E0000 - 0x341FFFFF : FSBL data RAM (128K)
 */

MEMORY
{
    FLASH_BL (rx)  : ORIGIN = 0x34180400, LENGTH = 31744
    RAM (xrw)      : ORIGIN = 0x341E0000, LENGTH = 128K
}

MEMORY

1	/*
2	    Linker script fragment for mboot on an STM32N6xx MCU.
3	    This defines the memory sections for the bootloader to use.
4	
5	    On N6, the hardware bootloader loads the first 512k of external flash into
6	    the upper part of SRAM2 AXI S, starting at 0x34180000.  The first 1024 bytes
7	    is a header. Then comes the actual code, starting with the vector table.
8	*/
9	
10	MEMORY
11	{
12	    FLASH_BL (rx)   : ORIGIN = 0x34180400, LENGTH = 31744   /* AXISRAM2_S */
13	    RAM (xrw)       : ORIGIN = 0x341e0000, LENGTH = 128K    /* AXISRAM2_S */
14	}
15	
16	/* Location of protected flash area which must not be modified, because mboot lives there. */
17	_mboot_protected_flash_start = ORIGIN(FLASH_BL);
18	_mboot_protected_flash_end_exclusive = ORIGIN(FLASH_BL) + LENGTH(FLASH_BL);
19

I found the signing command! The key is:

```
$(STM32_CUBE_PROGRAMMER)/bin/STM32_SigningTool_CLI -bin $^ -nk -of 0x80000000 -t fsbl -o $@ -hv $(STM32_N6_HEADER_VERSION) --align
```

The important parameters are:
- `-nk` - no key (unsigned, just header)
- `-of 0x80000000` - output format- `-t fsbl` - type is FSBL
- `-hv $(STM32_N6_HEADER_VERSION)` - header version
- `--align` - align the binary

log_info() {

}

log_warn() {
    echo -e "${YELLOW}[WARN]${NC} $1"
}

log_error() {

}

# Build FSBL
build_fsbl() {

    cd "$NUTTX_DIR"

    # Clean previous build
    make distclean 2>/dev/null || true

    # Configure for FSBL

# Sign FSBL binary
sign_fsbl() {
    log_info "Signing FSBL binary..."

        exit 1

        exit 1

    else
        log_error "STM32_Programmer_CLI not found!"
        log_info "Please flash manually: nuttx_signed.bin -> $FSBL_ADDR"
        exit 1
    fi

    else
        log_error "STM32_Programmer_CLI not found!"
        log_info "Please flash manually: nuttx.bin -> $APP_ADDR"
        exit 1
    fi
}

# Main
case "${1:-all}" in

        build_fsbl
        sign_fsbl
        flash_fsbl
        ;;
    sign)
        sign_fsbl
        ;;
    app)
        build_app
        flash_app
        ;;

        sign_fsbl
        flash_fsbl
        build_app

        echo "  app   - Build and flash NuttX application only"
        echo "  all   - Build, sign and flash both (default)"

esac

#!/bin/bash
# flash_dnn647.sh - Build and flash script for ATK-DNN647 board
#
# This script builds the FSBL and NuttX application, then flashes them
# to the external SPI flash on the DNN647 development board.
#
# Usage: ./flash_dnn647.sh [fsbl|app|all|sign]
#

set -e

# Script directory
SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
BOARD_DIR="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/.." && pwd)"
NUTTX_DIR="$(cd "$BOARD_DIR/../../../.." && pwd)"

# Toolchain path
export PATH="/home/warner/openvela/prebuilts/gcc/linux-x86_64/arm-none-eabi/bin:$PATH"

# STM32 tools path
STM32_TOOLS="/home/warner/STMicroelectronics/STM32Cube/STM32CubeProgrammer/bin"

# Colors for output
RED='\033[0;31m'
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
NC='\033[0m' # No Color

# Flash addresses
FSBL_ADDR=0x70000000
APP_ADDR=0x70080000

# Header version for DNN647
HEADER_VERSION="2.3"

log_info() {
    echo -e "${GREEN}[INFO]${NC} $1"
}

log_warn() {
    echo -e "${YELLOW}[WARN]${NC} $1"
}

log_error() {
    echo -e "${RED}[ERROR]${NC} $1"
}

# Build FSBL
build_fsbl() {
    log_info "Building FSBL..."
    cd "$NUTTX_DIR"

    # Clean previous build
    make distclean 2>/dev/null || true

    # Configure for FSBL
    ./tools/configure.sh -l boards/arm/stm32n6/atk-dnn647/configs/fsbl

    # Build
    make -j$(nproc)

    if [ -f nuttx.bin ]; then
        log_info "FSBL built successfully: nuttx.bin ($(wc -c < nuttx.bin) bytes)"
    else
        log_error "FSBL build failed!"
        exit 1
    fi
}

# Sign FSBL binary
sign_fsbl() {
    log_info "Signing FSBL binary..."

    if [ ! -f "$NUTTX_DIR/nuttx.bin" ]; then
        log_error "FSBL binary not found. Build first."
        exit 1
    fi

    if [ ! -f "$STM32_TOOLS/STM32_SigningTool_CLI" ]; then
        log_error "STM32_SigningTool_CLI not found at: $STM32_TOOLS"
        exit 1
    fi

    # Sign the FSBL binary for boot ROM
    # -nk: no key (just add header, no cryptographic signature)
    # -of 0x80000000: output format
    # -t fsbl: type is FSBL
    # -hv 2.3: header version for DNN647
    # --align: align the binary
    "$STM32_TOOLS/STM32_SigningTool_CLI" \
        -bin "$NUTTX_DIR/nuttx.bin" \
        -nk \
        -of 0x80000000 \
        -t fsbl \
        -o "$NUTTX_DIR/nuttx_signed.bin" \
        -hv "$HEADER_VERSION" \
        --align

    if [ -f "$NUTTX_DIR/nuttx_signed.bin" ]; then
        log_info "FSBL signed successfully: nuttx_signed.bin ($(wc -c < "$NUTTX_DIR/nuttx_signed.bin") bytes)"
    else
        log_error "FSBL signing failed!"
        exit 1
    fi
}

# Build NuttX application (XIP mode)
build_app() {
    log_info "Building NuttX application (XIP mode)..."
    cd "$NUTTX_DIR"

    # Clean previous build
    make distclean 2>/dev/null || true

    # Configure for XIP NSH
    ./tools/configure.sh -l boards/arm/stm32n6/atk-dnn647/configs/nsh_xip

    # Build
    make -j$(nproc)

    if [ -f nuttx.bin ]; then
        log_info "Application built successfully: nuttx.bin ($(wc -c < nuttx.bin) bytes)"
    else
        log_error "Application build failed!"
        exit 1
    fi
}

# Flash FSBL using STM32_Programmer_CLI
flash_fsbl() {
    log_info "Flashing FSBL to $FSBL_ADDR..."

    if [ ! -f "$NUTTX_DIR/nuttx_signed.bin" ]; then
        log_error "Signed FSBL binary not found. Run 'sign' first."
        exit 1
    fi

    # Flash using STM32_Programmer_CLI
    if [ -f "$STM32_TOOLS/STM32_Programmer_CLI" ]; then
        "$STM32_TOOLS/STM32_Programmer_CLI" -c port=SWD \
            -w "$NUTTX_DIR/nuttx_signed.bin" "$FSBL_ADDR" \
            -v
    else
        log_error "STM32_Programmer_CLI not found!"
        log_info "Please flash manually: nuttx_signed.bin -> $FSBL_ADDR"
        exit 1
    fi
}

# Flash NuttX application
flash_app() {
    log_info "Flashing NuttX application to $APP_ADDR..."

    if [ ! -f "$NUTTX_DIR/nuttx.bin" ]; then
        log_error "Application binary not found. Build first."
        exit 1
    fi

    # Flash using STM32_Programmer_CLI
    if [ -f "$STM32_TOOLS/STM32_Programmer_CLI" ]; then
        "$STM32_TOOLS/STM32_Programmer_CLI" -c port=SWD \
            -w "$NUTTX_DIR/nuttx.bin" "$APP_ADDR" \
            -v
    else
        log_error "STM32_Programmer_CLI not found!"
        log_info "Please flash manually: nuttx.bin -> $APP_ADDR"
        exit 1
    fi
}

# Main
case "${1:-all}" in
    fsbl)
        build_fsbl
        sign_fsbl
        flash_fsbl
        ;;
    sign)
        sign_fsbl
        ;;
    app)
        build_app
        flash_app
        ;;
    all)
        build_fsbl
        sign_fsbl
        flash_fsbl
        build_app
        flash_app
        ;;
    *)
        echo "Usage: $0 [fsbl|sign|app|all]"
        echo ""
        echo "Commands:"
        echo "  fsbl  - Build, sign and flash FSBL"
        echo "  sign  - Sign FSBL binary only"
        echo "  app   - Build and flash NuttX application only"
        echo "  all   - Build, sign and flash both (default)"
        exit 1
        ;;
esac

log_info "Done!"

#!/bin/bash
# flash_dnn647.sh - Build and flash script for ATK-DNN647 board
#
# This script builds the FSBL and NuttX application, then flashes them
# to the external SPI flash on the DNN647 development board.
#
# Usage: ./flash_dnn647.sh [fsbl|app|all|sign]
#

set -e

# Script directory
SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
BOARD_DIR="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/.." && pwd)"
NUTTX_DIR="$(cd "$BOARD_DIR/../../../.." && pwd)"

# Toolchain path
export PATH="/home/warner/openvela/prebuilts/gcc/linux-x86_64/arm-none-eabi/bin:$PATH"

# STM32 tools path
STM32_TOOLS="/home/warner/STMicroelectronics/STM32Cube/STM32CubeProgrammer/bin"

# Colors for output
RED='\033[0;31m'
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
NC='\033[0m' # No Color

# Flash addresses
FSBL_ADDR=0x70000000
APP_ADDR=0x70080000

# Header version for DNN647
HEADER_VERSION="2.3"

log_info() {
    echo -e "${GREEN}[INFO]${NC} $1"
}

log_warn() {
    echo -e "${YELLOW}[WARN]${NC} $1"
}

log_error() {
    echo -e "${RED}[ERROR]${NC} $1"
}

# Build FSBL
build_fsbl() {
    log_info "Building FSBL..."
    cd "$NUTTX_DIR"

    # Clean previous build
    make distclean 2>/dev/null || true

    # Configure for FSBL
    ./tools/configure.sh -l boards/arm/stm32n6/atk-dnn647/configs/fsbl

    # Build
    make -j$(nproc)

    if [ -f nuttx.bin ]; then
        log_info "FSBL built successfully: nuttx.bin ($(wc -c < nuttx.bin) bytes)"
    else
        log_error "FSBL build failed!"
        exit 1
    fi
}

# Sign FSBL binary
sign_fsbl() {
    log_info "Signing FSBL binary..."

    if [ ! -f "$NUTTX_DIR/nuttx.bin" ]; then
        log_error "FSBL binary not found. Build first."
        exit 1
    fi

    if [ ! -f "$STM32_TOOLS/STM32_SigningTool_CLI" ]; then
        log_error "STM32_SigningTool_CLI not found at: $STM32_TOOLS"
        exit 1
    fi

    # Remove old signed file if exists
    rm -f "$NUTTX_DIR/nuttx_signed.bin"

    # Sign the FSBL binary for boot ROM
    # -nk: no key (just add header, no cryptographic signature)
    # -of 0x80000000: output format
    # -t fsbl: type is FSBL
    # -hv 2.3: header version for DNN647
    # --align: align the binary
    "$STM32_TOOLS/STM32_SigningTool_CLI" \
        -bin "$NUTTX_DIR/nuttx.bin" \
        -nk \
        -of 0x80000000 \
        -t fsbl \
        -o "$NUTTX_DIR/nuttx_signed.bin" \
        -hv "$HEADER_VERSION" \
        --align

    if [ -f "$NUTTX_DIR/nuttx_signed.bin" ]; then
        log_info "FSBL signed successfully: nuttx_signed.bin ($(wc -c < "$NUTTX_DIR/nuttx_signed.bin") bytes)"
    else
        log_error "FSBL signing failed!"
        exit 1
    fi
}

# Build NuttX application (XIP mode)
build_app() {
    log_info "Building NuttX application (XIP mode)..."
    cd "$NUTTX_DIR"

    # Clean previous build
    make distclean 2>/dev/null || true

    # Configure for XIP NSH
    ./tools/configure.sh -l boards/arm/stm32n6/atk-dnn647/configs/nsh_xip

    # Build
    make -j$(nproc)

    if [ -f nuttx.bin ]; then
        log_info "Application built successfully: nuttx.bin ($(wc -c < nuttx.bin) bytes)"
    else
        log_error "Application build failed!"
        exit 1
    fi
}

# Flash FSBL using STM32_Programmer_CLI
flash_fsbl() {
    log_info "Flashing FSBL to $FSBL_ADDR..."

    if [ ! -f "$NUTTX_DIR/nuttx_signed.bin" ]; then
        log_error "Signed FSBL binary not found. Run 'sign' first."
        exit 1
    fi

    # Flash using STM32_Programmer_CLI
    if [ -f "$STM32_TOOLS/STM32_Programmer_CLI" ]; then
        "$STM32_TOOLS/STM32_Programmer_CLI" -c port=SWD \
            -w "$NUTTX_DIR/nuttx_signed.bin" "$FSBL_ADDR" \
            -v
    else
        log_error "STM32_Programmer_CLI not found!"
        log_info "Please flash manually: nuttx_signed.bin -> $FSBL_ADDR"
        exit 1
    fi
}

# Flash NuttX application
flash_app() {
    log_info "Flashing NuttX application to $APP_ADDR..."

    if [ ! -f "$NUTTX_DIR/nuttx.bin" ]; then
        log_error "Application binary not found. Build first."
        exit 1
    fi

    # Flash using STM32_Programmer_CLI
    if [ -f "$STM32_TOOLS/STM32_Programmer_CLI" ]; then
        "$STM32_TOOLS/STM32_Programmer_CLI" -c port=SWD \
            -w "$NUTTX_DIR/nuttx.bin" "$APP_ADDR" \
            -v
    else
        log_error "STM32_Programmer_CLI not found!"
        log_info "Please flash manually: nuttx.bin -> $APP_ADDR"
        exit 1
    fi
}

# Main
case "${1:-all}" in
    fsbl)
        build_fsbl
        sign_fsbl
        flash_fsbl
        ;;
    sign)
        sign_fsbl
        ;;
    app)
        build_app
        flash_app
        ;;
    all)
        build_fsbl
        sign_fsbl
        flash_fsbl
        build_app
        flash_app
        ;;
    *)
        echo "Usage: $0 [fsbl|sign|app|all]"
        echo ""
        echo "Commands:"
        echo "  fsbl  - Build, sign and flash FSBL"
        echo "  sign  - Sign FSBL binary only"
        echo "  app   - Build and flash NuttX application only"
        echo "  all   - Build, sign and flash both (default)"
        exit 1
        ;;
esac

log_info "Done!"

44	/****************************************************************************
45	 * Pre-processor Definitions
46	 ****************************************************************************/
47	
48	/* LED1 on PE10 - active low */
49	
50	#define LED1_GPIO_BASE   STM32_GPIOE_BASE
51	#define LED1_PIN         10
52	
53	/* Simple delay - approximate at 600MHz */
54	
55	#define DELAY() \
56	  do { \
57	    volatile uint32_t _i; \
58	    for (_i = 0; _i < 20000000; _i++); \
59	  } while (0)
60	
61	/* LED control macros - active low */
62	
63	#define LED1_ON()   putreg32((1 << (LED1_PIN + 16)), LED1_GPIO_BASE + STM32_GPIO_BSRR_OFFSET)
64	#define LED1_OFF()  putreg32((1 << LED1_PIN), LED1_GPIO_BASE + STM32_GPIO_BSRR_OFFSET)
65	
66	/****************************************************************************
67	 * Private Functions
68	 ****************************************************************************/
69	
70	/****************************************************************************
71	 * Name: app_led1_init
72	 *
73	 * Description:
74	 *   Initialize LED1 on PE10
75	 *
76	 ****************************************************************************/
77	
78	static void app_led1_init(void)
79	{
80	  uint32_t regval;
81	
82	  /* Enable GPIOE clock */
83	
84	  modifyreg32(STM32_RCC_AHB4ENR, 0, RCC_AHB4ENR_GPIOEEN);
85	
86	  /* Wait for clock to stabilize */
87	
88	  volatile int i;
89	  for (i = 0; i < 1000; i++);
90	
91	  /* Configure PE10 as general purpose output, push-pull, low speed */
92	
93	  regval = getreg32(LED1_GPIO_BASE + STM32_GPIO_MODER_OFFSET);
94	  regval &= ~(3 << (LED1_PIN * 2));
95	  regval |= (1 << (LED1_PIN * 2));  /* Output mode */
96	  putreg32(regval, LED1_GPIO_BASE + STM32_GPIO_MODER_OFFSET);
97	
98	  /* Push-pull output type (default) */
99	
100	  regval = getreg32(LED1_GPIO_BASE + STM32_GPIO_OTYPER_OFFSET);
101	  regval &= ~(1 << LED1_PIN);
102	  putreg32(regval, LED1_GPIO_BASE + STM32_GPIO_OTYPER_OFFSET);
103	
104	  /* Low speed */
105	
106	  regval = getreg32(LED1_GPIO_BASE + STM32_GPIO_OSPEEDR_OFFSET);
107	  regval &= ~(3 << (LED1_PIN * 2));
108	  putreg32(regval, LED1_GPIO_BASE + STM32_GPIO_OSPEEDR_OFFSET);
109	
110	  /* No pull-up/pull-down */
111	
112	  regval = getreg32(LED1_GPIO_BASE + STM32_GPIO_PUPDR_OFFSET);
113	  regval &= ~(3 << (LED1_PIN * 2));
114	  putreg32(regval, LED1_GPIO_BASE + STM32_GPIO_PUPDR_OFFSET);
115	
116	  /* Start with LED1 off (HIGH = off for active low) */
117	
118	  LED1_OFF();
119	}
120	
121	/****************************************************************************
122	 * Public Functions
123	 ****************************************************************************/
124	
125	/****************************************************************************
126	 * Name: stm32_bringup
127	 *
128	 * Description:
129	 *   Perform architecture-specific initialization
130	 *
131	 *   CONFIG_BOARD_LATE_INITIALIZE=y :
132	 *     Called from board_late_initialize().
133	 *
134	 *   CONFIG_BOARD_LATE_INITIALIZE=n && CONFIG_BOARDCTL=y :
135	 *     Called from the NSH library
136	 *
137	 ****************************************************************************/
138	
139	int stm32_bringup(void)
140	{
141	#if !defined(CONFIG_ARCH_LEDS) && defined(CONFIG_USERLED_LOWER)
142	  int ret;
143	
144	  /* Register the LED driver */
145	
146	  ret = userled_lower_initialize("/dev/userleds");
147	  if (ret < 0)
148	    {
149	      syslog(LOG_ERR, "ERROR: userled_lower_initialize() failed: %d\n", ret);
150	    }
151	#endif
152	
153	  /* Initialize LED1 and start blinking to indicate app is running */
154	
155	  app_led1_init();
156	
157	  /* Blink LED1 continuously to indicate NuttX app is running */
158	
159	  for (; ; )
160	    {
161	      LED1_ON();
162	      DELAY();
163	      LED1_OFF();
164	      DELAY();
165	    }
166	
167	  return OK;
168	}

# Claude.md — STM32N6 PCB 缺陷检测项目记忆

本文件记录项目中已解决的关键问题与解决方案，供后续开发与排错参考。

---

## 问题 1：YOLOv8 bbox 坐标系不匹配导致 INT8 量化后检测全零

### 现象

更换新模型 `Model_PCB_BW_Detection`（黑白 PCB 缺陷检测，6 类：hole/open/short/mousebite/spur/copper）后：

- NPU 推理正常运行（inf=95ms 稳定），但 **cls_max=0**，UART 日志中 `det=0` 占 99% 以上。
- ST Edge AI 报告 `output0_scale=2.014`（异常偏大），而旧 RGB 模型为 `0.0040`。
- INT8 量化后，类别概率（0~1 范围）被压缩到 int8 的 0，导致所有检测框被过滤。

### 根本原因

Ultralytics 8.4.23 使用 `opset=13` 导出 YOLOv8 ONNX 时，会在 bbox 输出分支末尾插入一个 `Mul` 节点，乘数为 `Constant_15 = [8, 16, 32]`（三个检测层的 stride），将 bbox 从 **归一化坐标 (0~1)** 还原为 **像素坐标 (0~416)**。

由此导致：

- ONNX 输出 bbox 范围变为 0~416，而类别概率仍是 0~1。
- ST Edge AI INT8 校准时，为容纳 0~416 的 bbox，将 `output0_scale` 放大至 2.014。
- 在 INT8 量化下，类别概率 0~1 × scale 2.014 ≈ int8 0~2，**几乎所有类别概率被量化为 0**。
- 应用层后处理 `app_ai_clamp01` 期望归一化坐标 (0~1)，遇到 0~416 像素坐标也会出错。

而旧的 RGB 模型使用 `int8=True, opset=19` 导出，Ultralytics 没有插入该 Mul 节点，bbox 保持归一化，`output0_scale=0.0040` 正常。

### 解决方案

**核心思路：在 FP32 ONNX 中将 `Constant_15` 从 `[8, 16, 32]` 修改为 `[8/416, 16/416, 32/416]`，使最终 bbox 输出回到归一化范围 (0~1)。**

修复脚本：[fix_bbox_normalization.py](file:///e:/STM32CubeIDE/STM32_N6_47/5_AISecond/Model_PCB_BW_Detection/fix_bbox_normalization.py)

```python
# 关键修改
import numpy as np
import onnx

m = onnx.load("best.onnx")
for node in m.graph.node:
    if node.op_type == "Constant" and node.output[0].startswith("Constant_15"):
        # 原 [8, 16, 32] -> [8/416, 16/416, 32/416]
        arr = onnx.numpy_helper.to_array(node.attribute[0].t).astype(np.float32)
        arr = arr / 416.0
        node.attribute[0].t.CopyFrom(
            onnx.numpy_helper.from_array(arr, node.attribute[0].t.name))
onnx.save(m, "best_normalized.onnx")
```

### 验证

- 修复后 `output0_scale = 0.004842`（与旧 RGB 模型 0.0040 接近）。
- 量化验证 `cls_max = 0.9199`（修复前为 0.000）。
- 部署后 UART 出现 `det=1, det=2, det=4` 等非零检测。
- CSV 报告出现 `cls=5, conf=6342`（即 0.6342）的真实检测。

### 完整部署流程

```text
best.pt
  → yolo export format=onnx opset=13 imgsz=416          (FP32 NCHW)
```

## 问题 2：Fused QDQ 模型导致 NPU 崩溃 (HardFault / 黑屏死机)

### 现象

使用 `best_qdq_s8_fused.onnx`（融合 QDQ）部署后，NPU 推理瞬间 HardFault，LCD 黑屏，整机死机。

### 根本原因

- 融合 QDQ 移除了末尾的 Q→DQ 链，ST Edge AI 输出节点变为 `Concat_538_out_0`（原始 int8）。
- 应用层 `app_ai_output_buffer` 是 `float[]`，将 int8 字节当作 float32 读取 → 4 个 int8 字节拼成 1 个垃圾 float → 数组索引越界 → HardFault。

### 解决方案

**必须使用非 fused QDQ 模型** `best_normalized_qdq_s8.onnx`，使 ST Edge AI 输出节点为 `Dequantize_505_out_0`（正确的 float32）。

### 部署确认

[STM32CubeIDE/Appli/Application/User/AI/network.h](file:///e:/STM32CubeIDE/STM32_N6_47/5_AISecond/STM32CubeIDE/Appli/Application/User/AI/network.h) 中：
- 模型名：`best_normalized_qdq_s8`
- 输出节点：`Dequantize_505_out_0`
- 输出格式：`float32(1x10x3549)`

## 问题 3：NPU 周期性超时（未完全解决）

### 现象

UART 日志中每隔约 90~120 帧出现：

```text
[AI] live inference timeout
[AI] live inference failed ret=-3, recovering runtime
WARNING: performing a hard-reset of debug wait-mask!
[Main] ERROR: inference failed on frame XXX
```

### 原因分析

非 fused QDQ 模型中仍存在 99KB 的 `_ec_blob_network_67[12408]`（EC = Embedded Code，NPU 调度补丁）。这些 EC blob 在某些张量形状下触发 NPU 内部死锁，需要 hard-reset 才能恢复。

### 现状

- **不影响功能**：每次超时后自动恢复，下一帧推理正常。
- **影响性能**：每次超时损失约 1~2 秒，且丢一帧检测。
- **未根本解决**：可能需要调整量化策略（per-channel 量化、不同校准数据集）或更换模型结构（去除某些算子）。

## 问题 4：SMART EXIT 后再进 REALTIME 导致 NPU 永久死锁

### 现象

用户在 SMART 模式快速进入并退出（<10 秒，未完成扫描），回到 REALTIME 后：

- Frame 520 `period=14827ms`（14.8 秒间隔，异常）
- Frame 521 第一次 timeout
- 之后 Frame 521 **反复 timeout**（每 5 秒一次），`ai_test_recover_after_failure()` 无法恢复
- 用户按 EXIT 回 HOME，再进 REALTIME，**依然 timeout**（NPU 永久卡死）
- 摄像头预览正常（Pipe1/ISP 没受影响），但 GUI 检测框不更新
- 必须完全断电重启才能恢复

### 根本原因

三个问题叠加：

1. **`app_ai_stop()` 没有彻底清理 NPU 状态**：原实现只设置 `g_ai_pipeline_started = 0` 并等待 `g_npu_busy` 清零，但**没有 deinit NPU runtime**。SMART 期间 NPU 内部状态可能已损坏，回到 REALTIME 时 NPU 仍处于异常状态。

2. **`app_ai_start()` 恢复时没有重新 init NPU**：当 `g_ai_runtime_inited = 1` 时，只调用 `imx335_start_nn_capture()` 重启 Pipe2，**没有重新 init NPU runtime**。NPU 已死锁的状态被直接复用。

3. **没有连续 timeout 熔断机制**：主循环在推理失败时只 `continue`，没有计数器和上限。`ai_test_recover_after_failure()` 在 NPU 真正死锁时也无效，导致无限循环 `timeout → recover → timeout`，UART 反复打印同一个 frame 号。

### 解决方案（已实施）

**修复 1：添加连续失败熔断**（[app_threadx.c](file:///e:/STM32CubeIDE/STM32_N6_47/5_AISecond/STM32CubeIDE/Appli/Application/User/Core/app_threadx.c)）

主循环中加入 `consecutive_inf_failures` 计数器：
- 推理失败时 +1，成功时清零
- **连续 2 次失败**时调用 `ai_inference_full_reset()` 彻底重置 NPU（含 cache），设置 `g_ai_runtime_inited = 0`，强制下次 `app_ai_start()` 走完整 init 流程
- 自动回到 HOME 页，提示用户重新进入 REALTIME

**修复 2：`app_ai_stop()` 彻底重置 NPU**（[app_threadx.c](file:///e:/STM32CubeIDE/STM32_N6_47/5_AISecond/STM32CubeIDE/Appli/Application/User/Core/app_threadx.c)）

`app_ai_stop()` 现在：
- 等待 `g_npu_busy` 清零（最多 2 秒）
- 清理残留帧信号
- 调用 `ai_inference_full_reset()`（deinit + NPU cache reset）
- 设置 `g_ai_runtime_inited = 0`

这样无论从 REALTIME EXIT 还是 SMART EXIT，NPU 都会被彻底清理，下次进入时走完整 init。

**修复 3：新增 `ai_inference_full_reset()` 函数**（[ai_test.c](file:///e:/STM32CubeIDE/STM32_N6_47/5_AISecond/STM32CubeIDE/Appli/Application/User/AI/ai_test.c) / [ai_test.h](file:///e:/STM32CubeIDE/STM32_N6_47/5_AISecond/STM32CubeIDE/Appli/Application/User/AI/ai_test.h)）

```c
void ai_inference_full_reset(void)
{
    ai_test_network_deinit();
    ai_test_runtime_deinit();
    /* NPU cache 完全重置（与 recover_after_failure 相同的流程） */
    (void)HAL_CACHEAXI_Disable(&hcacheaxi);
    npu_cache_enable_clocks_and_reset();
    npu_cache_enable();
    npu_cache_invalidate();
    __DSB();
    __ISB();
}
```

### 副作用

- 每次 `app_ai_stop()` 现在会增加 ~1 秒的 NPU 重置延迟（可接受）
- 每次 `app_ai_start()` 都走完整 init 流程（`g_ai_runtime_inited` 几乎总是 0）
- 这是**安全性 > 速度**的权衡，避免 NPU 状态污染导致的死锁

### 验证方法

1. 编译烧录后，进入 REALTIME 正常检测
2. 按 EXIT 回 HOME，进入 SMART，**立即按 EXIT**（<10 秒）
3. 回到 REALTIME，应该能正常检测（不再卡死）
4. 如果仍卡死，UART 会在连续 2 次 timeout 后打印 `[AI] FATAL: NPU deadlocked, performing full reset`，自动回到 HOME 页

## 关键约束与约定（与本次问题相关）

- **NN 输入**：416×416×3 RGB888 uint8（NHWC），量化 scale=1/255，等价于 `float = uint8 / 255`。
- **NN 输出**：`1x10x3549` float32，10 = 4(bbox xywh) + 6(classes)，3549 = (52²+26²+13²) anchors。
- **bbox 必须**为归一化坐标 (0~1)，应用层 `app_ai_clamp01` 强制裁剪到 0~1。
- **置信度阈值**：`AI_OBJDETECT_YOLOV8_PP_CONF_THRESHOLD = 0.5f`（位于 [app_config.h](file:///e:/STM32CubeIDE/STM32_N6_47/5_AISecond/Appli/Core/Inc/app_config.h) 第 59 行）。
- **IOU 阈值**：`AI_OBJDETECT_YOLOV8_PP_IOU_THRESHOLD = 0.45f`。
- **类别映射**：`hole(0), open(1), short(2), mousebite(3), spur(4), copper(5)`。
- **视觉管线**：DCMIPP Pipe1 800×480 实时预览 + Pipe2 416×416 NPU 推理并行。
- **CSV 报告坐标**：已乘以 LCD 尺寸 (800×480)，不是 NN 坐标。
- **newlib-nano 限制**：UART 中 `conf= box=(,,,)` 为空是已知问题，CSV 用整数算术正常输出（conf=6342 表示 0.6342）。

458	static void xspi_read_111(uint8_t cmd, uint32_t addr, int addr_en,
459	                           uint8_t *data, size_t len)
460	{
461	  uint32_t ccr;
462	
463	  ccr = (1 << XSPI_CCR_DMODE_Pos)   /* data on 1 line */
464	      | (3 << XSPI_CCR_ADSIZE_Pos)  /* 32-bit address */
465	      | ((addr_en ? 1 : 0) << XSPI_CCR_ADMODE_Pos)
466	      | (1 << XSPI_CCR_IMODE_Pos);  /* instruction on 1 line */
467	
468	  /* Indirect read mode */
469	
470	  xspi2->cr = (xspi2->cr & ~(3 << XSPI_CR_FMODE_Pos)) | (1 << XSPI_CR_FMODE_Pos);
471	
472	  xspi2->ccr = ccr;
473	  xspi2->tcr = 0;  /* no dummy cycles */
474	  xspi2->dlr = len - 1;
475	  xspi2->ir = cmd;
476	
477	  if (addr_en)
478	    {
479	      xspi2->ar = addr;
480	    }
481	
482	  /* Read data */
483	
484	  while (len-- > 0)
485	    {
486	      while (!((xspi2->sr >> XSPI_SR_FLEVEL_Pos) & 0x3f))
487	        {
488	        }
489	
490	      *data++ = *(volatile uint8_t *)&xspi2->dr;
491	    }
492	
493	  xspi2->fcr = XSPI_FCR_CTCF;
494	}

501	 *
502	 ****************************************************************************/
503	
504	static void xspi_switch_to_dtr(void)
505	{
506	  uint8_t buf[4];
507	
508	  /* Send WREN (Write Enable) */
509	
510	  xspi_write_111(CMD_WREN, 0, 0, NULL, 0);
511	
512	  /* Wait for WEL bit */
513	
514	  for (int i = 0; i < 100; i++)
515	    {

517	      if (buf[0] & 0x02)
518	        {
519	          break;
520	        }
521	    }
522	
523	  /* Write Configuration Register 2 to switch to DOPI mode */
524

542	      | (1 << XSPI_CCR_DDTR_Pos)     /* data DTR */
543	      | (4 << XSPI_CCR_DMODE_Pos)    /* data on 8 lines */
544	      | (3 << XSPI_CCR_ADSIZE_Pos)   /* 32-bit address */
545	      | (1 << XSPI_CCR_ADDTR_Pos)    /* address DTR */
546	      | (4 << XSPI_CCR_ADMODE_Pos)   /* address on 8 lines */
547	      | (1 << XSPI_CCR_ISIZE_Pos)    /* 16-bit instruction */
548	      | (1 << XSPI_CCR_IDTR_Pos)     /* instruction DTR */
549	      | (4 << XSPI_CCR_IMODE_Pos);   /* instruction on 8 lines */

552	  xspi2->tcr = 20 << XSPI_TCR_DCYC_Pos;  /* 20 dummy cycles */

554	  xspi2->lptr = 1024;  /* timeout period */

605	   * - CS high time: 2 cycles
606	   * - CLK idles low

FSBL 的跳转验证代码有错误：
- 原代码检查 MSP 是否在 `0x20000000` 范围（Cortex-M 通用 SRAM 地址）
- 但 STM32N6 的 SRAM 在 `0x34000000` 范围

NuttX 应用的 MSP 值是 `0x340042a8`，所以验证失败，FSBL 进入死循环，LED 不再闪烁。

**已修复：** 将 MSP 验证改为检查 `0x34xxxxxx` 范围，并在验证失败时 LED 快闪指示错误。

```bash
cd /home/warner/openvela/nuttx

# 1. 烧录修复后的 FSBL
/home/warner/STMicroelectronics/STM32Cube/STM32CubeProgrammer/bin/STM32_Programmer_CLI -c port=SWD -w nuttx_signed.bin 0x70000000 -v

/home/warner/STMicroelectronics/STM32Cube/STM32CubeProgrammer/bin/STM32_Programmer_CLI -c port=SWD -w nuttx.bin 0x70080000 -v
```

1. Primary Request and Intent:
   The user requested adapting an FSBL program for the DNN647 development board (STM32N647X0, Cortex-M55, no internal flash). The boot chain: Boot ROM → FSBL → NuttX Application. FSBL at 0x70000000, NuttX app at 0x70080000 in external SPI flash. The user also requested LED blinking for status indication. In this session, the user asked to add LED1 (PE10) continuous blinking in the NuttX application to verify it's running. When LED1 still didn't light up, the user provided a reference CubeIDE project at `/home/warner/openvela/demo/yolo-for-stm32n6` to study the FSBL and appli implementation.

2. Key Technical Concepts:
   - STM32N647X0 MCU with Cortex-M55 core (ARMv8.1-M)
   - No internal flash - boot from external SPI flash (MX25UM25645G, 32MB)
   - Boot ROM loads first 512K of external flash into SRAM2 at 0x34180000
   - FSBL runs from SRAM2 at 0x34180400
   - XIP (Execute-In-Place) from external flash at 0x70000000
   - XSPI2 peripheral for flash access (Macronix mode, DTR/DOPI mode)
   - VDD voltage domains: VDDIO2 (3.3V), VDDIO3 (1.8V), VDDIO4 (3.3V)
   - STM32N6 SRAM is at 0x34000000 (NOT 0x20000000 like typical Cortex-M)
   - LED0 = PG10 (active low), LED1 = PE10 (active low)
   - NuttX GPIO API: `stm32_configgpio()`, `stm32_gpiowrite()`
   - STM32_SigningTool: `-nk -of 0x80000000 -t fsbl -hv 2.3 --align`

   - **`nuttx/boards/arm/stm32n6/atk-dnn647/src/fsbl_main.c`** (MODIFIED)

     - Critical fix: MSP validation was checking wrong SRAM range (0x20000000 instead of 0x34000000)
     - Fixed `fsbl_jump_to_app()` function:
     ```c
     static void fsbl_jump_to_app(uint32_t app_addr)
     {
       uint32_t msp;
       uint32_t reset_handler;
       msp = *(volatile uint32_t *)app_addr;
       reset_handler = *(volatile uint32_t *)(app_addr + 4);
       /* Check that MSP looks reasonable (in SRAM range 0x34xxxxxx) and reset
        * handler is in the XIP flash range (0x70xxxxxx) */
       if ((msp & 0xff000000) != 0x34000000 ||
           (reset_handler & 0xff000000) != 0x70000000)
         {
           /* Invalid application, hang with LED blinking fast to indicate error */
           for (; ; )
             {
               LED_ON();
               for (volatile uint32_t d = 0; d < 50000; d++);
               LED_OFF();
               for (volatile uint32_t d = 0; d < 50000; d++);
             }
         }
       putreg32(app_addr, NVIC_VECTAB);
       __asm__ volatile (
           "msr msp, %0\n"
           "bx %1\n"
           :
           : "r" (msp), "r" (reset_handler)
       );
       for (; ; ) {}
     }
     ```
     - Note: The reference project (`stm32_boot_xip.c`) also disables I-Cache, D-Cache, sets MSPLIM, and suspends SysTick before jumping - our FSBL does NOT do these things.

   - **`nuttx/boards/arm/stm32n6/atk-dnn647/src/stm32_bringup.c`** (MODIFIED)
     - Added LED1 (PE10) continuous blinking code using NuttX GPIO API
     ```c
     #include "stm32_gpio.h"
     #include "dnn647.h"
     
     #define DELAY() \
       do { \
         volatile uint32_t _i; \
         for (_i = 0; _i < 20000000; _i++); \
       } while (0)
     
     int stm32_bringup(void)
     {
       /* ... userled init ... */
       
       /* Configure LED1 (PE10) as output using NuttX GPIO API */
       stm32_configgpio(GPIO_LED1);
       stm32_gpiowrite(GPIO_LED1, true);  /* LED1 OFF initially */
       
       /* Blink LED1 continuously to indicate NuttX app is running */
       for (; ; )
         {
           stm32_gpiowrite(GPIO_LED1, false);  /* LED1 ON (active low) */
           DELAY();
           stm32_gpiowrite(GPIO_LED1, true);   /* LED1 OFF (active low) */
           DELAY();
     ```

     ```c
     #define GPIO_LED0       (GPIO_OUTPUT | GPIO_PUSHPULL | GPIO_SPEED_2MHZ | \
     ```

   - **Other existing files** (unchanged from previous session):
     - `nuttx/boards/arm/stm32n6/atk-dnn647/scripts/fsbl.ld` - FSBL linker script (SRAM2 at 0x34180400, 256K)
     - `nuttx/boards/arm/stm32n6/atk-dnn647/scripts/flash_xip.ld` - XIP linker script (0x70080000)

# Claude.md — STM32N6 PCB 缺陷检测项目记忆

本文件记录项目中已解决的关键问题与解决方案，供后续开发与排错参考。

---

## 问题 1：YOLOv8 bbox 坐标系不匹配导致 INT8 量化后检测全零

### 现象

更换新模型 `Model_PCB_BW_Detection`（黑白 PCB 缺陷检测，6 类：hole/open/short/mousebite/spur/copper）后：

- NPU 推理正常运行（inf=95ms 稳定），但 **cls_max=0**，UART 日志中 `det=0` 占 99% 以上。
- ST Edge AI 报告 `output0_scale=2.014`（异常偏大），而旧 RGB 模型为 `0.0040`。
- INT8 量化后，类别概率（0~1 范围）被压缩到 int8 的 0，导致所有检测框被过滤。

### 根本原因

Ultralytics 8.4.23 使用 `opset=13` 导出 YOLOv8 ONNX 时，会在 bbox 输出分支末尾插入一个 `Mul` 节点，乘数为 `Constant_15 = [8, 16, 32]`（三个检测层的 stride），将 bbox 从 **归一化坐标 (0~1)** 还原为 **像素坐标 (0~416)**。

由此导致：

- ONNX 输出 bbox 范围变为 0~416，而类别概率仍是 0~1。
- ST Edge AI INT8 校准时，为容纳 0~416 的 bbox，将 `output0_scale` 放大至 2.014。
- 在 INT8 量化下，类别概率 0~1 × scale 2.014 ≈ int8 0~2，**几乎所有类别概率被量化为 0**。
- 应用层后处理 `app_ai_clamp01` 期望归一化坐标 (0~1)，遇到 0~416 像素坐标也会出错。

而旧的 RGB 模型使用 `int8=True, opset=19` 导出，Ultralytics 没有插入该 Mul 节点，bbox 保持归一化，`output0_scale=0.0040` 正常。

### 解决方案

**核心思路：在 FP32 ONNX 中将 `Constant_15` 从 `[8, 16, 32]` 修改为 `[8/416, 16/416, 32/416]`，使最终 bbox 输出回到归一化范围 (0~1)。**

修复脚本：[fix_bbox_normalization.py](file:///e:/STM32CubeIDE/STM32_N6_47/5_AISecond/Model_PCB_BW_Detection/fix_bbox_normalization.py)

```python
# 关键修改
import numpy as np
import onnx

m = onnx.load("best.onnx")
for node in m.graph.node:
    if node.op_type == "Constant" and node.output[0].startswith("Constant_15"):
        # 原 [8, 16, 32] -> [8/416, 16/416, 32/416]
        arr = onnx.numpy_helper.to_array(node.attribute[0].t).astype(np.float32)
        arr = arr / 416.0
        node.attribute[0].t.CopyFrom(
            onnx.numpy_helper.from_array(arr, node.attribute[0].t.name))
onnx.save(m, "best_normalized.onnx")
```

### 验证

- 修复后 `output0_scale = 0.004842`（与旧 RGB 模型 0.0040 接近）。
- 量化验证 `cls_max = 0.9199`（修复前为 0.000）。
- 部署后 UART 出现 `det=1, det=2, det=4` 等非零检测。
- CSV 报告出现 `cls=5, conf=6342`（即 0.6342）的真实检测。

### 完整部署流程

```text
best.pt
  → yolo export format=onnx opset=13 imgsz=416          (FP32 NCHW)
  → fix_bbox_normalization.py                            (修改 Constant_15)
  → best_normalized.onnx
  → quantize_yolov8_onnx_qdq.py --activation int8 --no-per-channel
  → best_normalized_qdq_s8.onnx                          (非 fused QDQ)
  → generate-n6-model-onnx-qdq.ps1                       (ST Edge AI 生成)
  → network.c/h, network_data.xSPI2.bin                  (部署到工程)
```

详细文档：[README_ONNX_QDQ_STM32N6.md](file:///e:/STM32CubeIDE/STM32_N6_47/5_AISecond/Model_PCB_BW_Detection/README_ONNX_QDQ_STM32N6.md)

---

## 问题 2：Fused QDQ 模型导致 NPU 崩溃 (HardFault / 黑屏死机)

### 现象

使用 `best_qdq_s8_fused.onnx`（融合 QDQ）部署后，NPU 推理瞬间 HardFault，LCD 黑屏，整机死机。

### 根本原因

- 融合 QDQ 移除了末尾的 Q→DQ 链，ST Edge AI 输出节点变为 `Concat_538_out_0`（原始 int8）。
- 应用层 `app_ai_output_buffer` 是 `float[]`，将 int8 字节当作 float32 读取 → 4 个 int8 字节拼成 1 个垃圾 float → 数组索引越界 → HardFault。

### 解决方案

**必须使用非 fused QDQ 模型** `best_normalized_qdq_s8.onnx`，使 ST Edge AI 输出节点为 `Dequantize_505_out_0`（正确的 float32）。

### 部署确认

[STM32CubeIDE/Appli/Application/User/AI/network.h](file:///e:/STM32CubeIDE/STM32_N6_47/5_AISecond/STM32CubeIDE/Appli/Application/User/AI/network.h) 中：
- 模型名：`best_normalized_qdq_s8`
- 输出节点：`Dequantize_505_out_0`
- 输出格式：`float32(1x10x3549)`

---

## 问题 3：NPU 周期性超时（未完全解决）

### 现象

UART 日志中每隔约 90~120 帧出现：

```text
[AI] live inference timeout
[AI] live inference failed ret=-3, recovering runtime
WARNING: performing a hard-reset of debug wait-mask!
[Main] ERROR: inference failed on frame XXX
```

### 原因分析

非 fused QDQ 模型中仍存在 99KB 的 `_ec_blob_network_67[12408]`（EC = Embedded Code，NPU 调度补丁）。这些 EC blob 在某些张量形状下触发 NPU 内部死锁，需要 hard-reset 才能恢复。

### 现状

- **不影响功能**：每次超时后自动恢复，下一帧推理正常。
- **影响性能**：每次超时损失约 1~2 秒，且丢一帧检测。
- **未根本解决**：可能需要调整量化策略（per-channel 量化、不同校准数据集）或更换模型结构（去除某些算子）。

---

## 问题 4：SMART EXIT 后再进 REALTIME 导致 NPU 永久死锁

### 现象

用户在 SMART 模式快速进入并退出（<10 秒，未完成扫描），回到 REALTIME 后：

- Frame 520 `period=14827ms`（14.8 秒间隔，异常）
- Frame 521 第一次 timeout
- 之后 Frame 521 **反复 timeout**（每 5 秒一次），`ai_test_recover_after_failure()` 无法恢复
- 用户按 EXIT 回 HOME，再进 REALTIME，**依然 timeout**（NPU 永久卡死）
- 摄像头预览正常（Pipe1/ISP 没受影响），但 GUI 检测框不更新
- 必须完全断电重启才能恢复

### 根本原因

三个问题叠加：

1. **`app_ai_stop()` 没有彻底清理 NPU 状态**：原实现只设置 `g_ai_pipeline_started = 0` 并等待 `g_npu_busy` 清零，但**没有 deinit NPU runtime**。SMART 期间 NPU 内部状态可能已损坏，回到 REALTIME 时 NPU 仍处于异常状态。

2. **`app_ai_start()` 恢复时没有重新 init NPU**：当 `g_ai_runtime_inited = 1` 时，只调用 `imx335_start_nn_capture()` 重启 Pipe2，**没有重新 init NPU runtime**。NPU 已死锁的状态被直接复用。

3. **没有连续 timeout 熔断机制**：主循环在推理失败时只 `continue`，没有计数器和上限。`ai_test_recover_after_failure()` 在 NPU 真正死锁时也无效，导致无限循环 `timeout → recover → timeout`，UART 反复打印同一个 frame 号。

### 解决方案（已实施）

**修复 1：添加连续失败熔断**（[app_threadx.c](file:///e:/STM32CubeIDE/STM32_N6_47/5_AISecond/STM32CubeIDE/Appli/Application/User/Core/app_threadx.c)）

主循环中加入 `consecutive_inf_failures` 计数器：
- 推理失败时 +1，成功时清零
- **连续 2 次失败**时调用 `ai_inference_full_reset()` 彻底重置 NPU（含 cache），设置 `g_ai_runtime_inited = 0`，强制下次 `app_ai_start()` 走完整 init 流程
- 自动回到 HOME 页，提示用户重新进入 REALTIME

**修复 2：`app_ai_stop()` 彻底重置 NPU**（[app_threadx.c](file:///e:/STM32CubeIDE/STM32_N6_47/5_AISecond/STM32CubeIDE/Appli/Application/User/Core/app_threadx.c)）

`app_ai_stop()` 现在：
- 等待 `g_npu_busy` 清零（最多 2 秒）
- 清理残留帧信号
- 调用 `ai_inference_full_reset()`（deinit + NPU cache reset）
- 设置 `g_ai_runtime_inited = 0`

这样无论从 REALTIME EXIT 还是 SMART EXIT，NPU 都会被彻底清理，下次进入时走完整 init。

**修复 3：新增 `ai_inference_full_reset()` 函数**（[ai_test.c](file:///e:/STM32CubeIDE/STM32_N6_47/5_AISecond/STM32CubeIDE/Appli/Application/User/AI/ai_test.c) / [ai_test.h](file:///e:/STM32CubeIDE/STM32_N6_47/5_AISecond/STM32CubeIDE/Appli/Application/User/AI/ai_test.h)）

```c
void ai_inference_full_reset(void)
{
    ai_test_network_deinit();
    ai_test_runtime_deinit();
    /* NPU cache 完全重置（与 recover_after_failure 相同的流程） */
    (void)HAL_CACHEAXI_Disable(&hcacheaxi);
    npu_cache_enable_clocks_and_reset();
    npu_cache_enable();
    npu_cache_invalidate();
    __DSB();
    __ISB();
}
```

### 副作用

- 每次 `app_ai_stop()` 现在会增加 ~1 秒的 NPU 重置延迟（可接受）
- 每次 `app_ai_start()` 都走完整 init 流程（`g_ai_runtime_inited` 几乎总是 0）
- 这是**安全性 > 速度**的权衡，避免 NPU 状态污染导致的死锁

### 验证方法

1. 编译烧录后，进入 REALTIME 正常检测
2. 按 EXIT 回 HOME，进入 SMART，**立即按 EXIT**（<10 秒）
3. 回到 REALTIME，应该能正常检测（不再卡死）
4. 如果仍卡死，UART 会在连续 2 次 timeout 后打印 `[AI] FATAL: NPU deadlocked, performing full reset`，自动回到 HOME 页

## 关键约束与约定（与本次问题相关）

- **NN 输入**：416×416×3 RGB888 uint8（NHWC），量化 scale=1/255，等价于 `float = uint8 / 255`。

241	/****************************************************************************
242	 * Name: led_init
243	 *
244	 * Description:
245	 *   Initialize LED0 (PG10) for status indication.
246	 *   LED0 is active low (low = on, high = off).
247	 *
248	 ****************************************************************************/
249	
250	static void led_init(void)
251	{
252	  uint32_t reg;
253	
254	  /* Enable GPIO G clock */
255	
256	  reg = getreg32(STM32_RCC_AHB4ENSR);
257	  reg |= LED_RCC_EN;
258	  putreg32(reg, STM32_RCC_AHB4ENSR);
259	
260	  /* Configure PG10 as general purpose output, very high speed, no pull */
261	
262	  reg = getreg32(STM32_GPIOG_MODER);
263	  reg &= ~(3 << (LED_PIN * 2));
264	  reg |= (1 << (LED_PIN * 2));  /* Output mode (0x1) */
265	  putreg32(reg, STM32_GPIOG_MODER);
266	
267	  reg = getreg32(STM32_GPIOG_OSPEED);
268	  reg &= ~(3 << (LED_PIN * 2));
269	  reg |= (3 << (LED_PIN * 2));  /* Very high speed (0x3) */
270	  putreg32(reg, STM32_GPIOG_OSPEED);
271	
272	  reg = getreg32(STM32_GPIOG_PUPDR);
273	  reg &= ~(3 << (LED_PIN * 2));  /* No pull (0x0) */
274	  putreg32(reg, STM32_GPIOG_PUPDR);
275	
276	  /* Start with LED off */
277	
278	  LED_OFF();
279	}

320	/****************************************************************************
321	 * Name: xspi_pin_config
322	 *
323	 * Description:
324	 *   Configure XSPI2 pins (PN0-PN12) for flash access.
325	 *
326	 ****************************************************************************/
327	
328	static void xspi_pin_config(void)
329	{
330	  uint32_t reg;
331	  uint32_t moder;
332	  uint32_t ospeedr;
333	  uint32_t pupdr;
334	  uint32_t afrl;
335	  uint32_t afrh;
336	  int pin;
337	
338	  /* Enable GPIO N clock */
339	
340	  reg = getreg32(STM32_RCC_AHB4ENSR);
341	  reg |= (1 << 14);  /* GPIONEN */
342	  putreg32(reg, STM32_RCC_AHB4ENSR);
343	
344	  /* Configure PN0-PN12 as AF9 (XSPI2), very high speed, no pull */
345	
346	  moder = getreg32(STM32_GPION_MODER);
347	  ospeedr = getreg32(STM32_GPION_OSPEED);
348	  pupdr = getreg32(STM32_GPION_PUPDR);
349	  afrl = getreg32(STM32_GPION_AFRL);
350	  afrh = getreg32(STM32_GPION_AFRH);
351	
352	  for (pin = 0; pin <= 12; pin++)
353	    {
354	      /* MODER: AF mode (0x2) */
355	
356	      moder &= ~(3 << (pin * 2));
357	      moder |= (2 << (pin * 2));
358	
359	      /* OSPEEDR: Very High speed (0x3) */
360	
361	      ospeedr &= ~(3 << (pin * 2));
362	      ospeedr |= (3 << (pin * 2));
363	
364	      /* PUPDR: No pull (0x0) */
365	
366	      pupdr &= ~(3 << (pin * 2));
367	
368	      /* AFR: AF9 */
369	
370	      if (pin < 8)
371	        {
372	          afrl &= ~(15 << (pin * 4));
373	          afrl |= (XSPI2_AF << (pin * 4));
374	        }
375	      else
376	        {
377	          afrh &= ~(15 << ((pin - 8) * 4));
378	          afrh |= (XSPI2_AF << ((pin - 8) * 4));
379	        }
380	    }
381	
382	  putreg32(moder, STM32_GPION_MODER);
383	  putreg32(ospeedr, STM32_GPION_OSPEED);
384	  putreg32(pupdr, STM32_GPION_PUPDR);
385	  putreg32(afrl, STM32_GPION_AFRL);
386	  putreg32(afrh, STM32_GPION_AFRH);
387	}

389	/****************************************************************************
390	 * Name: xspi_write_111
391	 *
392	 * Description:
393	 *   Write data to flash using 1-1-1 SPI mode.
394	 *
395	 ****************************************************************************/
396	
397	static void xspi_write_111(uint8_t cmd, uint32_t addr, int addr_en,
398	                            const uint8_t *data, size_t len)
399	{
400	  uint32_t ccr;
401	
402	  ccr = (1 << XSPI_CCR_DMODE_Pos)   /* data on 1 line */
403	      | (3 << XSPI_CCR_ADSIZE_Pos)  /* 32-bit address */
404	      | ((addr_en ? 1 : 0) << XSPI_CCR_ADMODE_Pos)
405	      | (1 << XSPI_CCR_IMODE_Pos);  /* instruction on 1 line */
406	
407	  /* Indirect write mode */
408	
409	  xspi2->cr = (xspi2->cr & ~(3 << XSPI_CR_FMODE_Pos)) | (0 << XSPI_CR_FMODE_Pos);
410	
411	  xspi2->ccr = ccr;
412	  xspi2->tcr = 0;  /* no dummy cycles */
413	
414	  if (len > 0)
415	    {
416	      xspi2->dlr = len - 1;
417	    }
418	
419	  xspi2->ir = cmd;
420	
421	  if (addr_en)
422	    {
423	      xspi2->ar = addr;
424	    }
425	
426	  /* Write data */
427	
428	  while (len-- > 0)
429	    {
430	      while (!(xspi2->sr & XSPI_SR_FTF))
431	        {
432	        }
433	
434	      *(volatile uint8_t *)&xspi2->dr = *data++;
435	    }
436	
437	  /* Wait for completion */
438	
439	  while (!(xspi2->sr & XSPI_SR_TCF))
440	    {
441	    }
442	
443	  xspi2->fcr = XSPI_FCR_CTCF;
444	
445	  while (xspi2->sr & XSPI_SR_BUSY)
446	    {
447	    }
448	}

450	/****************************************************************************
451	 * Name: xspi_read_111
452	 *
453	 * Description:
454	 *   Read data from flash using 1-1-1 SPI mode.
455	 *
456	 ****************************************************************************/
457	
458	static void xspi_read_111(uint8_t cmd, uint32_t addr, int addr_en,
459	                           uint8_t *data, size_t len)
460	{
461	  uint32_t ccr;
462	
463	  ccr = (1 << XSPI_CCR_DMODE_Pos)   /* data on 1 line */
464	      | (3 << XSPI_CCR_ADSIZE_Pos)  /* 32-bit address */
465	      | ((addr_en ? 1 : 0) << XSPI_CCR_ADMODE_Pos)
466	      | (1 << XSPI_CCR_IMODE_Pos);  /* instruction on 1 line */
467	
468	  /* Indirect read mode */
469	
470	  xspi2->cr = (xspi2->cr & ~(3 << XSPI_CR_FMODE_Pos)) | (1 << XSPI_CR_FMODE_Pos);
471	
472	  xspi2->ccr = ccr;
473	  xspi2->tcr = 0;  /* no dummy cycles */
474	  xspi2->dlr = len - 1;
475	  xspi2->ir = cmd;
476	
477	  if (addr_en)
478	    {
479	      xspi2->ar = addr;
480	    }
481	
482	  /* Read data */
483	
484	  while (len-- > 0)
485	    {
486	      while (!((xspi2->sr >> XSPI_SR_FLEVEL_Pos) & 0x3f))
487	        {
488	        }
489	
490	      *data++ = *(volatile uint8_t *)&xspi2->dr;
491	    }
492	
493	  xspi2->fcr = XSPI_FCR_CTCF;
494	}

496	/****************************************************************************
497	 * Name: xspi_switch_to_dtr
498	 *
499	 * Description:
500	 *   Switch the MX25UM25645G flash from SPI mode to DTR (DOPI) mode.
501	 *
502	 ****************************************************************************/
503	
504	static void xspi_switch_to_dtr(void)
505	{
506	  uint8_t buf[4];
507	
508	  /* Send WREN (Write Enable) */
509	
510	  xspi_write_111(CMD_WREN, 0, 0, NULL, 0);
511	
512	  /* Wait for WEL bit */
513	
514	  for (int i = 0; i < 100; i++)
515	    {
516	      xspi_read_111(CMD_RDSR, 0, 0, buf, 1);
517	      if (buf[0] & 0x02)
518	        {
519	          break;
520	        }
521	    }
522	
523	  /* Write Configuration Register 2 to switch to DOPI mode */
524	
525	  buf[0] = 0x02;  /* DOPI mode */
526	  xspi_write_111(0x72, 0x00000000, 1, buf, 1);
527	}

529	/****************************************************************************
530	 * Name: xspi_memory_map_888
531	 *
532	 * Description:
533	 *   Enable memory-mapped mode for XIP using 8-8-8 DTR read.
534	 *
535	 ****************************************************************************/
536	
537	static void xspi_memory_map_888(void)
538	{
539	  uint32_t ccr;
540	
541	  ccr = (1 << XSPI_CCR_DQSE_Pos)    /* DQS enabled */
542	      | (1 << XSPI_CCR_DDTR_Pos)     /* data DTR */
543	      | (4 << XSPI_CCR_DMODE_Pos)    /* data on 8 lines */
544	      | (3 << XSPI_CCR_ADSIZE_Pos)   /* 32-bit address */
545	      | (1 << XSPI_CCR_ADDTR_Pos)    /* address DTR */
546	      | (4 << XSPI_CCR_ADMODE_Pos)   /* address on 8 lines */
547	      | (1 << XSPI_CCR_ISIZE_Pos)    /* 16-bit instruction */
548	      | (1 << XSPI_CCR_IDTR_Pos)     /* instruction DTR */
549	      | (4 << XSPI_CCR_IMODE_Pos);   /* instruction on 8 lines */
550	
551	  xspi2->ccr = ccr;
552	  xspi2->tcr = 20 << XSPI_TCR_DCYC_Pos;  /* 20 dummy cycles */
553	  xspi2->ir = CMD_8DTRD;
554	  xspi2->lptr = 1024;  /* timeout period */
555	
556	  /* Enable memory-mapped mode */
557	
558	  xspi2->cr = (xspi2->cr & ~(3 << XSPI_CR_FMODE_Pos)) | (3 << XSPI_CR_FMODE_Pos);
559	}

561	/****************************************************************************
562	 * Name: xspi_init
563	 *
564	 * Description:
565	 *   Initialize XSPI2 for flash access and enable memory-mapped mode.
566	 *
567	 ****************************************************************************/
568	
569	static void xspi_init(void)
570	{
571	  uint32_t reg;
572	
573	  /* Configure XSPI pins */
574	
575	  xspi_pin_config();
576	
577	  /* Enable XSPI clocks and release reset */
578	
579	  reg = getreg32(rcc_ahb5rstcr);
580	  reg |= RCC_AHB5RSTCR_XSPIMRSTC | RCC_AHB5RSTCR_XSPI2RSTC;
581	  putreg32(reg, rcc_ahb5rstcr);
582	
583	  reg = getreg32(rcc_ahb5ensr);
584	  reg |= RCC_AHB5ENSR_XSPIMEN | RCC_AHB5ENSR_XSPI2EN;
585	  putreg32(reg, rcc_ahb5ensr);
586	
587	  /* Set XSPI2 clock source to HCLK */
588	
589	  reg = getreg32(rcc_ccipr4);
590	  reg &= ~(3 << 4);
591	  reg |= (1 << 4);  /* HCLK */
592	  putreg32(reg, rcc_ccipr4);
593	
594	  /* Configure XSPIM in direct mode */
595	
596	  *xspim_cr = 0;
597	
598	  /* Disable XSPI2 for configuration */
599	
600	  xspi2->cr &= ~XSPI_CR_EN;
601	
602	  /* Configure XSPI2:
603	   * - Macronix memory type
604	   * - 32MB flash size
605	   * - CS high time: 2 cycles
606	   * - CLK idles low
607	   */
608	
609	  xspi2->dcr1 = (1 << XSPI_DCR1_MTYP_Pos)
610	               | ((XSPI_FLASH_SIZE_BITS_LOG2 - 3 - 1) << XSPI_DCR1_DEVSIZE_Pos)
611	               | (1 << XSPI_DCR1_CSHT_Pos)
612	               | (0 << XSPI_DCR1_CKMODE_Pos);
613	
614	  /* Prescaler: F_CLK = F_AHB / 4 */
615	
616	  xspi2->dcr2 = (4 - 1) << XSPI_DCR2_PRESCALER_Pos;
617	  xspi2->dcr3 = 0;
618	  xspi2->dcr4 = 0;
619	  xspi2->tcr = 0;
620	
621	  /* Enable XSPI2 */
622	
623	  xspi2->cr |= XSPI_CR_EN;
624	
625	  /* Reconfigure XSPIM */
626	
627	  xspi2->cr &= ~XSPI_CR_EN;
628	  *xspim_cr = 0;
629	  xspi2->cr |= XSPI_CR_EN;
630	
631	  /* Switch flash to DTR mode */
632	
633	  xspi_switch_to_dtr();
634	
635	  /* Enable memory-mapped mode (8DTRD) */
636	
637	  xspi_memory_map_888();
638	}

640	/****************************************************************************
641	 * Name: fsbl_jump_to_app
642	 *
643	 * Description:
644	 *   Jump to the application at the given address.
645	 *
646	 ****************************************************************************/
647	
648	static void fsbl_jump_to_app(uint32_t app_addr)
649	{
650	  uint32_t msp;
651	  uint32_t reset_handler;
652	
653	  /* Validate application: check that the reset handler address is valid */
654	
655	  msp = *(volatile uint32_t *)app_addr;
656	  reset_handler = *(volatile uint32_t *)(app_addr + 4);
657	
658	  /* Check that MSP looks reasonable (in SRAM range 0x34xxxxxx) and reset
659	   * handler is in the XIP flash range (0x70xxxxxx)
660	   */
661	
662	  if ((msp & 0xff000000) != 0x34000000 ||
663	      (reset_handler & 0xff000000) != 0x70000000)
664	    {
665	      /* Invalid application, hang with LED blinking fast to indicate error */
666	
667	      for (; ; )
668	        {
669	          LED_ON();
670	          for (volatile uint32_t d = 0; d < 50000; d++);
671	          LED_OFF();
672	          for (volatile uint32_t d = 0; d < 50000; d++);
673	        }
674	    }
675	
676	  /* Set the vector table to the application's location */
677	
678	  putreg32(app_addr, NVIC_VECTAB);
679	
680	  /* Set MSP and jump */
681	
682	  __asm__ volatile (
683	      "msr msp, %0\n"
684	      "bx %1\n"
685	      :
686	      : "r" (msp), "r" (reset_handler)
687	  );
688	
689	  /* Should not reach here */
690	
691	  for (; ; )
692	    {
693	    }
694	}

723	/****************************************************************************

725	 *
726	 * Description:
727	 *   Main entry point for the FSBL.
728	 *
729	 ****************************************************************************/
730	
731	int fsbl_main(int argc, char *argv[])
732	{
733	  /* Disable interrupts */
734	
735	  up_irq_disable();
736	
737	  /* Enable PWR clock first (needed for VDD configuration) */
738	
739	  modifyreg32(STM32_RCC_AHB4ENSR, 0, (1 << 16));  /* PWREN */
740	
741	  /* Enable VDDIO4 (3.3V) for GPIO G */
742	
743	  modifyreg32(STM32_PWR_SVMCR1, 0, PWR_SVMCR1_VDDIO4SV);
744

defined in linker script */
.word _sidata

.word _sdata

.word _edata

 *          starts execution following a reset event. Only the absolutely
 *          necessary set is performed, after which the application
 *          supplied main() routine is called.
 * @param  None
 * @retval : None
*/

  .section .text.Reset_Handler
  .weak Reset_Handler
  .type Reset_Handler, %function
Reset_Handler:
  ldr   r0, =_sstack
  msr   MSPLIM, r0
  ldr   r0, =_estack
  mov   sp, r0          /* set stack pointer */
/* Call the clock system initialization function.*/
  bl  SystemInit

/* Copy the data segment initializers from flash to SRAM */
  ldr r0, =_sdata
  ldr r1, =_edata
  ldr r2, =_sidata
  movs r3, #0
  b LoopCopyDataInit

CopyDataInit:
  ldr r4, [r2, r3]
  str r4, [r0, r3]
  adds r3, r3, #4

LoopCopyDataInit:
  adds r4, r0, r3
  cmp r4, r1
  bcc CopyDataInit

/* Zero fill the bss segment. */
  ldr r2, =_sbss
  ldr r4, =_ebss

  adds r2, r2, #4

  bcc FillZerobss

  bl main

1. **Reference project's Reset_Handler**:

   - Sets MSPLIM and PSPLIM to 0
   - Branches to __start_c
   - __start_c sets VTOR, disables SysTick, enables FPU, clears .bss, copies .data, configures clocks, etc.

The reference project's SystemInit() sets VTOR to the vector table address, while our NuttX __start_c does the same. But here's the critical issue: the reference project's Reset_Handler sets MSPLIM to _sstack before anything else, whereas our NuttX sets MSPLIM to 0 and then reconfigures the stack later in arm_initialize_stack. This difference in stack limit initialization could be causing the problem.

The reference project's JumpToApplication() sets VTOR, loads the reset handler from the vector table, disables interrupts, sets MSPLIM to 0, sets MSP from the vector table, then re-enables interrupts before jumping to the reset handler. Our FSBL's fsbl_jump_to_app() does something similar but the sequence and interrupt handling might be different.

The key difference is that the reference project re-enables interrupts after setting MSP, while our FSBL keeps interrupts disabled when jumping. This shouldn't matter for the NuttX startup since it doesn't need interrupts initially, but it's worth noting.

/****************************************************************************
 * Name: arm_fpuconfig
 *
 * Description:
 *   Configure the FPU.  Relative bit settings:
 *
 *     CPACR:  Enables access to CP10 and CP11
 *     CONTROL.FPCA: Determines whether the FP extension is active in the
 *       current context:
 *     FPCCR.ASPEN:  Enables automatic FP state preservation, then the
 *       processor sets this bit to 1 on successful completion of any FP
 *       instruction.
 *     FPCCR.LSPEN:  Enables lazy context save of FP state. When this is
 *       done, the processor reserves space on the stack for the FP state,
 *       but does not save that state information to the stack.
 *
 *  Software must not change the value of the ASPEN bit or LSPEN bit while
 *  either:
 *
 *   - the CPACR permits access to CP10 and CP11, that give access to the FP
 *     extension, or
 *   - the CONTROL.FPCA bit is set to 1
 *
 ****************************************************************************/

void arm_fpuconfig(void)
{
  uint32_t regval;

  /* Set CONTROL.FPCA so that we always get the extended context frame
   * with the volatile FP registers stacked above the basic context.
   */

  regval = getcontrol();
  regval |= CONTROL_FPCA;
  setcontrol(regval);

  /* Ensure that FPCCR.LSPEN is disabled, so that we don't have to contend
   * with the lazy FP context save behavior.  Clear FPCCR.ASPEN since we
   * are going to turn on CONTROL.FPCA for all contexts.
   */

  regval = getreg32(NVIC_FPCCR);
  regval &= ~(NVIC_FPCCR_ASPEN | NVIC_FPCCR_LSPEN);
  putreg32(regval, NVIC_FPCCR);

  /* Enable full access to CP10 and CP11 */

  regval = getreg32(NVIC_CPACR);
  regval |= NVIC_CPACR_CP_FULL(10) | NVIC_CPACR_CP_FULL(11);
  putreg32(regval, NVIC_CPACR);
}

Now I understand the reference project's memory layout:

- FSBL maps flash starting at 0x70000000 (XSPI2 base)
- Application is at offset 0x100000 (1MB) + 0x400 (header) = 0x100400 from the base
- So application starts at 0x70000000 + 0x100400 = 0x70100400

Our NuttX setup:
- FSBL maps flash starting at 0x70000000
- Application is at 0x70080000 (512K offset)
- So the offset is 0x80000, not 0x100400

Both should work as long as the XSPI2 memory mapping covers the address. Our FSBL maps 32MB starting at 0x70000000, so both 0x70080000 and 0x70100400 are within range.

Now let me think about what else could be different. The reference project's FSBL:

1. Enables I-Cache and D-Cache at the beginning (lines 77-86 of main.c)
2. Calls HAL_Init() which sets up SysTick
3. Configures system clock (PLL1, PLL2, PLL3, PLL4)
4. Initializes XSPI1 (HyperRAM) and XSPI2 (flash)
5. Calls BOOT_Application() which:
   a. Maps memory (enables memory-mapped mode)
   b. Jumps to application (disables caches, suspends SysTick, sets MSPLIM, sets MSP, jumps)

Our FSBL:
1. Disables interrupts
2. Configures VDD
3. Configures power
4. Initializes XSPI2 (flash)
5. Jumps to application (sets VTOR, sets MSP, jumps)

Key differences:
- Our FSBL doesn't enable/disable caches (reference enables then disables before jump)
- Our FSBL doesn't configure SysTick (reference uses HAL_Init which sets up SysTick, then suspends before jump)
- Our FSBL doesn't set MSPLIM before jumping (reference does)
- Our FSBL doesn't re-enable interrupts after setting MSP (reference does)

The MSPLIM issue is interesting. When the FSBL jumps to the NuttX app, the NuttX __start function sets MSPLIM to 0. But what if the FSBL left MSPLIM at some non-zero value? Let me check...

Actually, the boot ROM might set MSPLIM. The NuttX __start function clears it to 0. But between the FSBL's jump and the NuttX __start executing, if any exception fires (like a HardFault), the processor would check MSPLIM. If MSPLIM is still set to some value from the boot ROM, and the MSP is below that value, it would cause a fault.

But wait, the NuttX __start function is the very first thing that executes. It sets MSPLIM to 0 before doing anything else. So this shouldn't be an issue.

Actually, let me re-read the reference project's jump function more carefully:

```c
__set_MSPLIM(0x00000000);
__set_MSP(*(__IO uint32_t *) Application_vector);
__set_PRIMASK(primask_bit);
JumpToApp();
```

The reference sets MSPLIM to 0 BEFORE setting MSP. This is important because if MSP is set first and it's below the current MSPLIM, the next stack operation would fault.

Our FSBL does:
```c
putreg32(app_addr, NVIC_VECTAB);
__asm__ volatile (
    "msr msp, %0\n"
    "bx %1\n"
    :
    : "r" (msp), "r" (reset_handler)
);
```

We set MSP without first clearing MSPLIM. If the boot ROM or FSBL set MSPLIM to some value, and the NuttX MSP (0x340042a8) is below that value, the very first push in the NuttX start function would fault!

Wait, but the NuttX __start function does `msr msplim, r0` where r0=0 as the very first instruction. So it clears MSPLIM before any stack operation. Let me check...

Actually, looking at the NuttX __start:
```c
void __attribute__((naked)) noinstrument_function __start(void)
{
  __asm__ volatile ("mov r0, #0\n\t"
                    "msr msplim, r0\n\t"
                    "msr psplim, r0\n\t"
                    "b __start_c\n\t");
}
```

This is the entry point. It sets MSPLIM to 0 first, then PSPLIM to 0, then branches to __start_c. But wait - the vector table points to `start` at 0x70080570, not `__start` at 0x70080370. The `start` function calls `arm_initialize_stack` first, which does stack setup.

Let me look at the `start` function again:
```
70080570 <start>:
70080570: b508       push {r3, lr}
70080572: f00f fdf7  bl 70090164 <arm_initialize_stack>
```

The very first instruction is `push {r3, lr}`! This pushes to the stack using MSP. If MSPLIM is set to a value above the current MSP, this push would cause a stack limit fault!

So the issue is:
1. FSBL sets MSP to 0x340042a8 (from the NuttX vector table)
2. FSBL jumps to `start` at 0x70080570
3. `start` does `push {r3, lr}` which decrements MSP to 0x340042a0
4. If MSPLIM is set to some value > 0x340042a0, a stack limit fault occurs

The boot ROM might set MSPLIM to some value. Let me check...

Actually, the NuttX __start_c function comment says:
```
/* The DEV-mode boot ROM leaves MSPLIM and PSPLIM set such that the first * stack push from C code can fault.  This function is naked so the limits
 * can be cleared before any compiler-generated prologue runs.
 */
```

So the boot ROM DOES set MSPLIM to some value! And the NuttX __start function clears it. But the problem is that `start` (the vector table entry point) does `push {r3, lr}` BEFORE calling `arm_initialize_stack`, and `arm_initialize_stack` eventually sets MSPLIM. So if MSPLIM is still set from the boot ROM, the push at the very beginning of `start` could fault.

Wait, but `arm_initialize_stack` does set MSPLIM:
```
700901b0: f383 8808  msr MSP, r3
700901b4: f381 880a  msr MSPLIM, r1
```

So the sequence is:
1. `start` does `push {r3, lr}` (this could fault if MSPLIM is wrong)
2. `start` calls `arm_initialize_stack`
3. `arm_initialize_stack` sets MSP and MSPLIM

The push at step 1 is the problem! If the boot ROM set MSPLIM to a value that's above the MSP we set, the push would fault.

Let me check what the boot ROM sets MSPLIM to. Actually, I don't know the exact value. But the NuttX comment says "the DEV-mode boot ROM leaves MSPLIM and PSPLIM set such that the first stack push from C code can fault."

So the fix is to set MSPLIM to 0 BEFORE jumping to the NuttX app, just like the reference project does.

3. Disable interrupts
4. Set MSPLIM to 0
5. Set MSP

#
# FSBL (First Stage Boot Loader) configuration for ATK-DNN647 board.
#
# This is a minimal configuration for the FSBL that initializes
# VDD voltage domains and XSPI flash, then jumps to the application.
#

CONFIG_ARCH="arm"
CONFIG_ARCH_ARMV8M=y
CONFIG_ARCH_BOARD="atk-dnn647"
CONFIG_ARCH_BOARD_ATK_DNN647=y
CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP="stm32n6"
CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP_STM32=y
CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP_STM32N647X0=y
CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP_STM32N6=y
CONFIG_ARCH_INTERRUPTSTACK=512
CONFIG_ARCH_STACKDUMP=n
CONFIG_ARCH_TOOLCHAIN_GCC=y
CONFIG_ARM_TOOLCHAIN_GNU_EABI=y

# FSBL runs from SRAM2 at 0x34180400
CONFIG_RAM_START=0x34180400
CONFIG_RAM_SIZE=31744

# FSBL mode - disable all OS features
CONFIG_BOARD_LATE_INITIALIZE=n
CONFIG_BOARDCTL=n
CONFIG_BUILTIN=n
CONFIG_DEBUG_ASSERTIONS=n
CONFIG_DEBUG_FEATURES=n
CONFIG_DEBUG_SYMBOLS=n

# Disable all filesystem support
CONFIG_DISABLE_ENVIRON=y
CONFIG_DISABLE_MQUEUE=y
CONFIG_DISABLE_PTHREAD=y
CONFIG_FS_DISABLE_MOUNTPOINT=y
CONFIG_FS_LOCK_BUCKET_SIZE=0
CONFIG_NAME_MAX=1

# Minimal memory management
CONFIG_MM_NODE_GUARDSIZE=0
CONFIG_MM_REGIONS=1

# FSBL entry point
CONFIG_INIT_ENTRYPOINT="fsbl_main"

# Stack size for FSBL
CONFIG_IDLETHREAD_STACKSIZE=1024

# Single CPU
CONFIG_NCPUS=1

# Minimal file descriptors
CONFIG_NFILE_DESCRIPTORS=0

# No console needed for FSBL
CONFIG_NSH_ARCHINIT=n

# No serial
CONFIG_SERIAL_DISABLE=y

# Minimal scheduling
CONFIG_PREALLOC_TIMERS=0
CONFIG_SIG_DEFAULT=y

# Binary output
CONFIG_RAW_BINARY=y

# FSBL specific
CONFIG_FSBL=y

# No C++ support
CONFIG_HAVE_CXX=n

# No syscall support
CONFIG_LIB_SYSCALL=n

两个固件都已重新编译完成：

**FSBL 修改：** 在跳转前添加了 MSPLIM/PSPLIM 清零操作，与参考项目的 `JumpToApplication()` 一致：

```c
__asm__ volatile (
    "mov r0, #0\n"
    "msr msplim, r0\n"
    "msr psplim, r0\n"
    "msr msp, %0\n"
    "bx %1\n"
    :
    : "r" (msp), "r" (reset_handler)
    : "r0"
);
```

**原因：** Boot ROM 会设置 MSPLIM，如果不先清零就设置 MSP，当 NuttX 的 `start` 函数执行 `push {r3, lr}` 时，如果 MSP 低于 MSPLIM，会触发栈限制错误（Stack Limit Fault）。

# Claude.md — STM32N6 PCB 缺陷检测项目记忆

本文件记录项目中已解决的关键问题与解决方案，供后续开发与排错参考。

---

## 问题 1：YOLOv8 bbox 坐标系不匹配导致 INT8 量化后检测全零

### 现象

更换新模型 `Model_PCB_BW_Detection`（黑白 PCB 缺陷检测，6 类：hole/open/short/mousebite/spur/copper）后：

- NPU 推理正常运行（inf=95ms 稳定），但 **cls_max=0**，UART 日志中 `det=0` 占 99% 以上。
- ST Edge AI 报告 `output0_scale=2.014`（异常偏大），而旧 RGB 模型为 `0.0040`。
- INT8 量化后，类别概率（0~1 范围）被压缩到 int8 的 0，导致所有检测框被过滤。

### 根本原因

Ultralytics 8.4.23 使用 `opset=13` 导出 YOLOv8 ONNX 时，会在 bbox 输出分支末尾插入一个 `Mul` 节点，乘数为 `Constant_15 = [8, 16, 32]`（三个检测层的 stride），将 bbox 从 **归一化坐标 (0~1)** 还原为 **像素坐标 (0~416)**。

由此导致：

- ONNX 输出 bbox 范围变为 0~416，而类别概率仍是 0~1。
- ST Edge AI INT8 校准时，为容纳 0~416 的 bbox，将 `output0_scale` 放大至 2.014。
- 在 INT8 量化下，类别概率 0~1 × scale 2.014 ≈ int8 0~2，**几乎所有类别概率被量化为 0**。
- 应用层后处理 `app_ai_clamp01` 期望归一化坐标 (0~1)，遇到 0~416 像素坐标也会出错。

而旧的 RGB 模型使用 `int8=True, opset=19` 导出，Ultralytics 没有插入该 Mul 节点，bbox 保持归一化，`output0_scale=0.0040` 正常。

### 解决方案

**核心思路：在 FP32 ONNX 中将 `Constant_15` 从 `[8, 16, 32]` 修改为 `[8/416, 16/416, 32/416]`，使最终 bbox 输出回到归一化范围 (0~1)。**

修复脚本：[fix_bbox_normalization.py](file:///e:/STM32CubeIDE/STM32_N6_47/5_AISecond/Model_PCB_BW_Detection/fix_bbox_normalization.py)

```python
# 关键修改
import numpy as np
import onnx

m = onnx.load("best.onnx")
for node in m.graph.node:
    if node.op_type == "Constant" and node.output[0].startswith("Constant_15"):
        # 原 [8, 16, 32] -> [8/416, 16/416, 32/416]
        arr = onnx.numpy_helper.to_array(node.attribute[0].t).astype(np.float32)
        arr = arr / 416.0
        node.attribute[0].t.CopyFrom(
            onnx.numpy_helper.from_array(arr, node.attribute[0].t.name))
onnx.save(m, "best_normalized.onnx")
```

### 验证

- 修复后 `output0_scale = 0.004842`（与旧 RGB 模型 0.0040 接近）。
- 量化验证 `cls_max = 0.9199`（修复前为 0.000）。
- 部署后 UART 出现 `det=1, det=2, det=4` 等非零检测。
- CSV 报告出现 `cls=5, conf=6342`（即 0.6342）的真实检测。

### 完整部署流程

```text
best.pt
  → yolo export format=onnx opset=13 imgsz=416          (FP32 NCHW)
  → fix_bbox_normalization.py                            (修改 Constant_15)
  → best_normalized.onnx
  → quantize_yolov8_onnx_qdq.py --activation int8 --no-per-channel
  → best_normalized_qdq_s8.onnx                          (非 fused QDQ)
  → generate-n6-model-onnx-qdq.ps1                       (ST Edge AI 生成)
  → network.c/h, network_data.xSPI2.bin                  (部署到工程)
```

详细文档：[README_ONNX_QDQ_STM32N6.md](file:///e:/STM32CubeIDE/STM32_N6_47/5_AISecond/Model_PCB_BW_Detection/README_ONNX_QDQ_STM32N6.md)

---

## 问题 2：Fused QDQ 模型导致 NPU 崩溃 (HardFault / 黑屏死机)

### 现象

使用 `best_qdq_s8_fused.onnx`（融合 QDQ）部署后，NPU 推理瞬间 HardFault，LCD 黑屏，整机死机。

### 根本原因

- 融合 QDQ 移除了末尾的 Q→DQ 链，ST Edge AI 输出节点变为 `Concat_538_out_0`（原始 int8）。
- 应用层 `app_ai_output_buffer` 是 `float[]`，将 int8 字节当作 float32 读取 → 4 个 int8 字节拼成 1 个垃圾 float → 数组索引越界 → HardFault。

### 解决方案

**必须使用非 fused QDQ 模型** `best_normalized_qdq_s8.onnx`，使 ST Edge AI 输出节点为 `Dequantize_505_out_0`（正确的 float32）。

### 部署确认

[STM32CubeIDE/Appli/Application/User/AI/network.h](file:///e:/STM32CubeIDE/STM32_N6_47/5_AISecond/STM32CubeIDE/Appli/Application/User/AI/network.h) 中：
- 模型名：`best_normalized_qdq_s8`
- 输出节点：`Dequantize_505_out_0`
- 输出格式：`float32(1x10x3549)`

---

## 问题 3：NPU 周期性超时（未完全解决）

### 现象

UART 日志中每隔约 90~120 帧出现：

```text
[AI] live inference timeout
[AI] live inference failed ret=-3, recovering runtime
WARNING: performing a hard-reset of debug wait-mask!
[Main] ERROR: inference failed on frame XXX
```

### 原因分析

非 fused QDQ 模型中仍存在 99KB 的 `_ec_blob_network_67[12408]`（EC = Embedded Code，NPU 调度补丁）。这些 EC blob 在某些张量形状下触发 NPU 内部死锁，需要 hard-reset 才能恢复。

### 现状

- **不影响功能**：每次超时后自动恢复，下一帧推理正常。
- **影响性能**：每次超时损失约 1~2 秒，且丢一帧检测。
- **未根本解决**：可能需要调整量化策略（per-channel 量化、不同校准数据集）或更换模型结构（去除某些算子）。

---

## 问题 4：SMART EXIT 后再进 REALTIME 导致 NPU 永久死锁

### 现象

用户在 SMART 模式快速进入并退出（<10 秒，未完成扫描），回到 REALTIME 后：

- Frame 520 `period=14827ms`（14.8 秒间隔，异常）
- Frame 521 第一次 timeout
- 之后 Frame 521 **反复 timeout**（每 5 秒一次），`ai_test_recover_after_failure()` 无法恢复
- 用户按 EXIT 回 HOME，再进 REALTIME，**依然 timeout**（NPU 永久卡死）
- 摄像头预览正常（Pipe1/ISP 没受影响），但 GUI 检测框不更新
- 必须完全断电重启才能恢复

### 根本原因

三个问题叠加：

1. **`app_ai_stop()` 没有彻底清理 NPU 状态**：原实现只设置 `g_ai_pipeline_started = 0` 并等待 `g_npu_busy` 清零，但**没有 deinit NPU runtime**。SMART 期间 NPU 内部状态可能已损坏，回到 REALTIME 时 NPU 仍处于异常状态。

2. **`app_ai_start()` 恢复时没有重新 init NPU**：当 `g_ai_runtime_inited = 1` 时，只调用 `imx335_start_nn_capture()` 重启 Pipe2，**没有重新 init NPU runtime**。NPU 已死锁的状态被直接复用。

3. **没有连续 timeout 熔断机制**：主循环在推理失败时只 `continue`，没有计数器和上限。`ai_test_recover_after_failure()` 在 NPU 真正死锁时也无效，导致无限循环 `timeout → recover → timeout`，UART 反复打印同一个 frame 号。

### 解决方案（已实施）

**修复 1：添加连续失败熔断**（[app_threadx.c](file:///e:/STM32CubeIDE/STM32_N6_47/5_AISecond/STM32CubeIDE/Appli/Application/User/Core/app_threadx.c)）

主循环中加入 `consecutive_inf_failures` 计数器：
- 推理失败时 +1，成功时清零
- **连续 2 次失败**时调用 `ai_inference_full_reset()` 彻底重置 NPU（含 cache），设置 `g_ai_runtime_inited = 0`，强制下次 `app_ai_start()` 走完整 init 流程
- 自动回到 HOME 页，提示用户重新进入 REALTIME

**修复 2：`app_ai_stop()` 彻底重置 NPU**（[app_threadx.c](file:///e:/STM32CubeIDE/STM32_N6_47/5_AISecond/STM32CubeIDE/Appli/Application/User/Core/app_threadx.c)）

`app_ai_stop()` 现在：
- 等待 `g_npu_busy` 清零（最多 2 秒）
- 清理残留帧信号
- 调用 `ai_inference_full_reset()`（deinit + NPU cache reset）
- 设置 `g_ai_runtime_inited = 0`

这样无论从 REALTIME EXIT 还是 SMART EXIT，NPU 都会被彻底清理，下次进入时走完整 init。

**修复 3：新增 `ai_inference_full_reset()` 函数**（[ai_test.c](file:///e:/STM32CubeIDE/STM32_N6_47/5_AISecond/STM32CubeIDE/Appli/Application/User/AI/ai_test.c) / [ai_test.h](file:///e:/STM32CubeIDE/STM32_N6_47/5_AISecond/STM32CubeIDE/Appli/Application/User/AI/ai_test.h)）

```c
void ai_inference_full_reset(void)
{
    ai_test_network_deinit();
    ai_test_runtime_deinit();
    /* NPU cache 完全重置（与 recover_after_failure 相同的流程） */
    (void)HAL_CACHEAXI_Disable(&hcacheaxi);
    npu_cache_enable_clocks_and_reset();
    npu_cache_enable();
    npu_cache_invalidate();
    __DSB();
    __ISB();
}
```

### 副作用

- 每次 `app_ai_stop()` 现在会增加 ~1 秒的 NPU 重置延迟（可接受）
- 每次 `app_ai_start()` 都走完整 init 流程（`g_ai_runtime_inited` 几乎总是 0）
- 这是**安全性 > 速度**的权衡，避免 NPU 状态污染导致的死锁

### 验证方法

1. 编译烧录后，进入 REALTIME 正常检测
2. 按 EXIT 回 HOME，进入 SMART，**立即按 EXIT**（<10 秒）
3. 回到 REALTIME，应该能正常检测（不再卡死）
4. 如果仍卡死，UART 会在连续 2 次 timeout 后打印 `[AI] FATAL: NPU deadlocked, performing full reset`，自动回到 HOME 页

---

## 关键约束与约定（与本次问题相关）

- **NN 输入**：416×416×3 RGB888 uint8（NHWC），量化 scale=1/255，等价于 `float = uint8 / 255`。
- **NN 输出**：`1x10x3549` float32，10 = 4(bbox xywh) + 6(classes)，3549 = (52²+26²+13²) anchors。
- **bbox 必须**为归一化坐标 (0~1)，应用层 `app_ai_clamp01` 强制裁剪到 0~1。
- **置信度阈值**：`AI_OBJDETECT_YOLOV8_PP_CONF_THRESHOLD = 0.5f`（位于 [app_config.h](file:///e:/STM32CubeIDE/STM32_N6_47/5_AISecond/Appli/Core/Inc/app_config.h) 第 59 行）。
- **IOU 阈值**：`AI_OBJDETECT_YOLOV8_PP_IOU_THRESHOLD = 0.45f`。
- **类别映射**：`hole(0), open(1), short(2), mousebite(3), spur(4), copper(5)`。
- **视觉管线**：DCMIPP Pipe1 800×480 实时预览 + Pipe2 416×416 NPU 推理并行。
- **CSV 报告坐标**：已乘以 LCD 尺寸 (800×480)，不是 NN 坐标。
- **newlib-nano 限制**：UART 中 `conf= box=(,,,)` 为空是已知问题，CSV 用整数算术正常输出（conf=6342 表示 0.6342）。

#
# For a description of the syntax of this configuration file,
# see the file kconfig-language.txt in the NuttX tools repository.
#

if ARCH_BOARD_ATK_DNN647

config FSBL
	bool "Build FSBL (First Stage Boot Loader)"
	default n
	---help---
		Build the FSBL for the ATK-DNN647 board. The FSBL runs from
		SRAM2 at 0x34180400, initializes VDD voltage domains and
		XSPI flash, then jumps to the application at 0x70080000.

config STM32N6_XIP
	bool "Build application for XIP (Execute-In-Place)"
	default n
	depends on !FSBL
	---help---
		Build the application to run from external flash via XIP
		at 0x70080000. Requires the FSBL to be running first.

endif

#
# FSBL (First Stage Boot Loader) configuration for ATK-DNN647 board.
#
# This is a minimal configuration for the FSBL that initializes
# VDD voltage domains and XSPI flash, then jumps to the application.
#

CONFIG_ARCH="arm"
CONFIG_ARCH_ARMV8M=y
CONFIG_ARCH_BOARD="atk-dnn647"
CONFIG_ARCH_BOARD_ATK_DNN647=y
CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP="stm32n6"
CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP_STM32=y
CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP_STM32N647X0=y
CONFIG_ARCH_CHIP_STM32N6=y
CONFIG_ARCH_INTERRUPTSTACK=512
CONFIG_ARCH_STACKDUMP=n
CONFIG_ARCH_TOOLCHAIN_GCC=y
CONFIG_ARM_TOOLCHAIN_GNU_EABI=y

# FSBL runs from SRAM2 at 0x34180400
CONFIG_RAM_START=0x34180400
CONFIG_RAM_SIZE=31744

CONFIG_BOARD_LATE_INITIALIZE=n
CONFIG_BOARDCTL=n
CONFIG_BUILTIN=n
CONFIG_DEBUG_ASSERTIONS=n
CONFIG_DEBUG_FEATURES=n
CONFIG_DEBUG_SYMBOLS=n

CONFIG_DISABLE_MQUEUE=y
CONFIG_DISABLE_PTHREAD=y
CONFIG_FS_DISABLE_MOUNTPOINT=y
CONFIG_FS_LOCK_BUCKET_SIZE=0
CONFIG_NAME_MAX=1

CONFIG_MM_NODE_GUARDSIZE=0
CONFIG_MM_REGIONS=1

CONFIG_INIT_ENTRYPOINT="fsbl_main"

# Stack size for FSBL

CONFIG_NCPUS=1

# Minimal file descriptors
CONFIG_NFILE_DESCRIPTORS=0

# No serial
CONFIG_SERIAL_DISABLE=y

# Minimal scheduling
CONFIG_PREALLOC_TIMERS=0
CONFIG_SIG_DEFAULT=y

# Binary output
CONFIG_RAW_BINARY=y

# FSBL specific
CONFIG_FSBL=y

# No C++ support
CONFIG_HAVE_CXX=n

# No syscall support
CONFIG_LIB_SYSCALL=n

# Claude.md — STM32N6 PCB 缺陷检测项目记忆

本文件记录项目中已解决的关键问题与解决方案，供后续开发与排错参考。

---

## 问题 1：YOLOv8 bbox 坐标系不匹配导致 INT8 量化后检测全零

### 现象

更换新模型 `Model_PCB_BW_Detection`（黑白 PCB 缺陷检测，6 类：hole/open/short/mousebite/spur/copper）后：

- NPU 推理正常运行（inf=95ms 稳定），但 **cls_max=0**，UART 日志中 `det=0` 占 99% 以上。
- ST Edge AI 报告 `output0_scale=2.014`（异常偏大），而旧 RGB 模型为 `0.0040`。
- INT8 量化后，类别概率（0~1 范围）被压缩到 int8 的 0，导致所有检测框被过滤。

### 根本原因

Ultralytics 8.4.23 使用 `opset=13` 导出 YOLOv8 ONNX 时，会在 bbox 输出分支末尾插入一个 `Mul` 节点，乘数为 `Constant_15 = [8, 16, 32]`（三个检测层的 stride），将 bbox 从 **归一化坐标 (0~1)** 还原为 **像素坐标 (0~416)**。

由此导致：

- ONNX 输出 bbox 范围变为 0~416，而类别概率仍是 0~1。
- ST Edge AI INT8 校准时，为容纳 0~416 的 bbox，将 `output0_scale` 放大至 2.014。
- 在 INT8 量化下，类别概率 0~1 × scale 2.014 ≈ int8 0~2，**几乎所有类别概率被量化为 0**。
- 应用层后处理 `app_ai_clamp01` 期望归一化坐标 (0~1)，遇到 0~416 像素坐标也会出错。

而旧的 RGB 模型使用 `int8=True, opset=19` 导出，Ultralytics 没有插入该 Mul 节点，bbox 保持归一化，`output0_scale=0.0040` 正常。

### 解决方案

**核心思路：在 FP32 ONNX 中将 `Constant_15` 从 `[8, 16, 32]` 修改为 `[8/416, 16/416, 32/416]`，使最终 bbox 输出回到归一化范围 (0~1)。**

修复脚本：[fix_bbox_normalization.py](file:///e:/STM32CubeIDE/STM32_N6_47/5_AISecond/Model_PCB_BW_Detection/fix_bbox_normalization.py)

```python
# 关键修改
import numpy as np
import onnx

m = onnx.load("best.onnx")
for node in m.graph.node:
    if node.op_type == "Constant" and node.output[0].startswith("Constant_15"):
        # 原 [8, 16, 32] -> [8/416, 16/416, 32/416]
        arr = onnx.numpy_helper.to_array(node.attribute[0].t).astype(np.float32)
        arr = arr / 416.0
        node.attribute[0].t.CopyFrom(
            onnx.numpy_helper.from_array(arr, node.attribute[0].t.name))
onnx.save(m, "best_normalized.onnx")
```

### 验证

- 修复后 `output0_scale = 0.004842`（与旧 RGB 模型 0.0040 接近）。
- 量化验证 `cls_max = 0.9199`（修复前为 0.000）。
- 部署后 UART 出现 `det=1, det=2, det=4` 等非零检测。
- CSV 报告出现 `cls=5, conf=6342`（即 0.6342）的真实检测。

```text
  → yolo export format=onnx opset=13 imgsz=416          (FP32 NCHW)
  → fix_bbox_normalization.py                            (修改 Constant_15)
  → best_normalized.onnx
  → quantize_yolov8_onnx_qdq.py --activation int8 --no-per-channel
  → best_normalized_qdq_s8.onnx                          (非 fused QDQ)
```
